model_requirements.description: PillarRx is a pharmacy benefit management (PBM) consulting firm operating as a division of Brown & Brown Insurance. PillarRx provides customized pharmacy solutions for employer-sponsored health plans, analyzing pharmacy spend across multiple PBMs on behalf of approximately 300 employer clients.  The business operates on a multi-tenant Company > Division > Client hierarchy. Each client is an employer whose health plan members fill prescriptions through one or more PBMs (CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts, Navitus, EmpiRx Health, BCBS Michigan, Rightway Healthcare, Prime Therapeutics, ServeYou, Carelon). PillarRx aggregates, normalizes, and analyzes pharmacy claims data across these PBMs to deliver consulting insights, copay assistance program management, PBM audit services, and affordability intelligence.  Core business functions: - Pharmacy claims analysis and consulting (audit, benchmarking, trend analysis) - Copay assistance program (CAP) management via the PAX application - Member eligibility and benefits administration - Drug reference and formulary analysis - Manufacturer program management (copay cards, rebates, coupons, 340B) - Prior authorization analysis - Medical claims integration for total cost of care  Revenue comes from consulting fees, not insurance premiums. PillarRx does not adjudicate claims or manage formularies -- it audits and advises on PBM performance for its employer clients.

attributes.name: accumulator_source_type

attributes.name: accumulator_status

attributes.name: accumulator_type

attributes.name: benefit_group_fk
attributes.business_glossary_term: Member Oop Accumulator Benefit Group Fk

attributes.name: benefit_year_end_date

attributes.name: benefit_year_start_date

attributes.name: cap_applied_amt
attributes.description: Year-to-date dollar amount applied by copay assistance programs (manufacturer coupons, copay cards) on behalf of the member. Tracked for TrOOP exclusion analysis.

attributes.name: cap_excluded_from_troop_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Copay Assistance Program (CAP) Excluded from True Out-of-Pocket (TrOOP) Flag

attributes.name: claim_count
attributes.description: Total number of paid pharmacy claims contributing to this accumulator record within the benefit year. Excludes reversals and adjustments.

attributes.name: coinsurance_applied_amt
attributes.description: Year-to-date coinsurance amounts paid by the member across all pharmacy claims in the benefit year. Percentage-based member cost share component.

attributes.name: copay_applied_amt
attributes.description: Year-to-date fixed copay amounts paid by the member across all pharmacy claims in the benefit year. Component of total OOP accumulation.

attributes.name: coverage_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accumulator applies to pharmacy-only, medical-only, or a combined pharmacy and medical deductible/OOP per the plan design.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accumulator record was first created in the system, typically at the start of the benefit year or upon the member's first claim.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating PBM or system that provided the accumulator data (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts). Supports multi-PBM reconciliation.

attributes.name: deductible_applied_amt
attributes.description: Year-to-date dollar amount the member has applied toward their pharmacy deductible within the benefit year. Accumulates with each paid claim.

attributes.name: deductible_maximum_amt
attributes.description: The plan-defined maximum deductible threshold for this member's benefit plan and year. Sourced from the benefit plan configuration.

attributes.name: deductible_met_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Member Oop Accumulator Deductible Met Date
attributes.description: The date on which the member's pharmacy deductible was fully satisfied for the benefit year. Null if deductible has not yet been met.

tag_set.value: Member Oop Accumulator Deductible Met Date

attributes.name: deductible_met_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Member Oop Accumulator Deductible Met Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has fully satisfied their pharmacy deductible for the benefit year. True when deductible applied equals or exceeds deductible maximum.

tag_set.value: Member Oop Accumulator Deductible Met Flag

attributes.name: deductible_remaining_amt
attributes.description: Dollar amount remaining before the member satisfies their pharmacy deductible for the benefit year. Equals deductible maximum minus deductible applied.

attributes.name: dir_adjustment_amt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) Adjustment Amount
attributes.description: Year-to-date DIR fee adjustments applied post-adjudication that may affect the member's effective OOP. Relevant for Medicare Part D DIR reconciliation.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D DIR; 42 CFR §423.308

tag_set.value: Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) Adjustment Amount

attributes.name: last_claim_date
attributes.description: The date of service of the most recent pharmacy claim that updated this accumulator record. Used to identify stale or inactive accumulator records.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Member Oop Accumulator Last Updated Timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this accumulator record, reflecting the latest claim adjudication or adjustment that modified accumulator balances.

tag_set.value: Member Oop Accumulator Last Updated Timestamp

attributes.name: mbi
attributes.description: The CMS-assigned Medicare Beneficiary Identifier for the member. Required for Medicare Part D TrOOP reporting and CMS coordination of benefits.

attributes.name: medicare_part_d_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Member Oop Accumulator Medicare Part D Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accumulator record applies to a Medicare Part D member, enabling TrOOP tracking and CMS catastrophic coverage threshold logic.

tag_set.value: Member Oop Accumulator Medicare Part D Flag

attributes.name: oop_applied_amt

attributes.name: oop_maximum_amt
attributes.description: The plan-defined maximum out-of-pocket threshold for this member's benefit plan and year. Once reached, the plan covers 100% of eligible costs.

attributes.name: oop_met_date
attributes.description: The date on which the member reached their pharmacy out-of-pocket maximum for the benefit year. Null if OOP maximum has not yet been reached.

attributes.name: oop_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has reached their pharmacy out-of-pocket maximum for the benefit year. True when OOP applied equals or exceeds OOP maximum.

attributes.name: oop_remaining_amt
attributes.description: Dollar amount remaining before the member reaches their pharmacy out-of-pocket maximum for the benefit year. Equals OOP maximum minus OOP applied.

attributes.name: other_payer_applied_amt
attributes.description: Year-to-date amounts paid by other payers (secondary insurance, SPAP, Medicaid) that reduce the member's OOP liability. Relevant for coordination of benefits.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; CMS COB rules

attributes.name: pbm_member_identifier
attributes.description: The member identifier as assigned by the PBM source system. Used for cross-PBM reconciliation and Member 360 identity resolution.

attributes.name: rds_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is enrolled in a Retiree Drug Subsidy plan. Affects accumulator reporting requirements and CMS subsidy calculations.
attributes.references: CMS RDS Program; 42 CFR §423 Subpart R

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of reconciliation between PBM-reported accumulator balances and PillarRx-calculated balances from claim-level data. Supports PBM audit workflows.
attributes.references: Internal PillarRx Data Standard; ERISA audit requirements

attributes.name: reconciliation_variance_amt
attributes.description: Dollar difference between PBM-reported OOP accumulator balance and PillarRx-calculated balance. Non-zero values trigger PBM audit review.
attributes.references: Internal PillarRx Data Standard; ERISA audit requirements

attributes.name: spap_applied_amt
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program (SPAP) Applied Amount
attributes.description: Year-to-date dollar amount applied by a State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program on behalf of the member. Tracked separately for TrOOP and COB analysis.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D; State SPAP regulations

tag_set.value: State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program (SPAP) Applied Amount

attributes.business_glossary_term: Member Oop Accumulator To Benefit Group
attributes.description: FK to claim.benefit_group.benefit_group_id — Accumulator is scoped to benefit group for MOOP/deductible rules; FK needed for breach detection.

tag_set.value: Member Oop Accumulator To Benefit Group

attributes.name: troop_remaining_amt
attributes.description: Dollar amount remaining before the Medicare Part D member reaches the catastrophic coverage threshold. Null for non-Medicare members.

attributes.name: troop_threshold_amt
attributes.description: The CMS-defined TrOOP threshold for the benefit year at which Medicare Part D catastrophic coverage begins. Updated annually by CMS.

products.name: dur_event
products.description: Drug Utilization Review (DUR) event record generated at the point of adjudication for a pharmacy claim. Captures the DUR service reason code (e.g., drug-drug interaction, duplicate therapy, high dose), DUR result code (e.g., dispensed as is, prescription
products.reference: NCPDP DUR Segment / CMS DUR Standards

attributes.name: dur_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Drug Utilization Review (DUR) event record generated at the point of pharmacy claim adjudication.

attributes.name: claim_prescriber_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.prescriber. Business justification: DUR events are triggered by prescriber actions at the point of adjudication. Currently dur_event has prescriber_npi as a string; adding prescriber_id FK allows joining to the full prescriber

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM that adjudicated the claim and generated this DUR event (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts).

attributes.name: dur_rx_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent pharmacy claim transaction that triggered this DUR event. Links the DUR event to its originating fill, reversal, or adjustment.

attributes.name: employer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employer client whose plan member triggered this DUR event. Supports multi-tenant client-level DUR analytics within the Company > Division > Client hierarchy.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the member (patient) whose prescription triggered this DUR event. Supports Member 360 cross-PBM analysis.

attributes.name: dispensed_ndc_code
attributes.description: Reference to the drug (by NDC) dispensed on the claim that triggered this DUR event. Links to the drug reference dimension.

attributes.name: pbm_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.pbm_assignment. Business justification: DUR events (drug utilization review alerts) are adjudicated by the PBM at point-of-sale.

attributes.name: pbm_division_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to division.division. Business justification: DUR events must be attributed to division for division-specific clinical program reporting, PBM contract compliance measurement (clinical intervention rates), and consulting deliverables.

attributes.name: pbm_feed_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.pbm_feed_batch. Business justification: DUR events are ingested via PBM feed batches. Strong traceability requirement for audit and data quality validation.

attributes.name: ncpdp_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dispensing Pharmacy National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) ID
attributes.description: 7-digit NCPDP identifier of the pharmacy that dispensed the prescription and submitted the DUR event. Used for pharmacy-level DUR trend analysis.

tag_set.value: Dispensing Pharmacy National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) ID

attributes.name: prior_auth_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.prior_auth. Business justification: DUR events may be triggered by prior authorization requirements or conflicts. Currently dur_event has prior_auth_number as a string; adding prior_auth_id FK allows joining to the full

attributes.name: rx_claim_id
attributes.description: FK to claim.rx_claim.rx_claim_id — Each DUR event is generated at adjudication of a specific claim; description states 'linked to a specific rx_claim' but the FK must be guaranteed.

attributes.name: to_rx_claim_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dur Event To Rx Claim Id
attributes.description: FK to claim.rx_claim.rx_claim_id — Each DUR event is generated for a specific claim at adjudication; parent FK required for clinical safety analysis joins.

tag_set.value: Dur Event To Rx Claim Id

attributes.name: adjudication_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the pharmacy claim was adjudicated by the PBM and this DUR event was generated. Represents the principal real-world event time for this record.

attributes.name: alert_category
attributes.description: Broad clinical category of the DUR alert for analytics grouping (e.g., drug_interaction, duplicate_therapy, dosing, allergy, age_precaution, pregnancy, renal, hepatic).
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; CMS DUR Program

attributes.name: alert_sequence_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Alert Sequence Number
attributes.description: Sequential number identifying the order of this DUR alert within the claim adjudication transaction when multiple DUR events are generated for a single claim.

tag_set.value: Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Alert Sequence Number

attributes.name: alert_status
attributes.description: Current disposition of the DUR alert: triggered (alert fired, no action yet), overridden (pharmacist bypassed), resolved (clinical action taken), or not_filled (prescription rejected).

attributes.name: clinical_significance_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Clinical Significance Code
attributes.description: Numeric code from the drug reference source (Medi-Span or FDB) indicating the clinical significance of the interaction or alert (1=most significant to 5=least significant).

tag_set.value: Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Clinical Significance Code

attributes.name: coagent_id_qualifier
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Co-Agent ID Qualifier
attributes.description: Qualifier indicating the coding system used for the co-agent drug identifier (e.g., ND=NDC, UP=UPC, GC=GPI Code, HC=HCPCS). Identifies the type of the interacting drug.

tag_set.value: Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Co-Agent ID Qualifier

attributes.name: coagent_ndc
attributes.description: 11-digit NDC of the co-agent (interacting or duplicate) drug when the DUR service reason involves a second drug. Normalized from coagent_id when qualifier is ND.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Standard; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard

attributes.name: days_supply
attributes.description: Number of days of drug therapy supplied on the claim that triggered this DUR event. Relevant for duplicate therapy and refill-too-soon DUR alerts.

attributes.name: dos
attributes.description: Date the prescription was dispensed (date of service) for the claim that generated this DUR event. Used for temporal DUR trend analysis.

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: Brand or generic name of the dispensed drug that triggered the DUR event. Denormalized from drug reference for reporting convenience.

attributes.name: drug_reference_source
attributes.description: The drug reference database used by the PBM to generate this DUR alert (e.g., medi_span=Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span, fdb=First DataBank, pbm_proprietary=PBM internal rules).

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of when the DUR review occurred relative to dispensing: prospective (at point of sale), concurrent (during therapy), or retrospective (post-dispensing claims analysis).

attributes.name: formulary_tier
attributes.description: The formulary tier of the dispensed drug at the time of the DUR event (e.g., Tier 1 generic, Tier 2 preferred brand). Relevant for DUR events involving formulary-based clinical edits.
attributes.references: PillarRx Drug Reference and Formulary Analysis

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this DUR event record was first loaded into the PillarRx data lakehouse from the PBM claims feed. Audit timestamp for data pipeline tracking.
attributes.references: PillarRx Enterprise Data Warehouse / Analytics Lakehouse

attributes.name: is_high_risk
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is High Risk Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Alert Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DUR event is classified as high-risk based on severity_code or clinical_significance_code thresholds. Used for clinical safety reporting and PBM audit.
attributes.references: CMS DUR Program Requirements; Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span

tag_set.value: Is High Risk Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Alert Flag

attributes.name: is_overridden
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Alert Overridden Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacist overrode the DUR alert and dispensed the prescription despite the clinical warning. True when override_code is present and alert was bypassed.

tag_set.value: Is Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Alert Overridden Flag

attributes.name: level_of_effort_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Level of Effort Code
attributes.description: NCPDP code indicating the pharmacist's professional effort required to resolve the DUR alert (1=lowest to 5=highest). Used for MTM billing and audit purposes.

tag_set.value: Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Level of Effort Code

attributes.name: ndc
attributes.description: 11-digit FDA National Drug Code of the dispensed drug that triggered the DUR alert. Primary drug identifier on the claim.

attributes.name: normalized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DUR event record has been normalized and standardized by the PillarRx ETL pipeline from the raw PBM source feed into the Silver layer schema.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: override_code
attributes.description: Code submitted by the pharmacist to override a DUR alert and proceed with dispensing (e.g., prescriber authorization, patient acknowledgment). Populated when alert_status is overridden.

attributes.name: pbm_claim_number
attributes.description: The PBM-assigned claim number from the source adjudication system that this DUR event is associated with. Used for cross-referencing back to the originating PBM feed.

attributes.name: pbm_member_identifier
attributes.description: The PBM-assigned member identifier as received in the source claims feed. Retained for cross-PBM reconciliation and Member 360 identity resolution.

attributes.name: professional_service_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Professional Service Code
attributes.description: NCPDP code for the professional service rendered by the pharmacist in response to the DUR alert (e.g., AS=patient assessment, CC=coordination of care, DE=dosing evaluation).

tag_set.value: Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Professional Service Code

attributes.name: quantity_dispensed
attributes.description: The quantity of the drug dispensed on the claim that triggered this DUR event. Used in dosing-related DUR analysis (e.g., high dose alerts, quantity limit edits).

attributes.name: result_code
attributes.description: NCPDP-standard code indicating the pharmacist's action taken in response to the DUR alert (e.g., 1A=filled as is, 1B=filled with prescriber approval, 1C=not filled).

attributes.name: result_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the DUR result code (e.g., 'Filled Prescription As Is', 'Filled With Prescriber Approval', 'Prescription Not Filled').

attributes.name: service_reason_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Service Reason Code
attributes.description: NCPDP-standard code identifying the clinical reason the DUR alert was triggered (e.g., DD=drug-drug interaction, TD=duplicate therapy, HD=high dose, PA=drug-age precaution).

tag_set.value: Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Service Reason Code

attributes.name: service_reason_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Service Reason Description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the DUR service reason code (e.g., 'Drug-Drug Interaction', 'Duplicate Therapy', 'High Dose Alert'). Sourced from NCPDP code set.

tag_set.value: Drug Utilization Review (DUR) Service Reason Description

attributes.name: severity_code
attributes.description: Clinical severity level of the DUR alert as assigned by the drug reference source (1=contraindicated, 2=severe, 3=moderate, 4=minor). Sourced from Medi-Span or FDB drug interaction database.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this DUR event record was last modified in the lakehouse (e.g., due to a claim adjustment or data correction from the PBM feed).
attributes.references: PillarRx Enterprise Data Warehouse / Analytics Lakehouse

attributes.name: prior_auth_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the prior authorization record in the PillarRx lakehouse. Primary key for the prior_auth entity.

attributes.name: claim_prescriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prescribing provider (NPI-keyed) who initiated or is associated with the prior authorization request.

attributes.name: company_client_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to company.company_client. Business justification: Prior authorization analysis is a core consulting service requiring client attribution for PA approval rate reporting, turnaround time benchmarking, and denial reason analysis by

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts) that adjudicated or managed this prior authorization.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the member (patient) for whom the prior authorization was requested. Supports Member 360 cross-PBM analysis.

attributes.name: pbm_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.pbm_assignment. Business justification: Prior authorizations are adjudicated by specific PBM assignments (employer-PBM contract context).

attributes.name: pbm_division_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to division.division. Business justification: Prior auths must be scoped to division for division-specific formulary enforcement, clinical program tracking, and PBM contract compliance measurement (PA turnaround times, approval rates).

attributes.name: prior_rx_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmacy claim transaction this prior authorization is associated with. Links PA records to the adjudicated fill event.

attributes.name: rx_claim_id
attributes.description: FK to claim.rx_claim.rx_claim_id — PA is linked to the rx_claim when a PA number is present on the claim; required for denial-rate benchmarking tied to actual fills.

attributes.name: to_rx_claim_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Auth To Rx Claim Id
attributes.description: FK to claim.rx_claim.rx_claim_id — PA records link to rx_claim when a PA number is present; FK needed for PA denial-rate benchmarking against claims.

tag_set.value: Prior Auth To Rx Claim Id

attributes.name: appeal_number
attributes.description: The reference number assigned to a PA appeal submission. Populated only when pa_type is appeal. Links the appeal to the original denied PA for audit tracking.

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: The result of the PA appeal review. Upheld means the original denial stands; overturned means the drug is approved on appeal. Null when no appeal was filed.

attributes.name: approved_days_supply
attributes.description: The number of days supply of medication approved under this PA. Constrains the dispensing window and refill eligibility at the pharmacy.

attributes.name: approved_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of drug units (e.g., tablets, milliliters) approved under this PA. Claims exceeding this quantity will reject at adjudication.

attributes.name: approved_refills
attributes.description: The number of refills authorized under this PA approval. A value of zero indicates the initial fill only; null indicates no refill restriction was specified.

attributes.name: clinical_criteria_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the submitted clinical documentation satisfied the PBM or plan clinical criteria for approval. Populated from the PA decision record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this prior authorization record was first loaded into the PillarRx lakehouse. Used for data lineage, audit, and incremental ETL processing.

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: The date the PBM or plan issued the approval, denial, or other determination on the PA request. Used to calculate decision turnaround time.

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason a PA request was denied (e.g., not medically necessary, step therapy required, non-formulary). Null when status is not denied.
attributes.references: NCPDP Reject Code List; CMS Prior Authorization Policy

attributes.name: denial_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text or standardized narrative explanation of the denial reason provided by the PBM or plan. Supports member appeal and consulting audit workflows.

attributes.name: diagnosis_code
attributes.description: The ICD-10-CM diagnosis code submitted with the PA request to support medical necessity. PHI — restricted access. Null if not provided by the PBM source.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the prior authorization approval becomes valid and claims may be adjudicated against it.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the prior authorization approval expires. Claims submitted after this date will reject unless a renewal PA is obtained.

attributes.name: formulary_tier
attributes.description: The formulary cost-sharing tier of the drug subject to this PA at the time of the request. Used to assess whether PA is driven by tier placement or clinical criteria.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Requirements; PillarRx Drug Reference

attributes.name: is_340b_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug and dispensing context associated with this PA may qualify under the federal 340B drug discount program. Supports 340B compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: HRSA 340B Drug Pricing Program; PHS Act §340B

attributes.name: is_specialty_drug
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug subject to this PA is classified as a specialty medication (SMN). Specialty PAs typically have distinct clinical criteria and turnaround requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Specialty Tier Policy; PillarRx Specialty Pharmacy Analytics

attributes.name: ndc
attributes.description: The 11-digit FDA National Drug Code identifying the specific drug product subject to this PA. Stored as the normalized 11-digit format (5-4-2 segments, no hyphens).
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; HIPAA Transaction Standard

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or supplemental information captured during PA review, appeal, or consulting analysis. May include clinical rationale or PBM communication details.

attributes.name: pa_number
attributes.description: The externally-assigned prior authorization number issued by the PBM or health plan. Used for claim adjudication routing and audit reconciliation.

attributes.name: pa_source

attributes.description: Annual maximum out-of-pocket amount in USD for an individual member under this benefit group. Once reached, the plan covers 100% of eligible pharmacy costs. Key for MOOP analysis.

attributes.name: integrated_deductible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy deductible is integrated with the medical deductible (combined accumulator) or is a separate pharmacy-only deductible. Affects total cost of care analysis.

attributes.name: integrated_oop
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy out-of-pocket maximum is integrated with the medical out-of-pocket maximum (combined MOOP) or is pharmacy-only. Critical for total cost of care (TCOC) reporting.

attributes.name: mail_order_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether mail-order pharmacy dispensing is an eligible benefit channel under this benefit group. Drives channel-based cost-sharing and dispensing fee analysis.

attributes.name: mail_order_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether mail-order dispensing is mandatory for maintenance medications after a defined number of retail fills. Affects member cost-sharing and GDR reporting.

attributes.name: member_count
attributes.description: Number of members currently enrolled in this benefit group as of the most recent eligibility file. Used for Per Member Per Month (PMPM) and Per Member Per Year (PMPY) denominator calculations.

attributes.name: pass_through_pricing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit group operates under a pass-through (transparent) PBM pricing model where the plan pays actual drug cost plus a dispensing fee, with no spread retained by the PBM.

attributes.name: pbm_source_group_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Claim Benefit Group Pbm Source Group Name
attributes.description: The raw benefit group name as received from the PBM claims feed prior to normalization. Preserved for audit traceability and cross-PBM benchmarking.
attributes.references: Internal PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

tag_set.value: Claim Benefit Group Pbm Source Group Name

attributes.name: plan_year_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Claim Benefit Group Plan Year End Date
attributes.description: The last day of the benefit plan year associated with this benefit group. Marks the boundary for annual deductible and out-of-pocket maximum accumulation periods.

tag_set.value: Claim Benefit Group Plan Year End Date

attributes.name: plan_year_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Claim Benefit Group Plan Year Start Date
attributes.description: The first day of the benefit plan year associated with this benefit group. Drives deductible and out-of-pocket accumulator resets for member cost-sharing calculations.

tag_set.value: Claim Benefit Group Plan Year Start Date

attributes.name: prior_auth_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization (PA) is required for any drug classes under this benefit group. Flags benefit groups for PA utilization management analysis.

attributes.name: quantity_limit_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether quantity limits (QL) are enforced on covered drugs under this benefit group. Drives utilization management and quantity limit exception analysis.

attributes.name: rds_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit group qualifies for the CMS Retiree Drug Subsidy (RDS) program, applicable to employer-sponsored retiree pharmacy benefits.

attributes.name: rebate_passthrough_pct
attributes.description: Contractual percentage of manufacturer rebates passed through to the employer plan under this benefit group. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0000 = 100%). Used in PBM rebate guarantee auditing.
attributes.references: Internal PillarRx PBM Contract Audit, ERISA

attributes.name: rx_bin
attributes.description: Six-digit Bank Identification Number used to route pharmacy claims to the correct PBM processor. Printed on member ID cards and transmitted in NCPDP claim transactions.

attributes.name: rx_group
attributes.description: The RxGroup identifier transmitted on pharmacy claim transactions for routing and adjudication by the PBM. Directly corresponds to the Group ID field in NCPDP claim transactions.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard, NCPDP Telecommunication Standard

attributes.name: rx_pcn
attributes.description: Processor Control Number used alongside RxBIN to route pharmacy claims to the correct PBM sub-processor or plan. Transmitted in NCPDP claim transactions and printed on member ID cards.

attributes.name: specialty_benefit_type
attributes.description: Indicates how specialty medications are covered under this benefit group — included in standard formulary, excluded, or administered under a separate specialty benefit carve-out.

attributes.name: step_therapy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether step therapy (ST) protocols are enforced under this benefit group, requiring members to try lower-cost alternatives before coverage of preferred agents.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which this benefit group design ceases to be binding. Null for open-ended active groups. Used for Type-2 SCD history tracking in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: three_forty_b_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether claims under this benefit group may be subject to 340B federal drug discount pricing. Relevant for covered entity clients and manufacturer program analysis.
attributes.references: HRSA 340B Program, Public Health Service Act Section 340B

attributes.name: tier_count
attributes.description: Number of formulary cost-sharing tiers defined in this benefit group (e.g., 3 for generic/preferred brand/non-preferred, 4 for specialty tier). Drives tier-level copay analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit group record was last modified in the PillarRx data platform. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: client_benefit_group_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Claim Benefit Group Client Benefit Group Id
attributes.description: Identifier referencing the related client benefit group id for the claim benefit group record in the claim domain.

tag_set.value: Claim Benefit Group Client Benefit Group Id

products.name: adjustment
products.description: Adjustment and reversal transaction record that modifies or cancels a previously adjudicated pharmacy claim. Captures the original rx_claim reference, adjustment type (reversal, rebill, correction), adjustment reason code, adjustment date, the financial

attributes.name: adjustment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the pharmacy claim adjustment or reversal record in the Pillarrx lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: adjustment_original_rx_claim_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Adjustment Adjustment Original Rx Claim Id
attributes.description: FK to claim.rx_claim.rx_claim_id — Adjustment/reversal references the original adjudicated claim it modifies; required for lifecycle audit trail.

tag_set.value: Adjustment Adjustment Original Rx Claim Id

attributes.name: adjustment_rx_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original pharmacy claim transaction that this adjustment, reversal, or rebill modifies. Core linkage to the parent claim fact.

attributes.name: claim_benefit_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.claim_benefit_group. Business justification: Adjustments are processed under a specific benefit group context (same as the original claim).

attributes.name: company_client_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to company.company_client. Business justification: Adjustments must be attributed to specific clients for accurate financial reconciliation, audit reporting, and consulting analysis of claim corrections.

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts) that processed the original claim and submitted this adjustment transaction.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the member (patient) associated with the adjusted claim. Supports Member 360 cross-PBM analytics and member-level financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: pbm_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.pbm_assignment. Business justification: Adjustments (reversals, rebills, DIR fees) are PBM-specific and must be reconciled against the employer's PBM assignment contract terms.

attributes.name: pbm_division_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to division.division. Business justification: Adjustments must be tracked at division level for accurate PBM guarantee calculations (AWP discount, dispensing fee, rebate guarantees) and division-specific financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: pbm_feed_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.pbm_feed_batch. Business justification: Adjustments are ingested via PBM feed batches. Every adjustment should be traceable to its ingestion batch for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: primary_rx_claim_id
attributes.description: FK to claim.rx_claim.rx_claim_id — Adjustment/reversal records reference the original rx_claim; the lifecycle audit trail is meaningless without this parent FK.

attributes.name: to_rx_claim_id
attributes.description: FK to claim.rx_claim.rx_claim_id — Adjustment/reversal records reference an original rx_claim; FK needed for lifecycle audit trail and DIR reconciliation.

attributes.name: adjustment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the adjustment or reversal transaction was processed or submitted by the PBM. Principal business event date for financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: adjustment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the adjustment transaction: pending (received, not yet applied), processed (applied to financials), rejected (denied by PBM), or voided (cancelled before processing).

attributes.name: adjustment_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the transaction: reversal (claim cancellation), rebill (resubmission after reversal), correction (financial correction), or general adjustment.

attributes.name: awp_adj
attributes.description: The delta change to the AWP-based pricing component resulting from this adjustment. Used in AWP discount guarantee auditing and PBM contract reconciliation.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span / First DataBank (FDB) AWP Standard

attributes.name: daw_code
attributes.description: The DAW code from the original claim indicating brand/generic dispensing instruction (0=no product selection, 1=substitution not allowed by prescriber, 2=substitution by patient, etc.).

attributes.name: days_supply
attributes.description: The number of days of medication supply dispensed on the original claim. Retained on the adjustment for PMPM/PMPY trend analysis and days-supply-based pricing reconciliation.

attributes.name: deductible_adj
attributes.description: The delta change to the deductible amount applied on the original claim resulting from this adjustment. Critical for accurate member deductible accumulator reconciliation.

attributes.name: dir_fee_adj
attributes.business_glossary_term: Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) Fee Adjustment Amount
attributes.description: The delta change to the DIR fee component applied via this adjustment. DIR fees are post-adjudication pharmacy clawbacks; tracking adjustments is essential for PBM audit and spread analysis.

tag_set.value: Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) Fee Adjustment Amount

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_adj
attributes.description: The delta change to the pharmacy dispensing fee resulting from this adjustment. Used in PBM dispensing-fee guarantee auditing and contract reconciliation.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard — Dispensing Fee Submitted

attributes.name: fill_number
attributes.description: The sequential fill number (refill count) of the original prescription being adjusted. Fill 0 = new prescription; Fill 1+ = refills. Used to identify which dispensing event is impacted.

attributes.name: ingested_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this adjustment record was first loaded into the Pillarrx lakehouse silver layer from the PBM claims feed. Used for data freshness monitoring and ETL audit.
attributes.references: Pillarrx Enterprise Data Warehouse / Analytics Lakehouse Standard

attributes.name: ingredient_cost_adj
attributes.description: The delta change to ingredient cost resulting from this adjustment. Negative for reversals; positive for upward corrections. Core financial component for PBM audit and benchmarking.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard — Ingredient Cost Submitted

attributes.name: is_rebill
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment record represents a rebill (resubmission of a previously reversed claim with corrected data). True = rebill transaction following a reversal.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard — Transaction Code B3

attributes.name: is_reversal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment record represents a full claim reversal (cancellation) as opposed to a partial financial correction or rebill. True = full reversal.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard — Transaction Code B1/B2/B3

attributes.name: member_coinsurance_adj
attributes.description: The delta change to the member coinsurance (percentage cost-share) resulting from this adjustment. Supports member OOP reconciliation and benefit design analysis.

attributes.name: member_copay_adj
attributes.description: The delta change to the member copay (fixed cost-share) resulting from this adjustment. Used for member out-of-pocket reconciliation and copay assistance program (CAP) impact analysis.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard — Patient Pay Amount

attributes.name: oop_adj
attributes.description: The delta change to the member out-of-pocket (OOP) accumulator applied on the original claim. Used to reconcile member MOOP and TrOOP accumulators after adjustment.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard — Other Amount Claimed

attributes.name: original_dos
attributes.description: The date of service (DOS) from the original pharmacy claim being adjusted. Retained on the adjustment record for period-accurate financial reporting and audit trail.

attributes.name: original_fill_date
attributes.description: The dispensing date of the original prescription fill that is being adjusted or reversed. Used to attribute the financial impact to the correct dispensing period.

attributes.name: other_payer_adj
attributes.description: The delta change to the other payer amount (e.g., SPAP, manufacturer copay card, secondary insurance) resulting from this adjustment. Supports coordination of benefits reconciliation.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard — Other Payer Amount Paid

attributes.name: pbm_adjustment_number
attributes.description: The externally-assigned transaction number or reference code assigned by the PBM to uniquely identify this adjustment or reversal event within the PBM system.

attributes.name: pbm_claim_number
attributes.description: The PBM-assigned claim number of the original adjudicated claim being adjusted or reversed. Used to trace the adjustment back to the source transaction in PBM systems.

attributes.name: pbm_response_code
attributes.description: The response or disposition code returned by the PBM upon processing the adjustment transaction (e.g., approved, rejected with reason). Used for adjustment reconciliation and exception management.

attributes.name: pbm_response_message
attributes.description: Free-text message returned by the PBM alongside the response code, providing additional context on the adjustment outcome (e.g., rejection reason narrative).

attributes.name: plan_paid_adj
attributes.description: The delta change to the plan-paid amount resulting from this adjustment. Negative for reversals recovering plan funds; positive for underpayment corrections. Key for client financial reporting.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard — Plan Paid Amount

attributes.name: quantity_dispensed
attributes.description: The quantity of drug dispensed on the original claim being adjusted, expressed in the drug's billing unit (e.g., tablets, mL). Retained for unit-cost recalculation during adjustment analysis.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code provided by the PBM indicating the reason for the adjustment or reversal (e.g., pricing correction, eligibility change, duplicate claim, DIR fee). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the adjustment reason, either sourced from the PBM feed or mapped from the adjustment_reason_code during normalization.

attributes.name: rebate_adj
attributes.description: The delta change to the manufacturer rebate amount associated with the original claim resulting from this adjustment. Used in rebate reconciliation and pass-through PBM contract auditing.
attributes.references: ERISA Plan Governance; CMS Rebate Reporting

attributes.name: rx_number
attributes.description: The pharmacy-assigned prescription number from the original fill being adjusted. Provides a human-readable cross-reference to the dispensing pharmacy's dispensing record.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the adjustment transaction was processed by the PBM system. Provides sub-day precision for sequencing multiple adjustments on the same claim.

attributes.name: total_cost_adj
attributes.description: The net total dollar change across all financial components (ingredient cost + dispensing fee + other fees) resulting from this adjustment. Used for client-level financial impact reporting.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard — Total Amount Paid

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this adjustment record was last modified in the lakehouse (e.g., due to a reprocessing or correction of the normalized record). Supports audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: Pillarrx Enterprise Data Warehouse / Analytics Lakehouse Standard

products.name: medical_claim
products.description: Integrated medical claim record ingested from the medical claims feed for total cost of care (TCOC) analysis. Captures the medical claim number, member identifier, date of service, diagnosis codes (ICD-10), procedure codes (CPT/HCPCS), place of service

attributes.name: medical_claim_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the medical claim record in the Pillarrx lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA Transaction and Code Sets (45 CFR Part 162)

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employer benefit plan under which this medical claim was adjudicated. Links to plan design for cost-sharing rule context.

attributes.name: employer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employer client whose health plan covers this medical claim, supporting multi-tenant Company > Division > Client scoping.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the member (patient) associated with this medical claim, linking to the unified Member 360 record.

attributes.name: pbm_division_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to division.division. Business justification: Medical claims required for total cost of care (TCOC) analysis at division level. Multi-division clients often have separate medical/pharmacy benefit designs.

attributes.name: admit_date
attributes.description: Date of inpatient admission for institutional claims. Null for professional/outpatient claims. Used for length-of-stay and inpatient cost analysis.
attributes.references: HIPAA X12 837I Transaction Set; CMS UB-04

attributes.name: allowed_amount
attributes.description: Maximum amount the payer will consider for reimbursement after applying contractual fee schedules. Basis for plan-paid and member cost-share calculations.

attributes.name: billed_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount billed by the provider before any contractual adjustments, discounts, or member cost-sharing. Basis for discount analysis.

attributes.name: billing_provider_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit NPI of the entity submitting the claim for payment (may differ from rendering provider for group practices or facilities).
attributes.references: NPPES; HIPAA NPI Final Rule (45 CFR Part 162)

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned claim number from the medical payer or clearinghouse. Primary business identifier used for audit, reconciliation, and TCOC analysis.

attributes.name: claim_source
attributes.description: Name or code of the medical claims integration feed or payer source from which this claim was ingested (e.g., carrier name, clearinghouse identifier).

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current processing lifecycle status of the medical claim as received from the medical claims integration feed.

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Classification of the medical claim by form type: professional (CMS-1500 / 837P) or institutional (UB-04 / 837I).

attributes.name: discharge_date
attributes.description: Date of inpatient discharge for institutional claims. Used with admit_date to calculate length of stay for inpatient benchmarking.
attributes.references: HIPAA X12 837I Transaction Set; CMS UB-04

attributes.name: discharge_status_code
attributes.description: UB-04 patient discharge status code indicating disposition at discharge (e.g., 01=Home, 20=Expired, 30=Still Patient). Used for readmission and outcomes analysis.
attributes.references: NUBC UB-04 Discharge Status Code Set; CMS

attributes.name: drg_code
attributes.description: CMS Diagnosis Related Group code assigned to inpatient institutional claims for prospective payment classification and benchmarking.

attributes.name: ingested_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this medical claim record was first captured and loaded into the Pillarrx lakehouse silver layer from the medical claims integration feed.

attributes.name: is_specialty_claim
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this medical claim is associated with a specialty condition or high-cost specialty service. Supports specialty spend monitoring.
attributes.references: Pillarrx Specialty Pharmacy Spend Monitoring Program

attributes.name: member_coinsurance_amount
attributes.description: Percentage-based cost-share amount paid by the member after the deductible is met. Contributes to member out-of-pocket accumulation.

attributes.name: member_copay_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar copay amount paid by the member at the point of service. Contributes to member out-of-pocket accumulation.

attributes.name: member_deductible_amount
attributes.description: Amount applied to the member's deductible accumulator for this claim. Tracks member spend toward annual deductible threshold.

attributes.name: member_oop_amount
attributes.description: Total out-of-pocket amount paid by the member for this claim (copay + coinsurance + deductible). Used for MOOP tracking and affordability analysis.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302; HIPAA X12 835 Transaction Set

attributes.name: network_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rendering provider was in-network or out-of-network at the time of service. Drives cost-sharing tier and benchmarking segmentation.

attributes.name: not_covered_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the billed amount not covered by the plan (non-covered services, benefit exclusions). Supports benefit gap and plan design analysis.

attributes.name: other_payer_amount
attributes.description: Amount paid by a secondary or tertiary payer (e.g., Medicare, Medicaid, SPAP, COB payer). Used for coordination of benefits and TCOC reconciliation.
attributes.references: HIPAA X12 837 COB Segment; CMS COB Guidelines

attributes.name: paid_date
attributes.description: Date the medical payer adjudicated and issued payment for this claim. Used for cash-flow and TCOC period alignment.

attributes.name: payer_claim_number
attributes.description: Unique claim identifier assigned by the medical payer upon adjudication. Used for cross-referencing with payer EOBs and audit reconciliation.

attributes.name: payer_name
attributes.description: Name of the medical insurance carrier or payer that adjudicated this claim. Supports multi-payer TCOC aggregation for employer clients.

attributes.name: place_of_service_code
attributes.description: CMS two-digit code indicating the setting where the medical service was rendered (e.g., 11=Office, 21=Inpatient Hospital, 23=Emergency Room).
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Code Set

attributes.name: plan_paid_amount
attributes.description: Amount paid by the employer health plan after member cost-sharing is applied. Core TCOC metric for employer spend analysis.

attributes.name: primary_diagnosis_code
attributes.description: ICD-10-CM code for the primary diagnosis associated with this medical claim. Core clinical dimension for TCOC and disease-burden analysis.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM (CMS / WHO); HIPAA Transaction and Code Sets (45 CFR Part 162)

attributes.name: procedure_code
attributes.description: CPT or HCPCS Level II procedure code identifying the medical service or supply billed. Primary clinical service identifier for TCOC analysis.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Code Set; CMS HCPCS Level II; HIPAA Transaction and Code Sets (45 CFR Part 162)

attributes.name: procedure_modifier
attributes.description: Two-character CPT/HCPCS modifier appended to the procedure code to indicate special circumstances (e.g., bilateral, assistant surgeon, telehealth).
attributes.references: AMA CPT Code Set; CMS HCPCS Level II

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date the medical claim was received by the payer or clearinghouse. Used for turnaround-time and audit lag analysis.

attributes.name: rendering_provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the provider who rendered the medical service, as reported on the claim. Supports provider-level reporting without requiring NPI lookup.

attributes.name: rendering_provider_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit NPI of the provider who rendered the medical service. Sourced from NPPES. Used for provider-level TCOC and specialty analysis.
attributes.references: NPPES (National Plan and Provider Enumeration System); HIPAA NPI Final Rule (45 CFR Part 162)

attributes.name: rendering_provider_specialty
attributes.description: Medical specialty taxonomy code or description for the rendering provider. Used for specialty-level TCOC segmentation and benchmarking.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: revenue_code
attributes.description: Four-digit UB-04 revenue code used on institutional claims to identify the type of service or accommodation billed by the facility.
attributes.references: NUBC UB-04 Revenue Code Set; HIPAA X12 837I Transaction Set

attributes.name: secondary_diagnosis_code
attributes.description: ICD-10-CM code for the secondary or comorbid diagnosis on this claim. Supports comorbidity analysis and total cost of care stratification.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM (CMS / WHO); HIPAA Transaction and Code Sets (45 CFR Part 162)

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: High-level category of the medical service for TCOC segmentation and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inpatient|outpatient|emergency|professional|mental_health|pharmacy|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Benefit Category Definitions; ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: The date on which the medical service was rendered. Primary event date used for TCOC trend analysis and period attribution.

attributes.name: service_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the service period for institutional claims spanning multiple days (e.g., inpatient stays). Equals service_date for single-day professional claims.

attributes.name: units_of_service
attributes.description: Quantity of services, procedures, or days billed on this claim line. Used for unit-cost normalization in benchmarking and TCOC analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this medical claim record in the lakehouse, reflecting adjustments, status changes, or data corrections.
attributes.references: Pillarrx Enterprise Data Warehouse / Analytics Lakehouse

products.name: pbm_feed_batch

attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each PBM feed batch ingestion record within the PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform.

attributes.name: claim_pbm_id

attributes.name: pbm_sender_company_pbm_id

attributes.name: actual_record_count

attributes.name: checksum_algorithm

attributes.name: client_scope

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: delivery_method

attributes.name: expected_record_count

attributes.name: feed_file_name

attributes.name: feed_file_path

attributes.name: feed_format
