attributes.name: feed_frequency
attributes.description: Expected delivery cadence for this PBM feed as contracted (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly). Used to detect missing or late file deliveries and trigger SLA alerts.

attributes.name: feed_type
attributes.description: Classification of the data content delivered in this batch. Distinguishes pharmacy claims feeds from eligibility, formulary, rebate, prior authorization, or medical claims feeds.

attributes.name: file_checksum
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash (e.g., MD5 or SHA-256) of the received feed file used to verify file integrity and detect corruption or tampering during transmission.

attributes.name: file_size_bytes
attributes.description: Size of the received PBM feed file in bytes. Used for transmission completeness checks and storage capacity planning in the ingestion platform.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: fill_count
attributes.description: Number of original prescription fill transactions (claim type = fill) contained in this feed batch. Used for volume trending and PBM audit reconciliation.

attributes.name: ingestion_environment
attributes.description: Target environment into which this feed batch was ingested (Production, UAT, Dev, Sandbox). Prevents test data from contaminating production analytics.

attributes.name: is_incremental
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch is an incremental (delta) feed containing only new or changed records since the last delivery, as opposed to a full historical reload.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: is_reprocessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch record represents a reprocessing of a previously received feed file (e.g., after a validation failure or data correction). Prevents duplicate loading.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes entered by the PillarRx data engineering team regarding this feed batch (e.g., late delivery explanation, PBM communication, manual override reason).
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: pbm_batch_reference
attributes.description: The PBM-assigned batch or transmission reference number included in the feed file header. Used for cross-referencing with the PBM's own transmission logs during audits.

attributes.name: pbm_code
attributes.description: Standardized short code identifying the PBM that delivered this feed batch. Used for routing, normalization, and source attribution in the ingestion pipeline.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: pbm_fk
attributes.description: FK to claim.pbm.pbm_id — Each ingestion batch is delivered by a specific PBM; FK needed for feed-completeness monitoring per source.

attributes.name: processed_record_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Feed Batch Processed Record Count
attributes.description: Number of claim records successfully parsed, normalized, and loaded into the Silver layer during ETL processing of this batch.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

tag_set.value: Pbm Feed Batch Processed Record Count

attributes.name: processing_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the ETL normalization pipeline completed processing this feed batch. Combined with processing_start_timestamp to compute pipeline duration.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: processing_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the ETL normalization pipeline began processing this feed batch. Used for ingestion SLA measurement and pipeline performance monitoring.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the PBM feed file was received and landed in the PillarRx ingestion platform. Serves as the authoritative business event timestamp for SLA tracking.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: rejected_record_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Feed Batch Rejected Record Count
attributes.description: Number of claim records that failed validation or normalization rules and were rejected during ETL processing. Drives data quality alerting and reprocessing workflows.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

tag_set.value: Pbm Feed Batch Rejected Record Count

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Feed Batch Reporting Period End Date
attributes.description: The latest date of service (DOS) covered by the claims data in this feed batch, as declared by the PBM. Defines the reporting window for client analytics.

tag_set.value: Pbm Feed Batch Reporting Period End Date

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Feed Batch Reporting Period Start Date
attributes.description: The earliest date of service (DOS) covered by the claims data in this feed batch, as declared by the PBM. Defines the reporting window for client analytics.

tag_set.value: Pbm Feed Batch Reporting Period Start Date

attributes.name: reversal_count
attributes.description: Number of claim reversal transactions contained in this feed batch. Reversals cancel previously adjudicated fills and affect net plan spend calculations.

attributes.name: to_pbm
attributes.description: FK to claim.pbm.pbm_id — Each ingestion batch is from one PBM source; FK needed for feed-completeness monitoring per PBM.

attributes.name: total_ingredient_cost_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Feed Batch Total Ingredient Cost Amount
attributes.description: Sum of ingredient cost amounts across all claim records in this feed batch. Ingredient cost is the drug acquisition cost component used in AWP discount and MAC analysis.

tag_set.value: Pbm Feed Batch Total Ingredient Cost Amount

attributes.name: total_member_cost_share_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Feed Batch Total Member Cost Share Amount
attributes.description: Sum of all member cost-share amounts (copay + coinsurance + deductible applied) across all claim records in this batch. Used for member OOP and MOOP reconciliation.

tag_set.value: Pbm Feed Batch Total Member Cost Share Amount

attributes.name: total_plan_paid_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Feed Batch Total Plan Paid Amount
attributes.description: Sum of plan-paid amounts across all claim records in this feed batch (net of reversals). Used for high-level financial reconciliation against PBM invoices and client reporting.

tag_set.value: Pbm Feed Batch Total Plan Paid Amount

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this pbm_feed_batch record was last modified (e.g., status update, reprocessing flag change). Supports change tracking and audit.

attributes.name: validation_error_summary
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Feed Batch Validation Error Summary
attributes.description: Human-readable summary of validation errors encountered during feed batch processing. Captures top error categories (e.g., missing NDC, invalid NPI) for triage and remediation.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

tag_set.value: Pbm Feed Batch Validation Error Summary

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Result of the automated data quality validation checks applied to this feed batch (e.g., record count match, required field presence, NDC format checks). Distinct from batch_status.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

products.name: rebate_record
products.description: Manufacturer rebate record tracking rebate amounts earned and received at the claim or drug-class level for a given client and benefit period. Captures the rebate type (brand, specialty, performance, administrative), the drug NDC or GPI therapeutic class

attributes.name: rebate_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the manufacturer rebate record within the PillarRx lakehouse. Primary key for the rebate_record entity.

attributes.name: claim_pbm_id
attributes.description: FK to claim.claim_pbm.claim_pbm_id — Rebate records reference the PBM rebate contract; FK to PBM master needed for guarantee reconciliation.

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM through which the rebatable claims were adjudicated. Links to company.pbm.

attributes.name: employer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employer client whose plan members generated the rebatable claims. Links to client.employer. Supports multi-tenant client scoping.

attributes.name: pbm_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.pbm_assignment. Business justification: Rebate records must be reconciled against the specific PBM assignment's contracted rebate guarantees, passthrough percentages, and pricing model.

attributes.name: rebate_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rebate contract under which this rebate record was earned. Links to the division.rebate_contract product.

attributes.name: rebate_payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rebate payment record that settled this rebate amount. Links to the division.rebate_payment product. Nullable until payment is received.

attributes.name: rebate_rx_claim_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate Record Rebate Rx Claim Id
attributes.description: FK to claim.rx_claim.rx_claim_id — Claim-level rebate rows reference the originating claim; for claim-grain rebates a guaranteed FK supports DIR and pass-through reconciliation. (Drug-class-level rebate rows may be null-FK.)

tag_set.value: Rebate Record Rebate Rx Claim Id

attributes.name: to_rx_claim_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate Record To Rx Claim Id
attributes.description: FK to claim.rx_claim.rx_claim_id — Rebate records track amounts at the claim or drug-class level; a claim-level FK is required for claim-grain rebate reconciliation.

tag_set.value: Rebate Record To Rx Claim Id

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of any post-invoice adjustment applied to this rebate record (positive = upward adjustment, negative = clawback or reduction).

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for the rebate adjustment amount, such as claim restatement, eligibility correction, or DIR reconciliation. Required when adjustment_amount is non-zero.

attributes.name: admin_fee_amount
attributes.description: Administrative fee retained by the PBM from the gross rebate before passing through to the plan. Key metric in pass-through vs. spread PBM model audits.

attributes.name: benefit_period_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate Record Benefit Period End Date
attributes.description: End date of the benefit period to which this rebate record applies. Together with benefit_period_start_date defines the rebate measurement window.

tag_set.value: Rebate Record Benefit Period End Date

attributes.name: benefit_period_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate Record Benefit Period Start Date
attributes.description: Start date of the benefit period (plan year quarter or contract period) to which this rebate record applies. Used for period-level rebate aggregation.

tag_set.value: Rebate Record Benefit Period Start Date

attributes.name: claim_count
attributes.description: Number of eligible pharmacy claims included in this rebate record for the benefit period. Used to validate rebate amounts against per-claim rates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rebate record was first created in the PillarRx lakehouse. Audit trail for data lineage and ETL traceability.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this rebate record. Typically USD for domestic PBM rebates.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for a rebate dispute when rebate_status is 'disputed'. Captures the basis for challenging the invoiced or received amount.

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: Brand or generic name of the drug associated with this rebate record. Denormalized for readability in rebate reporting and consulting deliverables.

attributes.name: estimated_rebate_amount
attributes.description: Projected rebate amount calculated at time of estimation, prior to PBM invoice or manufacturer confirmation. Used for accrual and client forecasting.

attributes.name: formulary_tier
attributes.description: Formulary tier placement of the drug at the time the rebate was earned. Tier placement drives rebate eligibility and rate under most PBM contracts.

attributes.name: gpi_code
attributes.description: 14-digit Medi-Span Generic Product Identifier representing the therapeutic class or drug group for class-level rebate records where a single NDC is not applicable.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rebate was invoiced to the manufacturer or PBM. Marks the formal billing event in the rebate lifecycle.

attributes.name: invoiced_rebate_amount
attributes.description: Rebate amount formally invoiced to the manufacturer or PBM for the benefit period. Represents the billed gross rebate before any adjustments.

attributes.name: is_340b_excluded
attributes.description: Indicates whether claims under the federal 340B drug discount program are excluded from this rebate record, as required by most manufacturer rebate contracts.

attributes.name: is_pass_through
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rebate is fully passed through to the employer plan (true) or retained in whole or part by the PBM under a spread model (false).

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the pharmaceutical manufacturer from whom the rebate is earned. Key party in the rebate contract relationship.

attributes.name: market_share_pct
attributes.description: Drug market share percentage achieved within the therapeutic class for the benefit period. Determines tier qualification for market-share-based rebate contracts.

attributes.name: net_rebate_amount
attributes.description: Net rebate amount passed through to the employer plan after deducting PBM administrative fees. Core metric for plan sponsor rebate value reporting.
attributes.references: PCMA; CMS DIR guidance; ERISA; DOL

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by PillarRx analysts regarding this rebate record, such as audit findings, reconciliation commentary, or client communication context.

attributes.name: pbm_rebate_reference
attributes.description: PBM-assigned reference number for this rebate record as reported in the PBM rebate remittance file. Used for cross-referencing PBM source data during audits.

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Performance tier achieved under the rebate contract for the benefit period (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Gold). Determines the applicable rebate rate for performance-based contracts.

attributes.name: rebate_basis
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the rebate amount: per claim, per dispensed unit, percentage of AWP/WAC, flat fee, or market-share tier. Drives rate application logic.

attributes.name: rebate_rate
attributes.description: Contractual rebate rate applied to calculate the rebate amount, expressed as a percentage of AWP or a per-unit dollar amount per the rebate contract terms.

attributes.name: rebate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rebate record, from initial estimation through receipt, dispute resolution, or voiding.

attributes.name: rebate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rebate by its contractual basis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: brand|specialty|performance|administrative|inflation|market_share|formulary_placement — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rebate payment was actually received. Nullable until payment is confirmed. Used for cash-basis rebate accounting.

attributes.name: received_rebate_amount
attributes.description: Actual rebate amount received from the manufacturer or PBM. May differ from invoiced amount due to disputes, adjustments, or partial payments.

attributes.name: record_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this rebate record, assigned by the PBM or manufacturer. Used for reconciliation and audit traceability.

attributes.name: source_pbm_name
attributes.description: Name of the PBM that reported this rebate record (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts). Denormalized for multi-PBM reporting without join.

attributes.name: therapeutic_class_code
attributes.description: Drug therapeutic class code (e.g., Medi-Span GPI class prefix) used for class-level rebate aggregation and performance tier measurement.

attributes.name: unit_count
attributes.description: Total dispensed units (tablets, milliliters, etc.) across all eligible claims in this rebate record. Used for unit-based rebate rate calculations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this rebate record. Used to detect changes during reconciliation cycles and ETL incremental loads.

products.name: cob
products.description: Coordination-of-benefits / other-payer segment for a pharmacy claim, capturing each other-payer amount, payer sequence (primary/secondary/tertiary), other payer ID and qualifier, other payer paid amount, other payer patient responsibility, and the

attributes.name: cob_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for the coordination-of-benefits segment record. One row per other-payer occurrence on a pharmacy claim.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.benefit_plan. Business justification: Coordination of benefits (COB) records track other payer coverage for members. Linking to benefit_plan enables accurate accumulator reconciliation, TROOP calculation for Medicare Part D

attributes.name: company_client_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to company.company_client. Business justification: COB records must be attributed to clients for coordination of benefits analysis, other payer recovery audits, and CAP program coordination reporting. New FK needed.

attributes.name: other_payer_company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the other payer (e.g., secondary insurer, SPAP, Medicare, Medicaid, manufacturer copay card). Interpreted in conjunction with other_payer_id_qualifier.

attributes.name: pbm_division_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to division.division. Business justification: COB records needed at division level for accurate accumulator tracking and PBM guarantee measurement when coordination of benefits rules vary by division.

attributes.name: rx_claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the parent pharmacy claim (rx_claim) to which this COB segment belongs. Links the other-payer record to its adjudicated fill transaction.

attributes.name: cap_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this COB segment represents a manufacturer copay assistance program (CAP) payment such as a copay card or coupon. Enables PAX application tracking and CAP program analytics.
attributes.references: PillarRx PAX Application; CMS TrOOP Exclusion Rules

attributes.name: cob_status
attributes.description: Processing status of this COB segment. Indicates whether the other-payer amount was successfully applied, rejected by the adjudicator, pending resolution, or reversed.

attributes.name: coordination_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the benefit period during which the other payer's coverage is active and coordinating. Null if the other payer coverage is open-ended or ongoing.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; ERISA Plan Coordination Rules

attributes.name: coordination_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the benefit period during which the other payer's coverage is active and coordinating. Used to validate COB eligibility and benefit year alignment.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; ERISA Plan Coordination Rules

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this COB segment record was first loaded into the lakehouse Silver layer from the PBM claims feed. Supports data freshness monitoring and ETL audit.
attributes.references: PillarRx Enterprise Data Warehouse / Analytics Lakehouse

attributes.name: other_payer_amount_qualifier
attributes.description: NCPDP qualifier indicating what the other_payer_paid_amt represents. Values: 01=Ingredient Cost, 02=Dispensing Fee, 03=Total, 04=Copay, 05=Coinsurance, 06=Deductible.

attributes.name: other_payer_bin
attributes.description: Six-digit Bank Identification Number (BIN/RxBIN) of the other payer used for pharmacy claim routing. Enables identification of the other payer's adjudication network.

attributes.name: other_payer_coinsurance_amt
attributes.description: Percentage-based coinsurance amount assessed by the other payer for this claim. Supports granular COB cost-sharing analysis separate from copay and deductible.

attributes.name: other_payer_copay_amt
attributes.description: Fixed copay amount assessed by the other payer for this claim. Distinguishes the copay component of patient responsibility from coinsurance and deductible for COB analytics.

attributes.name: other_payer_coverage_type
attributes.description: Type of coverage provided by the other payer. Distinguishes pharmacy-specific COB from medical or other benefit coordination, relevant for total cost of care analysis.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; CMS COB Guidelines

attributes.name: other_payer_date
attributes.description: Date on which the other payer adjudicated or processed this claim. Used to sequence COB events and validate that the other payer processed the claim before the primary plan.

attributes.name: other_payer_deductible_amt
attributes.description: Deductible amount applied by the other payer toward this claim. Used to determine how much of the patient responsibility is attributable to the other payer's deductible accumulator.

attributes.name: other_payer_group
attributes.description: Benefit group identifier (RxGroup) associated with the other payer's plan. Used to identify the specific benefit design under the secondary or tertiary payer.

attributes.name: other_payer_id_qualifier
attributes.description: Qualifier code indicating the type of identifier in other_payer_id. NCPDP values: 01=BIN, 02=NPI, 03=NCPDP, 04=Medicare, 99=Other. Required to correctly interpret the payer ID.

attributes.name: other_payer_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the other payer (e.g., 'Medicare Part D', 'Aetna', 'Pfizer Copay Card'). Sourced from the PBM claims feed or enriched from payer reference data.

attributes.name: other_payer_paid_amt
attributes.description: Dollar amount paid by the other payer toward this claim. Used in COB calculations to determine residual member liability and plan liability after all payers have contributed.

attributes.name: other_payer_patient_responsibility_amt
attributes.description: Amount the other payer determined to be the patient's responsibility (copay, coinsurance, deductible) under that payer's benefit design. Feeds into primary plan COB adjudication.

attributes.name: other_payer_pcn
attributes.description: Processor Control Number (RxPCN) of the other payer, used alongside BIN to route claims to the correct adjudication processor for the secondary or tertiary payer.

attributes.name: other_payer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the other payer. Supports COB analytics and CAP program identification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial|medicare|medicaid|spap|manufacturer_cap|tricare|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS COB Guidelines; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard

attributes.name: payer_sequence
attributes.description: Indicates the coordination order of this other payer relative to the primary plan: primary, secondary, or tertiary. Drives COB logic and member liability calculation.

attributes.name: pbm_claim_number
attributes.description: The PBM-assigned claim reference number from the source adjudication system. Used to correlate the COB segment back to the raw PBM claims feed for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: reject_code
attributes.description: NCPDP reject code returned when the COB segment was not accepted during adjudication. Used for claims audit and PBM performance analysis when COB coordination fails.
attributes.references: NCPDP Reject Code List; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard Field 511-FB

attributes.name: reject_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the reject code for the COB segment. Supports claims audit workflows and PBM consulting deliverables when investigating COB adjudication failures.

attributes.name: source_file_name
attributes.description: Name of the raw PBM claims file from which this COB segment was extracted. Enables data lineage tracing back to the original ingestion artifact for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: troop_excluded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the other payer amount is excluded from the member's True Out-of-Pocket (TrOOP) accumulator under Medicare Part D rules. Critical for 340B and manufacturer CAP compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D TrOOP Guidelines; 42 CFR Part 423

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this COB segment record in the lakehouse. Tracks adjustments, reversals, or corrections applied after initial ingestion.
attributes.references: PillarRx Enterprise Data Warehouse / Analytics Lakehouse

domains.name: drug
domains.description: Authoritative reference domain for all drug, formulary, and pharmacy provider data. Drugs are keyed by the 11-digit NDC and sourced from Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span and First DataBank, including pricing (AWP, WAC, MAC), classification (GPI therapeutic class
domains.references: FDA NDC Directory / Medi-Span / First DataBank

products.name: ndc
products.description: Authoritative SSOT master for every 11-digit National Drug Code (NDC) dispensed or referenced across PillarRx client claims, sourced from Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span and First DataBank.
products.reference: FDA NDC Directory / Medi-Span / First DataBank

attributes.name: ndc_id
attributes.description: Surrogate primary key for the NDC dimension record. Supports Type-2 SCD versioning so each historical snapshot of an NDC has a unique row.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB)

attributes.name: labeler_manufacturer_id
attributes.description: FK to drug.manufacturer.manufacturer_id — manufacturer is keyed on labeler code (first 5 digits of NDC); the NDC master must FK to its manufacturer for rebate, 340B, and manufacturer-spend reporting. Day-1 critical for manufacturer program ma

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: FDA New Drug Application (NDA), Abbreviated NDA (ANDA), or Biologics License Application (BLA) number. Links the NDC to its regulatory approval for biosimilar and generic analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book; FDA Purple Book; 21 CFR Part 314/601

attributes.name: awp_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current AWP pricing became effective. Critical for point-in-time pricing lookups during PBM audit and claims repricing.

attributes.name: awp_package_price
attributes.description: Average Wholesale Price for the full package (AWP per unit × package size). Used in ingredient cost benchmarking and PBM audit comparisons.

attributes.name: awp_unit_price
attributes.description: Average Wholesale Price per dispensing unit as published by Medi-Span or FDB. Basis for AWP discount calculations in PBM contract audits and guarantee reconciliation.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB); CMS AWP Reference

attributes.name: biosimilar_indicator
attributes.description: True if the drug is an FDA-approved biosimilar. Used in biosimilar substitution opportunity analysis and specialty spend optimization consulting.
attributes.references: FDA Biosimilar Product Information; BPCIA (Biologics Price Competition and Innovation Act)

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned brand/trade name for the drug product (e.g., LIPITOR). Null for generic-only products. Used in brand vs. generic spend analytics.

attributes.name: dea_schedule
attributes.description: DEA controlled substance schedule (CI–CV) or 'unscheduled'. Drives DUR alerts, quantity limit rules, and regulatory compliance reporting for controlled substance utilization.
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act; 21 CFR Part 1308

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date the drug product was discontinued from the U.S. market. Null for active products. Used to identify claims dispensed after market withdrawal.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB)

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: Physical form of the drug product (e.g., tablet, capsule, solution, injection). Sourced from FDA labeling and drug reference files. Used in formulary and utilization analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Drug Labeling; Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB)

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: Full proprietary or established drug product name as published by the labeler and sourced from Medi-Span or FDB (e.g., LIPITOR, atorvastatin calcium).
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB); FDA Drug Labeling

attributes.name: drug_reference_source
attributes.description: External reference source (Medi-Span/First DataBank)

attributes.name: drug_status
attributes.description: Current FDA market status of the NDC (active, discontinued, recalled, pending, obsolete). Drives formulary maintenance and claim adjudication validity checks.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB)

attributes.name: fdb_drug_code
attributes.description: First DataBank internal drug identifier for this NDC. Enables cross-reference between Medi-Span and FDB sourcing and supports dual-source validation in the drug reference pipeline.

attributes.name: generic_indicator
attributes.description: Attribute capturing the generic indicator for the ndc record in the drug domain.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB); NCPDP D.0

attributes.name: generic_name
attributes.description: International Nonproprietary Name (INN) or USAN generic name of the active ingredient(s) (e.g., atorvastatin calcium). Used for generic substitution analysis and GDR reporting.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB); USP

attributes.name: gpi14
attributes.description: Medi-Span 14-digit Generic Product Identifier classifying the drug by therapeutic category, drug group, drug class, drug name, dosage form, route, and strength. Core to therapeutic class analysis.

attributes.name: is_current
attributes.description: True if this row is the current active version of the NDC record in the Type-2 SCD. Simplifies queries that need only the latest drug attributes without date-range filtering.

attributes.name: ldd_indicator
attributes.description: True if the drug is a Limited Distribution Drug available only through select specialty pharmacies. Used in specialty pharmacy network compliance and affordability analysis.
attributes.references: FDA REMS Program; Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB)

attributes.name: maintenance_drug_indicator
attributes.description: True if the drug is classified as a maintenance medication (chronic, long-term use). Used in 90-day supply program analysis and mail-order vs. retail dispensing analytics.

attributes.name: market_date
attributes.description: Date the drug product was first commercially available in the U.S. market. Used in new-to-market drug trend analysis and formulary addition timing.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span

attributes.name: medi_span_drug_code
attributes.description: Medi-Span internal drug identifier for this NDC. Supports cross-reference and reconciliation between Medi-Span and FDB drug reference feeds in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: multi_source_indicator
attributes.description: True if a generic equivalent is available from multiple manufacturers, enabling MAC pricing. Used in PBM audit and MAC pricing analysis.

attributes.name: ndc11
attributes.description: The FDA-assigned 11-digit National Drug Code in 5-4-2 format (labeler-product-package). Primary natural key for drug identification across all PBM claim feeds.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; HIPAA Transaction Standard 837P/D

attributes.name: ndc11_formatted
attributes.description: NDC-11 displayed in hyphenated 5-4-2 format for human-readable reporting and EOB presentation (e.g., 12345-6789-01).

attributes.name: orange_book_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: FDA Orange Book Therapeutic Equivalence Code

attributes.name: rems_indicator

attributes.name: route_of_administration

attributes.name: scd_effective_date

attributes.name: specialty_drug_indicator

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: Active ingredient strength and unit (e.g., 10 mg, 500 mg/5 mL). Used in clinical equivalence matching, step therapy analysis, and quantity limit validation.
attributes.references: FDA Drug Labeling; Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB)

attributes.name: therapeutic_class_code

attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span GPI; First DataBank (FDB) Therapeutic Class

attributes.name: therapeutic_class_name
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the therapeutic class (e.g., HMG-CoA Reductase Inhibitors). Supports consulting reports and client-facing trend analysis.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span GPI; First DataBank (FDB)

attributes.name: wac_effective_date

attributes.name: wac_unit_price

attributes.name: ndc_price_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Drug Code (NDC) Price Record ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for each time-versioned NDC pricing record in the Pillarrx drug reference domain.

tag_set.value: National Drug Code (NDC) Price Record ID

attributes.name: primary_mac_list_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ndc Price Primary Mac List Id
attributes.description: FK to drug.mac_list.mac_list_id — ndc_price stores MAC values that belong to a specific MAC list; FK to mac_list enables under-reimbursement appeals analysis and MAC benchmarking (iteration-1 request).

tag_set.value: Ndc Price Primary Mac List Id

attributes.name: mac_list_id
attributes.description: FK to drug.mac_list.mac_list_id — ndc_price MAC entries reference a mac_list; FK required for under-reimbursement appeals and MAC benchmarking.

attributes.name: ndc_mac_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to drug.mac_list. Business justification: ndc_price can reference a MAC list when the price is MAC-based. Currently has mac_list_name (STRING) but needs proper FK to mac_list master. The mac_list_name string becomes redundant.

attributes.name: awp_discount_pct
attributes.description: The contracted AWP discount percentage applied to this NDC for ingredient cost reimbursement. Expressed as a positive decimal (e.g., 16.00 = 16% off AWP). Used in PBM contract guarantee auditing.
attributes.references: PCMA pricing standards; Pillarrx PBM audit methodology

attributes.name: awp_package_price
attributes.description: Average Wholesale Price for the full package size as published by Medi-Span or FDB. Used in package-level cost analysis and PBM audit reconciliation.

attributes.name: awp_unit_price
attributes.description: Average Wholesale Price per dispensing unit as published by Medi-Span or FDB. AWP is the benchmark price used in PBM contract discount calculations and ingredient cost benchmarking.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB); PCMA pricing standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary price fields in this record. Pillarrx operates in USD; this field supports multi-currency extensibility.

attributes.name: dea_schedule
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) Controlled Substance Schedule
attributes.description: DEA controlled substance schedule for this NDC. CI = Schedule I through CV = Schedule V. Unscheduled = not a controlled substance. Required for controlled substance utilization reporting.
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act; 21 CFR Part 1308

tag_set.value: Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) Controlled Substance Schedule

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: Physical form of the drug product (e.g., TABLET, CAPSULE, SOLUTION, INJECTION, PATCH). Sourced from Medi-Span or FDB. Used in drug utilization and formulary analysis.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB); FDA drug labeling

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: Brand or generic drug name for this NDC as published by Medi-Span or FDB. Denormalized onto the pricing record to support reporting without joining to the drug dimension.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB); FDA drug labeling

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this pricing record becomes effective. Used with expiration_date to define the valid window for AWP, WAC, and MAC values. Supports Type-2 SCD history.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this pricing record expires and is superseded by a newer version. NULL indicates the record is currently active. Supports Type-2 SCD history.

attributes.name: formulary_tier
attributes.description: Formulary cost-sharing tier associated with this NDC at the time of this pricing record (e.g., Tier 1 Generic, Tier 2 Preferred Brand). Supports formulary and benefit analysis.
attributes.references: Pillarrx formulary analysis; PCMA formulary standards

attributes.name: generic_indicator
attributes.description: Classifies the NDC as brand, generic, over-the-counter, or biosimilar. Drives Generic Dispensing Rate (GDR) calculations and brand/generic cost benchmarking in PBM audits.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB); FDA drug classification

attributes.name: gpi_code
attributes.description: 14-digit Generic Product Identifier from Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span providing a hierarchical drug classification (drug group, class, subclass, name, name extension, dosage form, strength).

attributes.name: is_340b_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NDC is eligible for the federal 340B drug discount program. Used in 340B program management and manufacturer discount reconciliation for covered entities.

attributes.name: is_current
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the currently active pricing record for the NDC. TRUE = current active row; FALSE = historical row. Supports efficient Type-2 SCD current-row filtering.
attributes.references: Pillarrx Enterprise Data Warehouse; Type-2 SCD convention

attributes.name: is_limited_distribution
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NDC is a Limited Distribution Drug (LDD) available only through select specialty pharmacies. Affects reimbursement benchmarking and network adequacy analysis.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB); FDA LDD designation

attributes.name: is_specialty_drug
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NDC is classified as a specialty medication (SMN) requiring special handling, prior authorization, or specialty pharmacy dispensing. Critical for specialty spend monitoring.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB); PCMA specialty drug standards

attributes.name: labeler_name
attributes.description: Name of the drug manufacturer or labeler as registered with the FDA for this NDC. Used in manufacturer program management, rebate tracking, and 340B analysis.

attributes.name: mac_price
attributes.description: Maximum Allowable Cost price for this NDC, representing the maximum reimbursement a PBM will pay for a generic or multi-source drug. Central to PBM contract MAC list auditing.
attributes.references: PCMA MAC transparency standards; State PBM transparency laws

attributes.name: multisource_code
attributes.description: Medi-Span/FDB multisource code indicating generic availability: O = originator brand, M = multisource brand, N = no generic available, Y = generic available. Drives MAC applicability.

attributes.name: obsolete_date
attributes.description: Date on which the FDA or drug reference source marked this NDC as obsolete or discontinued. NULL if still active. Used to prevent claims matching to discontinued NDCs in audit workflows.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB)

attributes.name: package_size
attributes.description: Numeric quantity of dispensing units contained in the package for which package-level pricing (AWP, WAC) is expressed. Used to derive per-unit pricing from package pricing.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span

attributes.name: package_size_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the package size quantity (e.g., TAB for 30-tablet bottle, ML for 100mL vial). Distinct from unit_of_measure which applies to per-unit pricing.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span

attributes.name: price_change_type
attributes.description: Describes the nature of the pricing change that triggered this new SCD Type-2 row. Used in drug price trend analysis and manufacturer price increase monitoring for employer clients.
attributes.references: Pillarrx PBM audit methodology; PCMA pricing standards

attributes.name: price_source
attributes.description: Identifies the authoritative external source that published this pricing record. Medi-Span (Wolters Kluwer) and First DataBank (FDB) are the primary drug reference feeds used by Pillarrx.

attributes.name: price_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this pricing record. ACTIVE = currently in effect; EXPIRED = past expiration_date; SUPERSEDED = replaced by a newer SCD row; PENDING = future-dated not yet effective.
attributes.references: Pillarrx Enterprise Data Warehouse; Type-2 SCD convention

attributes.name: price_type_code
attributes.description: Classifies the primary pricing basis of this record. AWP = Average Wholesale Price, WAC = Wholesale Acquisition Cost, MAC = Maximum Allowable Cost, DP = Direct Price, SP = Suggested Price.

attributes.name: prior_awp_unit_price
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Per Unit
attributes.description: The AWP per unit from the immediately preceding pricing record for this NDC. Retained on the new row to enable direct price change calculations without joining to the prior SCD row.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; Pillarrx PBM audit methodology

tag_set.value: Prior Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Per Unit

attributes.name: prior_wac_unit_price
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) Per Unit
attributes.description: The WAC per unit from the immediately preceding pricing record for this NDC. Enables direct WAC change calculations for manufacturer price increase monitoring.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; Pillarrx PBM audit methodology

tag_set.value: Prior Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) Per Unit

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pricing record row was first inserted into the Pillarrx Silver layer. Supports audit trail and SCD Type-2 row lineage.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pricing record row was last modified in the Pillarrx Silver layer. Tracks corrections or restatements to a pricing row after initial load.

attributes.name: repackaged_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NDC belongs to a repackager rather than the original manufacturer. Repackaged NDCs may have different AWP/WAC values and require special handling in PBM audits.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The route by which the drug is administered (e.g., ORAL, INJECTABLE). Sourced from Medi-Span or FDB. Used in specialty drug identification and clinical utilization analysis.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB); FDA drug labeling

attributes.name: source_file_name
attributes.description: Name of the Medi-Span or FDB source file from which this pricing record was loaded. Supports data lineage tracing and audit of pricing feed ingestion.

attributes.name: source_load_date
attributes.description: The date on which this pricing record was loaded from the external source feed (Medi-Span or FDB) into the Pillarrx lakehouse. Supports feed timeliness monitoring.

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: Strength of the active ingredient(s) for this NDC as labeled (e.g., 10MG, 500MG/5ML). Sourced from Medi-Span or FDB. Used in clinical and formulary analysis.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB); FDA drug labeling

attributes.name: therapeutic_class_code
attributes.description: Drug therapeutic class code from Medi-Span GPI or FDB therapeutic classification hierarchy. Used in drug utilization review (DUR), formulary analysis, and therapeutic category spend reporting.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span GPI; First DataBank (FDB) therapeutic classification

attributes.name: therapeutic_class_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the therapeutic class corresponding to therapeutic_class_code. Supports reporting and analytics without requiring a join to a separate classification table.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span GPI; First DataBank (FDB) therapeutic classification

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The dispensing unit of measure for which per-unit pricing (AWP, WAC) is expressed. Examples: EA (each), ML (milliliter), GM (gram), TAB (tablet), CAP (capsule).
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT standard; FDA NDC labeling

attributes.name: wac_package_price
attributes.description: Wholesale Acquisition Cost for the full package size. Used in package-level manufacturer pricing analysis and 340B ceiling price calculations.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB); HRSA 340B program

attributes.name: wac_unit_price
attributes.description: Wholesale Acquisition Cost per dispensing unit as published by Medi-Span or FDB. WAC is the manufacturer list price before discounts and is used in 340B and rebate analytics.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB); HRSA 340B program

products.name: classification

attributes.description: Human-readable label for the 6-digit Medi-Span GPI drug subclass. Used in specialty spend monitoring and therapeutic category benchmarking.

attributes.name: limited_distribution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is a Limited Distribution Drug (LDD) available only through select specialty pharmacies. Impacts network adequacy analysis and specialty pharmacy spend monitoring.
attributes.references: FDA REMS Program; PBM Limited Distribution Network Standards

attributes.name: maintenance_drug_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is classified as a maintenance medication (chronic, long-term use). Used in mail-order incentive analysis and 90-day supply benefit design consulting.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span Drug Descriptor Database

attributes.name: multisource_code
attributes.description: Medi-Span multisource code indicating generic availability: M=multisource (generic available), O=originator brand, N=no generic available, Y=generic product. Used in GDR auditing and MAC pricing applicability.

attributes.name: ndc11
attributes.description: The 11-digit National Drug Code uniquely identifying the drug product. Carried here for denormalized lookup convenience alongside the FK to the NDC master.

attributes.name: orphan_drug_flag

attributes.name: otc_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is available over-the-counter without a prescription. OTC drugs are typically excluded from PBM formulary coverage and require separate benefit design consideration.
attributes.references: FDA OTC Drug Review; 21 CFR Part 330

attributes.name: prior_auth_typical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization (PA) is typically required for this drug class based on standard PBM formulary management practices. Used as a benchmark in PA analysis and benefit design consulting.
attributes.references: CMS Prior Authorization Standards; NCPDP SCRIPT Standard

attributes.name: quantity_limit_typical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether quantity limits (QL) are typically applied to this drug class in standard PBM formulary management. Used in benefit design analysis and PBM audit services.

attributes.name: rems_flag

attributes.name: source_version
attributes.description: Version or release identifier of the source drug reference file from which this classification was loaded (e.g., Medi-Span quarterly release label). Supports audit and reproducibility of historical analyses.

attributes.name: specialty_drug_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is classified as a specialty medication (SMN) requiring special handling, cold chain, or limited distribution. Key driver of specialty pharmacy spend monitoring and trend reporting.
attributes.references: NCPDP; PBM Specialty Drug List Standards

attributes.name: step_therapy_typical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether step therapy (ST) is typically required for this drug class. Used as a benchmark in step therapy protocol analysis and PBM formulary consulting for employer clients.
attributes.references: CMS Step Therapy Standards; NCPDP SCRIPT Standard

attributes.name: therapeutic_equivalent_code

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this classification record was last updated in the PillarRx data platform. Used to detect classification changes from source drug reference feeds and trigger SCD Type-2 versioning.
attributes.references: Internal PillarRx Data Governance Standard; SOC 2

products.name: drug_formulary
products.description: Master record for each formulary (covered drug list) managed or analyzed by PillarRx on behalf of employer clients. A formulary is the PBM-administered list of covered drugs with associated tier structures and utilization management rules.

attributes.name: drug_formulary_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each formulary record in the PillarRx data lakehouse. Primary key for the drug_formulary dimension.

attributes.name: primary_drug_division_formulary_id
attributes.description: The PBM's own internal identifier for this formulary as received in claims feeds or formulary files from CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts, Navitus, and other PBM partners.

attributes.name: brand_drug_count
attributes.description: Number of brand-name drug products listed on this formulary. Used in formulary composition analysis and brand-versus-generic benchmarking for PBM audit engagements.

attributes.name: daw_policy
attributes.description: The formulary-level policy governing how DAW codes are handled. Defines whether brand dispensing is allowed, penalized with higher cost-share, or whether generic substitution is mandated.

attributes.name: drug_count
attributes.description: Total number of National Drug Codes (NDCs) or drug products listed on this formulary at the time of the effective date. Supports formulary breadth benchmarking across PBMs.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this formulary version becomes effective for adjudication and benefit administration. Supports Type-2 slowly changing dimension history tracking.

attributes.name: formulary_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code assigned by the PBM or plan sponsor to uniquely identify this formulary (covered drug list). Used in claims routing and benefit configuration.

attributes.name: formulary_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the formulary, including its intended population, design philosophy, or notable features. Used in consulting deliverables and client-facing reporting.

attributes.name: formulary_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the formulary as defined by the PBM or plan sponsor (e.g., 'Standard 4-Tier Formulary', 'Specialty Preferred Formulary'). Used in reporting and client communications.

attributes.name: formulary_source
attributes.description: The originating data source for this formulary record. Identifies whether the formulary was received via PBM claims feed, manually entered, provided by the client, or sourced from FDB or Medi-Span reference data.

attributes.name: formulary_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the formulary. Active formularies are in use for adjudication; retired formularies are historical; pending formularies are approved but not yet effective.

attributes.name: formulary_type
attributes.description: Classification of the formulary structure. Open formularies cover most drugs; closed formularies restrict to listed drugs only; incentive formularies apply differential cost-sharing to drive preferred drug use.

attributes.name: generic_drug_count
attributes.description: Number of generic drug products listed on this formulary. Used to calculate the Generic Dispensing Rate (GDR) potential and benchmark formulary generic utilization incentives.

attributes.name: generic_tier_label
attributes.description: The label assigned to the generic drug tier in this formulary (e.g., 'Tier 1', 'Generic'). Used in member communications, EOB displays, and formulary comparison reporting.

attributes.name: has_preventive_tier
attributes.description: Indicates whether this formulary includes a zero-cost-share preventive drug tier as required under ACA Section 2713 for preventive care mandates.

attributes.name: has_specialty_tier
attributes.description: Indicates whether this formulary includes a dedicated specialty drug tier. True when a specialty tier exists; False for formularies that do not separately classify specialty medications.

attributes.name: is_current_record
attributes.description: Type-2 SCD flag indicating whether this row is the currently active version of the formulary record. True for the current version; False for historical versions superseded by a later update.
attributes.references: PillarRx Data Lakehouse SCD Type-2 Convention

attributes.name: list_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a national PBM standard formulary, a custom formulary negotiated for a specific client, or a client-specific formulary. Drives consulting analysis segmentation.

attributes.name: loaded_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this formulary record was first loaded into the PillarRx data lakehouse Silver layer. Supports data freshness monitoring and ETL audit trail.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business for which this formulary is designed. Determines applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., CMS Part D formulary rules for Medicare, ACA rules for exchange plans).

attributes.name: mail_order_supported

attributes.name: non_preferred_brand_tier_label
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug Formulary Non Preferred Brand Tier Label

tag_set.value: Drug Formulary Non Preferred Brand Tier Label

attributes.name: pass_through_model

attributes.name: pbm_name
attributes.description: Name of the PBM that administers this formulary (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts, Navitus, EmpiRx Health). Supports multi-PBM formulary benchmarking.

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: The benefit plan year (e.g., 2024) to which this formulary applies. Formularies are typically updated annually; plan year scopes the formulary for trend and audit analysis.

attributes.name: preferred_brand_tier_label
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug Formulary Preferred Brand Tier Label
attributes.description: The label assigned to the preferred brand drug tier in this formulary (e.g., 'Tier 2', 'Preferred Brand'). Supports formulary tier structure documentation and PBM audit.

tag_set.value: Drug Formulary Preferred Brand Tier Label

attributes.name: prior_auth_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization (PA) utilization management is applied to any drugs on this formulary. True when PA programs are active; used in PA analysis and audit reporting.

attributes.name: quantity_limit_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether quantity limit (QL) utilization management controls are applied to any drugs on this formulary. Quantity limits cap the dispensed amount per fill or per period.

attributes.name: rebate_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether drugs on this formulary are eligible for manufacturer rebate programs. Rebate eligibility is a key factor in PBM contract guarantee reconciliation and DIR analysis.

attributes.name: scd_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this Type-2 SCD row was superseded by a newer version. Null for the currently active record. Used with scd_start_date for point-in-time formulary history reconstruction.

attributes.name: scd_start_date

attributes.references: PillarRx Data Lakehouse SCD Type-2 Convention

attributes.name: source_file_name
attributes.description: Name of the source file or feed from which this formulary record was ingested (e.g., PBM formulary extract filename). Supports data lineage tracking and ETL audit within the lakehouse.

attributes.name: specialty_drug_count
attributes.description: Number of specialty medications (SMN) listed on this formulary. Specialty drug count is a key metric for specialty spend monitoring and copay assistance program (CAP) scoping.

attributes.name: specialty_pharmacy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether specialty medications on this formulary must be dispensed through a designated specialty pharmacy network. Relevant for limited distribution drug (LDD) management.

attributes.name: specialty_tier_label
attributes.description: The label assigned to the specialty drug tier in this formulary (e.g., 'Tier 4', 'Specialty'). Specialty tier tracking is critical for high-cost drug spend monitoring and CAP program management.

attributes.name: step_therapy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether step therapy (ST) utilization management protocols are applied to any drugs on this formulary. Step therapy requires trial of preferred drugs before coverage of non-preferred alternatives.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which this formulary version is no longer effective. Null indicates the record is currently active. Used with effective_date to implement Type-2 SCD history.

attributes.name: tier_count

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this formulary record was last modified in the PillarRx data lakehouse. Used for change detection, SCD processing, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: version

products.name: drug_formulary_tier

attributes.name: copay_retail_90

attributes.name: cost_share_type

attributes.name: deductible_applies

attributes.references: ERISA Plan Document Standards; ACA Cost-Sharing Provisions

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this formulary tier definition becomes effective for benefit adjudication. Required for Type-2 SCD history tracking and plan year alignment.
attributes.references: ERISA Plan Document Standards; CMS Part D Formulary Guidance

attributes.name: formulary_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating data source for this formulary tier record (e.g., pbm_feed, manual, medi_span, fdb, client_upload). Supports data lineage and ETL audit traceability.

attributes.name: formulary_year
attributes.description: The benefit plan year (e.g., 2024) to which this formulary tier definition applies. Enables year-over-year formulary change analysis and trend reporting.

attributes.name: is_current
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the current active version of the formulary tier record (True) or a historical version (False). Standard Type-2 SCD current-row flag.

attributes.name: mail_order_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether drugs on this tier are eligible for mail-order dispensing. Relevant for channel optimization analysis and member benefit communication.

attributes.name: max_copay
attributes.description: Maximum member copay ceiling applied when coinsurance is used, capping the member's cost-share per fill. Protects members from catastrophic per-fill costs on high-cost specialty drugs.
attributes.references: ERISA Plan Document Standards; ACA Cost-Sharing Provisions

attributes.name: min_copay
attributes.description: Minimum member copay floor applied when coinsurance is used, ensuring the member pays at least this amount per fill regardless of drug cost. Common in specialty tier designs.
attributes.references: ERISA Plan Document Standards; ACA Cost-Sharing Provisions

attributes.name: oop_applies

attributes.references: ACA Cost-Sharing Provisions; CMS MOOP Guidance

attributes.name: preferred_network_only

attributes.references: ERISA Plan Document Standards; NCPDP Pharmacy Network Standards

attributes.name: prior_auth_required

attributes.references: ERISA Plan Document Standards; CMS Prior Authorization Guidance

attributes.name: quantity_limit_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether quantity limits (QL) are applied to drugs on this tier, restricting the dispensed quantity per fill or per period.

attributes.name: rebate_eligible

attributes.references: ERISA Plan Document Standards; CMS DIR Guidance

attributes.name: scd_version

attributes.name: specialty_pharmacy_required

attributes.references: PCMA Specialty Drug Standards; CMS Part D Formulary Guidance

attributes.name: specialty_tier

attributes.name: step_therapy_required

attributes.name: termination_date

attributes.name: tier_code

attributes.name: tier_description

attributes.name: tier_name

attributes.name: tier_status

attributes.name: tier_type
