attributes.description: Timestamp when this pharmacy record was first loaded into the Pillarrx lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trails, and SCD Type-2 version management.

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: Trade or doing-business-as name of the pharmacy when it differs from the legal name (e.g., a chain banner name). Used for consumer-facing reporting and benchmarking.

attributes.name: dea_number
attributes.description: DEA registration number authorizing the pharmacy to dispense controlled substances. Required for Schedule II-V drug dispensing compliance and audit. Format: 2 letters + 7 digits.

attributes.name: dispensing_languages
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of languages in which the pharmacy provides counseling and dispensing services (e.g., English, Spanish, Mandarin). Supports member access and health equity reporting.

attributes.name: dispensing_state_license
attributes.description: State board of pharmacy license number authorizing the pharmacy to dispense medications in its operating state. Required for regulatory compliance and PBM network credentialing.

attributes.name: drive_through
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy offers drive-through dispensing service (True). Used in member-facing network directory and access reporting for employer clients.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Start date of this Type-2 SCD record version, representing when this set of pharmacy attributes became effective. Used for point-in-time historical lookups on pharmacy claims.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: End date of this Type-2 SCD record version. Null indicates the current active version. When a pharmacy attribute changes, the prior row is closed with this date and a new row is opened.

attributes.name: fax
attributes.description: Fax number for the pharmacy. Used for prior authorization transmissions and prescriber-to-pharmacy communications in PBM workflows.

attributes.name: is_340b
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy participates in the federal 340B drug discount program (True). Critical for identifying 340B-eligible dispensing events and manufacturer program compliance.

attributes.name: is_chain
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy is part of a chain (True) or is an independent pharmacy (False). Key segmentation flag for PBM network analysis and GDR benchmarking.

attributes.name: is_current
attributes.description: Type-2 SCD flag indicating whether this row is the current (most recent) version of the pharmacy record (True) or a historical version (False). Simplifies current-state queries.

attributes.name: is_long_term_care
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy is designated as a long-term care pharmacy serving nursing facilities or assisted living. Relevant for Medicare Part D and SPAP reporting.
attributes.references: NCPDP Pharmacy File / CMS Medicare Part D

attributes.name: is_mail_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy operates as a mail-order dispensing facility (True). Mail-order pharmacies typically dispense 90-day supplies and are subject to different reimbursement guarantees.
attributes.references: NCPDP Pharmacy File / PBM Contract Terms

attributes.name: is_specialty
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy is designated as a specialty pharmacy (True). Specialty pharmacies dispense high-cost, complex medications (SMN/LDD). Drives specialty spend monitoring.
attributes.references: NCPDP Pharmacy File / URAC Specialty Pharmacy Accreditation

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the pharmacy location in decimal degrees. Used for member proximity analysis, network adequacy mapping, and geographic access reporting.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the pharmacy location in decimal degrees. Used alongside latitude for network adequacy mapping and member access distance calculations.

attributes.name: pharmacy_name
attributes.description: Legal business name of the pharmacy as registered with NCPDP and state boards of pharmacy. Used for display, reporting, and audit deliverables.

attributes.name: ncpdp_source_date
attributes.description: Date of the NCPDP Pharmacy File extract from which this record was sourced. Used for data lineage, refresh tracking, and identifying stale pharmacy reference data.

attributes.name: network_status
attributes.description: Current network participation status of the pharmacy within PBM networks managed by Pillarrx clients. Drives member cost-sharing tiers and PBM contract guarantee applicability.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: 10-digit NPI assigned to the pharmacy by CMS/NPPES. Used for crosswalk to medical claims, provider credentialing, and HIPAA standard transactions.

attributes.name: open_24_hours
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy operates 24 hours per day (True). Used in member benefit communications and network adequacy assessments for employer clients.

attributes.name: pharmacy_network_id
attributes.description: PBM-assigned network identifier for this pharmacy within a specific PBM network (e.g., CVS Caremark retail network code). Used for network tier assignment and reimbursement guarantee auditing.
attributes.references: PBM Contract Terms / Pillarrx PBM Audit

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary 10-digit telephone number for the pharmacy. Used for member outreach, prior authorization coordination, and audit contact.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this pharmacy dimension record. Active = currently dispensing; inactive = temporarily closed; terminated = permanently closed or removed from NCPDP file.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the pharmacy location. Used for state board of pharmacy compliance, state PBM transparency law reporting, and geographic trend analysis.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the pharmacy location (e.g., America/Chicago). Used for date-of-service normalization across multi-time-zone claims aggregation.

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: NCPDP-defined pharmacy type code classifying the dispensing channel (e.g., retail, mail order, specialty, long-term care, home infusion). Drives network tier and reimbursement logic.

attributes.name: type_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the pharmacy type corresponding to pharmacy_type_code (e.g., Retail, Mail Order, Specialty, Long-Term Care). Used in reporting and client deliverables.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this pharmacy record in the Pillarrx lakehouse. Used for change detection, SCD Type-2 processing, and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: 5-digit or ZIP+4 postal code for the pharmacy location. Used for geographic clustering, network adequacy, and member proximity analysis.

attributes.name: ncpdp_id
attributes.description: Identifier referencing the related ncpdp id for the pharmacy record in the drug domain.

attributes.name: pharmacy_type
attributes.description: Attribute capturing the pharmacy type for the pharmacy record in the drug domain.

attributes.name: chain_independent_status
attributes.description: Attribute capturing the chain independent status for the pharmacy record in the drug domain.

attributes.name: specialty_designation
attributes.description: Attribute capturing the specialty designation for the pharmacy record in the drug domain.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Attribute capturing the effective start date for the pharmacy record in the drug domain.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Attribute capturing the effective end date for the pharmacy record in the drug domain.

products.name: pharmacy_network
products.description: Defines PBM pharmacy network contracts and network participation records, linking a pharmacy (NCPDP ID) to a PBM network for a defined effective period. Stores network name, network type (standard retail, preferred retail, mail, specialty, narrow), PBM
products.reference: PBM Network Contract / NCPDP Network Participation

attributes.name: pharmacy_network_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each pharmacy network participation record linking a pharmacy (NCPDP ID) to a PBM network for a defined effective period.

attributes.name: company_client_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to company.company_client. Business justification: Some clients negotiate custom pharmacy networks or carve-outs (e.g., excluding mail-order, specialty-only networks).

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM that owns and administers this pharmacy network contract (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts).

attributes.name: mac_list_id
attributes.description: FK to drug.mac_list.mac_list_id — pharmacy_network already carries a MAC list reference; once mac_list exists as a first-class entity this FK supports MAC guarantee auditing.

attributes.name: ncpdp_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) ID
attributes.description: 7-digit NCPDP pharmacy identifier for the participating pharmacy. Denormalized here for direct claims matching and audit without requiring a join to the pharmacy dimension.

tag_set.value: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) ID

attributes.name: pharmacy_mac_list_fk
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pharmacy Network Pharmacy Mac List Fk
attributes.description: FK to drug.mac_list.mac_list_id — pharmacy_network carries a MAC list reference; FK to mac_list required for MAC guarantee auditing.

tag_set.value: Pharmacy Network Pharmacy Mac List Fk

attributes.name: pharmacy_mac_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to drug.mac_list. Business justification: pharmacy_network references specific MAC (Maximum Allowable Cost) lists for pricing. Currently has mac_list_name (STRING) but needs proper FK to mac_list master.

attributes.name: pharmacy_network_mac_list_fk
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pharmacy Network Pharmacy Network Mac List Fk
attributes.description: FK to drug.mac_list.mac_list_id — pharmacy_network carries a MAC list reference; now that mac_list is a first-class master this must FK to it for MAC guarantee auditing (iteration-1 request).

tag_set.value: Pharmacy Network Pharmacy Network Mac List Fk

attributes.name: pharmacy_ncpdp_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmacy dimension record (keyed by NCPDP ID) that participates in this network.

attributes.name: tertiary_pharmacy_id
attributes.description: FK to drug.pharmacy.pharmacy_id — Network participation records link a pharmacy (NCPDP) to a PBM network; FK to the pharmacy master is required for network adequacy analysis and preferred-pharmacy benchmarking.

attributes.name: awp_discount_brand_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Brand Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Percentage
attributes.description: Contracted AWP discount percentage applied to brand drug ingredient cost reimbursement for this pharmacy within this network. Core metric for PBM guarantee benchmarking (BER).

tag_set.value: Brand Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Percentage

attributes.name: awp_discount_generic_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generic Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Percentage
attributes.description: Contracted AWP discount percentage applied to generic drug ingredient cost reimbursement for this pharmacy within this network. Used in GDR and GER audit calculations.

tag_set.value: Generic Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Percentage

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: PBM pricing model type for this network contract. Pass-through means transparent ingredient cost; spread means PBM retains difference between plan paid and pharmacy reimbursement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pharmacy network participation record was first created in the lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit, and SCD version management.

attributes.name: dir_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) Applicable Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) fees apply to claims adjudicated through this pharmacy network. Relevant for Medicare Part D plan sponsors and PBM audit.

tag_set.value: Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) Applicable Indicator

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_mail
attributes.description: Contracted dispensing fee (in USD) paid to the pharmacy per mail-order fill within this network. Distinct from retail fee due to 90-day supply economics.

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_retail
attributes.description: Contracted dispensing fee (in USD) paid to the pharmacy per retail fill within this network. Used in PBM contract guarantee auditing and spread analysis.

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_specialty
attributes.description: Contracted dispensing fee (in USD) paid to the pharmacy per specialty drug fill within this network. Key input for specialty spend monitoring and PBM audit.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy's participation in this PBM network becomes effective. Used for Type-2 SCD history and claims eligibility validation.

attributes.name: is_340b
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pharmacy is a 340B covered entity or contract pharmacy within this network, eligible for federal drug discount pricing under HRSA 340B program.

attributes.name: is_mail_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pharmacy participates as a mail-order dispensing location within this network. Relevant for 90-day supply benefit design and PMPM trend analysis.

attributes.name: is_preferred
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pharmacy participates at the preferred tier within the network, typically associated with lower member cost-sharing and higher plan reimbursement rates.

attributes.name: is_specialty
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pharmacy is designated as a specialty pharmacy within this network, authorized to dispense specialty and limited-distribution drugs (LDD).

attributes.name: network_adequacy_class
attributes.description: Regulatory adequacy classification of the pharmacy network per CMS or state standards. Narrow and limited networks may trigger member access reporting requirements.
attributes.references: CMS; ACA; state pharmacy access laws

attributes.name: network_code
attributes.description: PBM-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the pharmacy network (e.g., CVS_PREF_RETAIL, ESI_MAIL). Used for claims routing and benefit adjudication.

attributes.name: network_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the pharmacy network as defined by the PBM (e.g., 'CVS Preferred Retail Network', 'Express Scripts Standard Mail').

attributes.name: network_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pharmacy network participation record. Active indicates the pharmacy is currently contracted within this network.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Cost-sharing tier designation for this pharmacy within the network. Tier 1 typically carries the lowest member cost-share; out-of-network carries the highest or no coverage.

attributes.name: network_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pharmacy network by access model. Drives member cost-sharing tiers and PBM audit benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard_retail|preferred_retail|mail|specialty|narrow|limited_distribution — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for analyst or data steward notes regarding this pharmacy network participation record, such as contract exceptions, audit findings, or onboarding remarks.

attributes.name: pbm_network_file_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pharmacy Network Pbm Network File Date
attributes.description: Date of the PBM network participation file from which this record was extracted. Used to track file vintage and detect stale network data in the lakehouse.

tag_set.value: Pharmacy Network Pbm Network File Date

attributes.name: pbm_network_id_external
attributes.description: The PBM's own internal network identifier as received in claims feeds or contract files. Preserved for reconciliation against PBM-sourced data and audit traceability.

attributes.name: rxbin
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pharmacy Claim Routing Bank Identification Number (RxBIN)
attributes.description: 6-digit BIN used to route pharmacy claims to the correct PBM processor for this network. Required for real-time adjudication and claims feed reconciliation.

tag_set.value: Pharmacy Claim Routing Bank Identification Number (RxBIN)

attributes.name: rxgroup
attributes.description: Pharmacy benefit group identifier associated with this network, used in claims adjudication to apply the correct formulary, cost-sharing, and network rules.

attributes.name: rxpcn
attributes.description: Processor Control Number used alongside RxBIN to route pharmacy claims to the correct PBM sub-processor or plan for this network.

attributes.name: scd_current_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD) Current Record Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record is the current active version of the pharmacy network participation. True for the most recent version; False for historical versions.

tag_set.value: Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD) Current Record Flag

attributes.name: scd_version
attributes.description: Monotonically increasing version number for Type-2 SCD history tracking. Each contract change or network renegotiation increments this version for the pharmacy-network combination.

attributes.name: source_record_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this record in the originating source system (e.g., PBM network file row key, NCPDP record ID). Enables upstream reconciliation and ETL traceability.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy's participation in this PBM network ends. Null indicates an open-ended active participation record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this pharmacy network participation record. Used for incremental ETL processing and change detection in the Silver layer.

products.name: drug_prescriber
products.description: Authoritative master record for prescribing providers identified by NPI, sourced from NPPES (National Plan and Provider Enumeration System). This is the SSOT for WHO prescribed the drug.

attributes.name: drug_prescriber_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the prescribing provider record in the PillarRx data lakehouse. Primary key for the drug_prescriber dimension.

attributes.name: credential
attributes.description: Professional credential or degree suffix of the prescribing provider (e.g., MD, DO, NP, PA-C, PharmD) as registered in NPPES. Indicates prescribing authority type.
attributes.references: NPPES; DEA; State Boards of Pharmacy

attributes.name: dea_number
attributes.description: DEA registration number authorizing the prescriber to prescribe controlled substances. Required for Schedule II-V drug prescriptions. Format: 2 letters + 7 digits.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date the NPI was deactivated in NPPES (e.g., provider retired, deceased, or license revoked). Null if the NPI is currently active.

attributes.name: entity_type_code
attributes.description: NPPES entity type: 1 = Individual (person), 2 = Organization. Drug prescribers are typically type 1 (individual), but group practices may appear as type 2.

attributes.name: enumeration_date
attributes.description: Date the NPI was assigned to the prescriber by NPPES. Indicates when the provider was first registered in the national provider registry.

attributes.name: erx_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prescriber is capable of transmitting electronic prescriptions (ERx). True = ERx enabled. Used in PBM workflow routing and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first name (given name) of the prescribing provider as registered in NPPES. Used for display, search, and audit reporting.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender of the prescribing provider as registered in NPPES. M = Male, F = Female, U = Unknown/Not Provided. Used for demographic reporting.

attributes.name: group_practice_pac_code
attributes.description: CMS Provider Associate-level Identifier (PAC ID) for the group practice or organization the prescriber is affiliated with. Links individual providers to group entities in CMS data.

attributes.name: individual_pac_code
attributes.description: CMS Provider Associate-level Identifier (PAC ID) uniquely assigned to the individual prescriber across all CMS enrollment records. Supports cross-program provider linkage.

attributes.name: is_controlled_substance_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prescriber holds a valid DEA registration authorizing controlled substance prescribing. True = DEA number on file and valid.

attributes.name: is_current_record
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SCD Type-2 row is the current active version of the prescriber record. True = current. Simplifies queries that need only the latest prescriber attributes.
attributes.references: PillarRx Data Lakehouse SCD Type-2 Standard

attributes.name: is_specialty_prescriber
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prescriber is classified as a specialty prescriber based on taxonomy code mapping. True = specialty prescriber. Used for specialty drug spend segmentation.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last name (family name) of the prescribing provider as registered in NPPES. Used for display, search, and audit reporting.

attributes.name: last_update_date
attributes.description: Date the prescribers NPPES record was last updated by the provider or CMS. Used to detect stale records and trigger refresh from the NPPES data feed.

attributes.name: license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation where the prescribers primary medical or prescribing license is issued. Used for cross-state prescribing compliance checks.

attributes.name: medicare_participation_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prescriber accepts Medicare assignment (Y = participating, N = non-participating). Relevant for Medicare Part D claim analysis and member cost-share.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the prescribing provider as registered in NPPES. Supports full-name disambiguation when last and first names are identical.

attributes.name: name_prefix
attributes.description: Honorific prefix for the prescribing provider (e.g., Dr., Prof.) as registered in NPPES. Used in formal correspondence and reporting displays.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS via NPPES. Primary business key for the prescriber. Used to link prescriptions to the authoritative provider record.

attributes.name: npi_status
attributes.description: Current status of the NPI in NPPES: active = valid and in use, deactivated = administratively deactivated, retired = provider no longer practicing.

attributes.name: organization_name
attributes.description: Legal organization name for entity-type-2 (organizational) NPI records, or the practice/group name associated with an individual prescriber. Sourced from NPPES.

attributes.name: pecos_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prescriber is enrolled in the CMS Provider Enrollment, Chain, and Ownership System (PECOS). Required for Medicare Part D prescribing eligibility.

attributes.name: practice_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the prescribers practice location as registered in NPPES. Used for geographic prescribing analysis and provider directory maintenance.

attributes.name: practice_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (suite, floor, unit) of the prescribers practice location as registered in NPPES. Supplements the primary address line.

attributes.name: practice_city
attributes.description: City of the prescribers primary practice location as registered in NPPES. Used for geographic segmentation in prescribing trend and benchmarking reports.

attributes.name: practice_fax
attributes.description: 10-digit fax number for the prescribers primary practice location. Used for electronic prescription routing and prior authorization document transmission.

attributes.name: practice_phone
attributes.description: 10-digit phone number for the prescribers primary practice location as registered in NPPES. Used for provider outreach and prior authorization coordination.

attributes.name: practice_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation of the prescribers primary practice location. Used for state-level prescribing analytics and cross-state dispensing compliance.

attributes.name: practice_zip
attributes.description: 5- or 9-digit US postal ZIP code of the prescribers primary practice location. Supports geographic clustering and regional prescribing pattern analysis.

attributes.name: prescriber_type
attributes.description: Broad classification of the prescribers professional role. Derived from taxonomy code. Used for prescribing authority analysis and PBM audit segmentation.
attributes.references: NUCC; NPPES; State Boards of Pharmacy

attributes.name: reactivation_date
attributes.description: Date a previously deactivated NPI was reactivated in NPPES. Null if the NPI has never been deactivated or has not been reactivated.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this prescriber record was first created in the PillarRx data lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and SCD Type-2 history management.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this prescriber record was last modified in the PillarRx data lakehouse. Used for change detection, ETL delta processing, and audit trail.

attributes.name: scd_effective_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD) Effective End Date
attributes.description: End date of the validity period for this Type-2 SCD record. Null indicates the current active version. Set when a new version supersedes this record.
attributes.references: PillarRx Data Lakehouse SCD Type-2 Standard

tag_set.value: Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD) Effective End Date

attributes.name: scd_effective_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD) Effective Start Date
attributes.description: Start date of the validity period for this Type-2 SCD record. Indicates when this version of the prescriber record became effective in the PillarRx data lakehouse.
attributes.references: PillarRx Data Lakehouse SCD Type-2 Standard

tag_set.value: Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD) Effective Start Date

attributes.name: specialty_description
attributes.description: Plain-language specialty description derived from taxonomy or PBM claim data (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Primary Care). Used for specialty drug spend segmentation.

attributes.name: state_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued medical or prescribing license number for the provider. Used in PBM audit and compliance validation to confirm prescribing authority in the dispensing state.

attributes.name: taxonomy_code
attributes.description: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy code identifying the prescribers specialty and classification (e.g., 207R00000X = Internal Medicine). Primary taxonomy from NPPES.
attributes.references: NPPES; NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy

attributes.name: taxonomy_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the NUCC taxonomy code (e.g., Internal Medicine, Family Practice, Nurse Practitioner). Used in specialty-level prescribing analytics.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy; NPPES

products.name: manufacturer
products.description: Master record for pharmaceutical manufacturers and labelers whose drugs appear in PillarRx client claims. Stores labeler code (first 5 digits of NDC), manufacturer name, parent company name, manufacturer type (brand, generic, biosimilar, OTC)
products.reference: FDA Labeler Directory / NDC Labeler Code

attributes.name: manufacturer_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the pharmaceutical manufacturer or labeler record within the PillarRx enterprise data platform.

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to company.organization. Business justification: Pharmaceutical manufacturers can also be PillarRx clients (self-insured employer health plans).

attributes.name: biosimilar_manufacturer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the manufacturer produces FDA-approved biosimilar products. Supports biosimilar substitution analysis, formulary tier strategy, and rebate benchmarking for employer clients.

attributes.name: cap_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer's copay assistance program (CAP) as tracked in the PAX application. Used for program identification in member assistance ledger and manufacturer coupon reconciliation.

attributes.name: cap_program_url
attributes.description: Web address for the manufacturer's copay assistance program enrollment or information portal. Used by PillarRx consultants and members to access CAP enrollment resources.

attributes.name: controlled_substance_manufacturer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the manufacturer produces DEA-scheduled controlled substances. Supports drug utilization review (DUR) analysis and regulatory compliance monitoring for employer plan clients.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this manufacturer record was first created in the PillarRx enterprise data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and record governance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; SOC 2; Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet 9-digit DUNS number uniquely identifying the manufacturer as a business entity. Used for cross-referencing manufacturer identity in rebate contracts and consulting engagements.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this manufacturer record version was superseded or expired. NULL indicates the current active version. Supports Type-2 SCD history for point-in-time drug reference and rebate analysis.
attributes.references: Internal PillarRx SCD Type-2 Standard; Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this manufacturer record version became effective. Supports Type-2 slowly changing dimension (SCD) history tracking for the drug reference domain, enabling point-in-time drug reference lookups.
attributes.references: Internal PillarRx SCD Type-2 Standard; Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span

attributes.name: fda_establishment_code
attributes.description: FDA-assigned establishment identifier for the manufacturer's registered drug production facility. Supports regulatory compliance tracking and drug sourcing validation.
attributes.references: FDA Drug Establishment Registration; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: has_cap_program
attributes.description: Indicates whether the manufacturer offers a copay assistance program (CAP) such as copay cards or coupons managed through the PAX application. Supports affordability intelligence and member OOP optimization.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the manufacturer's corporate headquarters. Used for business correspondence, contract management, and manufacturer program administration.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary street address line (suite, floor, building) of the manufacturer's corporate headquarters. Supplements the primary address for complete mailing and contract records.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: City of the manufacturer's corporate headquarters. Used in geographic analysis of manufacturer distribution and for contract correspondence.

attributes.name: headquarters_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the manufacturer's corporate headquarters. Identifies domestic vs. international manufacturers relevant to 340B and import regulations.

attributes.name: headquarters_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code of the manufacturer's corporate headquarters. Used for geographic segmentation and mailing address validation.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Standard; FDA NDC Directory

attributes.name: headquarters_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code of the manufacturer's corporate headquarters. Supports state-level regulatory compliance and geographic reporting.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviation Standard; FDA NDC Directory

attributes.name: is_340b_participating
attributes.description: Indicates whether the manufacturer participates in the federal 340B Drug Pricing Program, which requires covered entities to receive discounted drug prices. Critical for 340B compliance and audit analysis.

attributes.name: is_current_record
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this row is the current active version of the manufacturer record in the Type-2 SCD history. True = current; False = historical version. Simplifies current-state queries.

attributes.name: is_rebate_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the manufacturer has active rebate agreements applicable to PillarRx client plans. Drives rebate reconciliation workflows and PBM contract guarantee auditing.

attributes.name: labeler_code
attributes.description: FDA-assigned 5-digit labeler code representing the first segment of the 11-digit NDC. Uniquely identifies the manufacturer or labeler responsible for the drug product.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Labeler Code Standard; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: ldd_manufacturer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the manufacturer produces limited distribution drugs (LDD) that are only available through select specialty pharmacies. Critical for specialty pharmacy network analysis and client consulting.

attributes.name: manufacturer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the manufacturer record. Inactive, acquired, merged, or dissolved statuses indicate the labeler is no longer independently operating and may affect drug reference validity.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: manufacturer_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the manufacturer by the primary nature of its drug portfolio: brand (innovator), generic, biosimilar, over-the-counter (OTC), or combination. Drives rebate strategy and formulary analysis.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB); FDA Drug Classification

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Legal or trade name of the pharmaceutical manufacturer or labeler as registered with the FDA. Used as the primary human-readable identifier in drug reference lookups and consulting reports.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name

products.name: mac_list
products.description: Master record for each Maximum Allowable Cost (MAC) list referenced by PBM networks and pharmacy reimbursement. A MAC list is a PBM-published or custom pricing list that sets the maximum per-unit reimbursement for multi-source generic drugs.

attributes.name: appeal_process_available

attributes.name: appeal_turnaround_days

attributes.name: list_name

attributes.name: list_status

attributes.name: list_type

attributes.name: network_scope

products.name: equivalence
products.description: NDC-to-GPI therapeutic-equivalence and generic-substitution crosswalk. This product is the SSOT for SUBSTITUTION/INTERCHANGE semantics (not clinical classification — see classification).

attributes.name: equivalence_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each NDC-to-GPI therapeutic equivalence and generic substitution crosswalk record.

attributes.name: awp_savings_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage cost savings when substituting the source NDC with the equivalent NDC, calculated from AWP unit prices at time of crosswalk creation. Used in savings opportunity reporting.

attributes.name: biosimilar_interchangeable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equivalent NDC is an FDA-designated interchangeable biosimilar to the source biologic. Interchangeable biosimilars may be substituted without prescriber intervention.
attributes.references: FDA Biosimilar Product Information; BPCIA (Biologics Price Competition and Innovation Act)

attributes.name: cap_substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this equivalence pair is relevant to copay assistance program (CAP) substitution logic in the PAX application. Flags pairs where a brand-to-generic switch may affect CAP eligibility.
attributes.references: Internal PillarRx PAX CAP Management Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this equivalence crosswalk record was first created in the PillarRx lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data governance requirements.
attributes.references: Internal PillarRx Data Governance Standard; HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: dosage_form_match
attributes.description: Indicates whether the source and equivalent NDCs share the same dosage form (e.g., tablet, capsule, solution). A mismatch may restrict substitution eligibility under state pharmacy law.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; State Boards of Pharmacy

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this equivalence crosswalk relationship became effective. Used in time-bounded formulary analysis and historical claims auditing to apply the correct equivalence at date of service.

attributes.name: equivalence_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this equivalence crosswalk record. Active records are used in live formulary and claims analysis; superseded records are retained for historical audit.

attributes.name: equivalence_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the equivalence relationship. Drives substitution logic in formulary analysis, generic dispensing rate (GDR) calculations, and copay assistance program (CAP) eligibility.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book; Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span

attributes.name: equivalent_drug_name
attributes.description: Human-readable drug name for the equivalent NDC as sourced from Medi-Span or FDB. Supports analyst readability and reporting without requiring a join to the NDC dimension.

attributes.name: equivalent_generic_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equivalent NDC is a brand, generic, or branded generic product. Confirms the substitution direction (e.g., brand-to-generic) for GDR and savings opportunity reporting.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; FDA Orange Book

attributes.name: equivalent_gpi14
attributes.description: The 14-digit GPI code of the equivalent NDC. Enables GPI-level therapeutic grouping and substitution logic independent of specific NDC packaging variants.

attributes.name: equivalent_multisource_code
attributes.description: Medi-Span multisource code for the equivalent NDC. Confirms the equivalent is a true generic (Y) or multisource brand (M) for substitution and GDR reporting purposes.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span Multisource Code Standard

attributes.name: equivalent_ndc11
attributes.description: The 11-digit NDC of the therapeutically equivalent or generic substitute drug. Represents the target side of the substitution crosswalk used in formulary analysis and claims auditing.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this equivalence crosswalk relationship expires or was superseded. Null indicates an open-ended active relationship. Supports Type-2 SCD history for the drug dimension.

attributes.name: formulary_substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this equivalence pair is actively used in formulary-level substitution recommendations for PillarRx client plan analysis. Distinguishes reference data from operationally applied substitutions.

attributes.name: gpi10_match
attributes.description: Indicates whether the source and equivalent NDCs share the same 10-digit GPI prefix, confirming same drug, strength, and dosage form. Used to validate the precision of the equivalence relationship.

attributes.name: gpi12_match
attributes.description: Indicates whether the source and equivalent NDCs share the same 12-digit GPI prefix, confirming same drug, strength, dosage form, and route. Provides finer equivalence precision than GPI10.

attributes.name: is_current
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the current active version of the equivalence crosswalk record. Supports Type-2 slowly changing dimension (SCD) pattern for the drug equivalence history table.
attributes.references: Internal PillarRx SCD Type-2 Data Standard

attributes.name: ldd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the source or equivalent NDC is a limited distribution drug (LDD), restricting dispensing to select specialty pharmacies. LDD status may prevent substitution in standard retail networks.
attributes.references: FDA Limited Distribution Drug Policy; HRSA 340B Program

attributes.name: orange_book_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: FDA Orange Book Therapeutic Equivalence Code
attributes.description: FDA Orange Book therapeutic equivalence evaluation code (e.g., AB, AA, BX) for the equivalent NDC relative to the source. AB-rated products are considered therapeutically equivalent and substitutable.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book (Approved Drug Products with Therapeutic Equivalence Evaluations)

tag_set.value: FDA Orange Book Therapeutic Equivalence Code

attributes.name: reference_source
attributes.description: The authoritative external data source from which this equivalence relationship was derived. Medi-Span and FDB are primary sources; Orange Book is used for FDA therapeutic equivalence codes.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB); FDA Orange Book

attributes.name: reference_source_version
attributes.description: Version or release identifier of the external reference source file from which this equivalence record was loaded. Supports data lineage, audit, and refresh cycle tracking.

attributes.name: route_match
attributes.description: Indicates whether the source and equivalent NDCs share the same route of administration (e.g., oral, injectable). Route mismatches typically disqualify automatic substitution.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; State Boards of Pharmacy

attributes.name: source_drug_name
attributes.description: Human-readable drug name for the source NDC as sourced from Medi-Span or FDB. Supports analyst readability and reporting without requiring a join to the NDC dimension.

attributes.name: source_generic_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the source NDC is a brand, generic, or branded generic product. Used in generic dispensing rate (GDR) analysis and substitution opportunity identification.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span; FDA Orange Book

attributes.name: source_gpi14
attributes.description: The 14-digit GPI code of the source NDC, representing its full therapeutic classification hierarchy from Medi-Span. Used to group drugs by therapeutic equivalence class.

attributes.name: source_load_date
attributes.description: The date on which the source reference file (Medi-Span or FDB) containing this equivalence record was loaded into the PillarRx lakehouse. Supports data lineage and refresh cycle auditing.
attributes.references: Internal PillarRx ETL Data Lineage Standard

attributes.name: source_multisource_code
attributes.description: Medi-Span multisource code for the source NDC. M=multisource brand, O=originator brand, N=single-source brand, Y=generic. Drives substitution eligibility logic.
attributes.references: Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span Multisource Code Standard

attributes.name: specialty_substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether either the source or equivalent NDC is classified as a specialty medication (SMN). Specialty substitutions require additional clinical and formulary review before application.

attributes.name: strength_match
attributes.description: Indicates whether the source and equivalent NDCs have the same drug strength. Strength mismatches require prescriber authorization before substitution and affect DAW code compliance.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; NCPDP DAW Code Standard

attributes.name: substitution_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equivalent NDC is permitted as a generic substitute for the source NDC under applicable state pharmacy law and formulary policy. Core flag for DAW code analysis.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy; NCPDP DAW Code Standard

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this equivalence crosswalk record was last modified in the PillarRx lakehouse. Used to detect stale records and trigger downstream refresh in formulary and claims analysis pipelines.
attributes.references: Internal PillarRx Data Governance Standard; HIPAA Security Rule

products.name: mac_pricing
products.description: This association product represents the pricing relationship between an NDC and a MAC list. It captures the Maximum Allowable Cost price for a specific drug on a specific PBM MAC list, including effective dates, pricing basis, and appeal status.

attributes.name: mac_pricing_id
attributes.description: Surrogate primary key for this MAC pricing record. Supports historical tracking of price changes for the same NDC-MAC list combination.

attributes.name: mac_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the MAC list that contains this NDC pricing

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of any pharmacy appeal of this MAC price. State PBM transparency laws require appeal processes for MAC prices below pharmacy acquisition cost.

attributes.name: awp_discount_percentage
attributes.description: If this MAC price is expressed as a discount off AWP, this field captures the discount percentage (e.g., 80.00 for AWP-20%). Null if MAC is not AWP-based.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this MAC price becomes effective for this NDC on this MAC list. Critical for point-in-time pricing analysis and PBM audit.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this MAC price expires or is superseded by a new price. Null indicates the price is currently active. Enables historical price tracking.

attributes.name: is_current
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the current active MAC price for this NDC on this MAC list. Supports Type-2 SCD historical tracking.

attributes.name: mac_price
attributes.description: The Maximum Allowable Cost price for this NDC on this MAC list, expressed per unit defined by pricing_basis. This is the maximum reimbursement amount the PBM will pay pharmacies for this drug.

attributes.name: pharmacy_acquisition_cost
attributes.description: The estimated pharmacy acquisition cost for this NDC at the time this MAC price was set. Used to identify below-cost MAC pricing that may trigger pharmacy appeals.

attributes.name: price_source
attributes.description: The external drug pricing reference used to derive this MAC price (e.g., Medi-Span, FDB, NADAC, AMP). Used for PBM audit and pricing methodology validation.

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: Defines the unit of measure for this MAC price: per dispensing unit (tablet, capsule), per package, per mL, or per gram. Required to correctly apply MAC pricing to claims.

attributes.name: scd_effective_date
attributes.description: Start date of the current SCD Type-2 record version for this MAC pricing entry. Enables point-in-time historical queries.

attributes.name: scd_expiration_date
attributes.description: End date of the current SCD Type-2 record version. Set to a high-date (9999-12-31) for the current active version.

attributes.name: update_frequency
attributes.description: How frequently the PBM updates the MAC price for this NDC on this list. Relevant for PBM audit and price volatility analysis.
