attributes.name: data_feed_config_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the PBM data feed configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: PBM source system providing the data feed (CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts, Navitus, etc.).

attributes.name: data_assignment_fk
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Feed Config Data Assignment Fk
attributes.description: FK to client.pbm_assignment.pbm_assignment_id — Each PBM data feed config corresponds to an employer-PBM relationship. Required for correct feed-to-PBM mapping.

tag_set.value: Data Feed Config Data Assignment Fk

attributes.name: data_employer_id
attributes.description: Employer client for whom this PBM data feed is configured.

attributes.name: data_pbm_assignment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Feed Config Data Pbm Assignment Id
attributes.description: FK to client.pbm_assignment.pbm_assignment_id — Each data feed config is per employer-PBM pipeline; the employer-PBM relationship is owned by pbm_assignment, making it the natural scoping parent for the feed.

tag_set.value: Data Feed Config Data Pbm Assignment Id

attributes.name: employer_id
attributes.description: FK to client.employer.employer_id — Each PBM data feed is configured on behalf of a specific employer client.

attributes.name: pbm_assignment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Feed Config Pbm Assignment Id
attributes.description: FK to client.pbm_assignment.pbm_assignment_id — Each PBM data feed is configured per employer-PBM pipeline; the feed config should resolve to the pbm_assignment (which owns the employer-PBM relationship and routing) rather than to a bare employer.

tag_set.value: Data Feed Config Pbm Assignment Id

attributes.name: primary_pbm_assignment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Feed Config Primary Pbm Assignment Id
attributes.description: FK to client.pbm_assignment.pbm_assignment_id — A data feed config ingests a specific employer-PBM pipeline; FK to the PBM assignment resolves which relationship the feed serves.

tag_set.value: Data Feed Config Primary Pbm Assignment Id

attributes.name: api_authentication_method
attributes.description: Authentication mechanism for API access (OAuth2, API key, basic auth, bearer token, certificate, none).

attributes.name: api_endpoint_url
attributes.description: API endpoint URL for real-time or on-demand data retrieval.

attributes.name: character_encoding
attributes.description: Character encoding standard used in the data files (UTF-8, UTF-16, ASCII, ISO-8859-1, Windows-1252).

attributes.name: compression_format
attributes.description: Compression format applied to data files (none, zip, gzip, tar, 7z).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this feed configuration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_retention_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Feed Config Data Retention Days
attributes.description: Number of days raw feed files are retained in the ingestion platform before archival or deletion.

tag_set.value: Data Feed Config Data Retention Days

attributes.name: date_format
attributes.description: Date format convention used in the data files (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD, MM/DD/YYYY, YYYYMMDD).

attributes.name: delimiter_character
attributes.description: Character used to delimit fields in flat files (e.g., pipe |, comma, tab, semicolon).

attributes.name: delivery_frequency
attributes.description: How often the PBM delivers data files (daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, quarterly, on-demand, real-time). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|biweekly|monthly|quarterly|on_demand|real_time — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Mechanism by which the PBM delivers data files (SFTP, FTPS, API, S3 bucket, Azure Blob, email, manual upload). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sftp|ftps|api|s3_bucket|azure_blob|email|manual_upload — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: delivery_schedule
attributes.description: Specific schedule or time window when files are expected (e.g., daily at 2:00 AM EST, first business day of month).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this feed configuration became active and operational.

attributes.name: encryption_method
attributes.description: Encryption method applied to data files in transit or at rest (none, PGP, AES-256, TLS, SSL).

attributes.name: error_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable percentage of records with validation errors before the entire file is rejected.

attributes.name: feed_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying this feed configuration within the PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform.

attributes.name: feed_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name for this data feed configuration (e.g., CVS Caremark Claims Feed - Client ABC).

attributes.name: feed_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the data feed configuration.

attributes.name: feed_type
attributes.description: Category of data delivered by this feed (pharmacy claims, eligibility, formulary, prior authorization, rebate, medical claims).

attributes.name: file_extension
attributes.description: Expected file extension for incoming data files (e.g., .txt, .csv, .dat, .xml, .json).

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: Format of the data files delivered by the PBM (EDI 835, flat file, CSV, pipe-delimited, tab-delimited, fixed-width, XML, JSON, proprietary). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: edi_835|flat_file|csv|pipe_delimited|tab_delimited|fixed_width|xml|json|proprietary — 9

attributes.name: file_naming_pattern
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Feed Config File Naming Pattern
attributes.description: Expected file naming convention or regex pattern for incoming files (e.g., CLAIMS_YYYYMMDD_*.txt).

tag_set.value: Data Feed Config File Naming Pattern

attributes.name: footer_row_present
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Feed Config Footer Row Present
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data file contains a footer row with summary or control totals.

tag_set.value: Data Feed Config Footer Row Present

attributes.name: header_row_present
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Feed Config Header Row Present
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data file contains a header row with column names.

tag_set.value: Data Feed Config Header Row Present

attributes.name: last_successful_load_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Feed Config Last Successful Load Date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent successful data file ingestion for this feed.

tag_set.value: Data Feed Config Last Successful Load Date

attributes.name: next_expected_delivery_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Feed Config Next Expected Delivery Date
attributes.description: Date when the next data file delivery is expected based on the delivery schedule.

tag_set.value: Data Feed Config Next Expected Delivery Date

attributes.name: notification_email_list
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Feed Config Notification Email List
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses to notify on feed success, failure, or anomaly detection.

tag_set.value: Data Feed Config Notification Email List

attributes.name: pbm_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary PBM contact for feed-related issues and coordination.

attributes.name: pbm_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact at the PBM responsible for this data feed.

attributes.name: pbm_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary PBM contact for urgent feed-related escalations.

attributes.name: sftp_directory_path
attributes.business_glossary_term: Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) Directory Path
attributes.description: Directory path on the SFTP server where files are deposited.

tag_set.value: Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) Directory Path

attributes.name: sftp_host
attributes.description: SFTP server hostname or IP address for file retrieval.

attributes.name: sftp_port
attributes.description: SFTP server port number (typically 22 for SFTP).

attributes.name: sftp_username
attributes.description: Username credential for SFTP authentication.

attributes.name: sla_delivery_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours allowed for file delivery per the SLA with the PBM.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this feed configuration was terminated or decommissioned.

attributes.name: text_qualifier
attributes.description: Character used to qualify text fields in flat files (e.g., double quote, single quote, none).

attributes.name: timestamp_format
attributes.description: Timestamp format convention used in the data files (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, ISO 8601).

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: Timezone in which date and timestamp values are expressed (e.g., EST, UTC, America/New_York).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this feed configuration record was last modified.

attributes.name: validation_rules_applied
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Feed Config Validation Rules Applied
attributes.description: Summary of data quality and validation rules applied during ingestion (e.g., NDC format check, date range validation).

tag_set.value: Data Feed Config Validation Rules Applied

products.name: client_benefit_group
products.description: Defines a benefit group (BG) — the population-segmentation grain within an employer client's pharmacy benefit, to which members and claims are scoped (VREQ-003).

attributes.name: client_benefit_group_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a benefit group record within a client's pharmacy benefit plan. Primary key for the client_benefit_group entity.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Benefit Group Benefit Plan Id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent pharmacy benefit plan under which this benefit group is defined. A plan may contain multiple benefit groups segmenting the member population.

tag_set.value: Client Benefit Group Benefit Plan Id

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM administering this benefit group. Enables multi-PBM scoping where a client may have different benefit groups serviced by different PBMs.

attributes.name: division_formulary_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the drug formulary (covered drug list) assigned to this benefit group. Determines which drugs are covered, at what tier, and with what cost-sharing for members in this group.
attributes.references: CMS Formulary Requirements, NCPDP, Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: employer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employer client that owns this benefit group. Scopes the benefit group within the Company > Division > Client hierarchy.

attributes.name: mac_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to drug.mac_list. Business justification: Benefit groups may reference specific MAC lists for generic pricing configuration. Supports benefit design analysis, pricing validation, and multi-PBM benchmarking across client benefit

attributes.name: pbm_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.pbm_assignment. Business justification: A client benefit group is scoped to a specific PBM assignment. The rx_group, rx_bin, and rx_pcn identifiers on client_benefit_group are PBM-specific routing codes that belong to the

attributes.name: accumulator_adjustment_program
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit group participates in an accumulator adjustment program, preventing manufacturer copay card payments from counting toward the member's deductible or OOP max.
attributes.references: CMS Accumulator Adjustment Program Rules, ACA, Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: bg_code
attributes.description: The PBM-assigned or client-assigned alphanumeric code identifying this benefit group. Used in eligibility feeds and claim routing. Maps to the RxGroup or BG code in PBM systems.

attributes.name: bg_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the benefit group's purpose, eligibility criteria, or population segment. Supports consulting documentation and client onboarding context.

attributes.name: bg_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for the benefit group as defined by the client or PBM (e.g., 'Active Employees', 'Retirees', 'COBRA', 'Part-Time'). Used in reporting and member eligibility displays.

attributes.name: bg_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit group. Controls whether members can be enrolled and claims can be adjudicated against this group.

attributes.name: bg_type
attributes.description: Classification of the member population segment this benefit group covers. Drives cost-sharing rules and formulary assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active_employee|retiree|cobra|dependent|part_time|medicare|medicaid|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ERISA, CMS Medicare Part D, Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: brand_penalty_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Benefit Group Brand Penalty Amount
attributes.description: Additional member cost-share applied when a brand drug is dispensed and a generic equivalent is available, per the DAW policy. Used in generic substitution savings analysis.

tag_set.value: Client Benefit Group Brand Penalty Amount

attributes.name: cap_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether members in this benefit group are eligible to participate in copay assistance programs (CAP) managed via the PAX application. Drives CAP enrollment eligibility logic.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit group record was first created in the PillarRx data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOC 2, HIPAA Security Rule, Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: daw_policy
attributes.description: The benefit group's policy governing brand vs. generic dispensing. Controls whether a brand penalty applies when a generic equivalent is available. Drives GDR analysis.
attributes.references: NCPDP DAW Code Standard, Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this benefit group becomes active and members may begin using benefits. Aligns with the plan year start or mid-year enrollment event.
attributes.references: ERISA, HIPAA, Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: eligibility_feed_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Benefit Group Eligibility Feed Code
attributes.description: The code used to identify this benefit group in inbound eligibility files from the client or PBM. Used during ETL normalization to map raw eligibility records to the correct benefit group.
attributes.references: HIPAA 834 Benefit Enrollment Transaction, Internal PillarRx Data Standard

tag_set.value: Client Benefit Group Eligibility Feed Code

attributes.name: family_deductible_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Benefit Group Family Deductible Amount
attributes.description: Annual aggregate deductible amount for a family unit before the plan begins paying pharmacy benefits. Applies when a subscriber and dependents are enrolled together under this benefit group.
attributes.references: ACA, ERISA, IRS HSA Deductible Rules

tag_set.value: Client Benefit Group Family Deductible Amount

attributes.name: family_oop_max
attributes.description: Maximum annual out-of-pocket cost for a family unit under this benefit group. Aggregate cap across all covered family members. Used in MOOP and TrOOP analysis for consulting deliverables.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302, ERISA, Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: individual_deductible_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Benefit Group Individual Deductible Amount
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount an individual member must satisfy before the plan begins paying pharmacy benefits for this benefit group. Used in OOP accumulator tracking and audit analysis.
attributes.references: ACA, ERISA, IRS HSA Deductible Rules

tag_set.value: Client Benefit Group Individual Deductible Amount

attributes.name: individual_oop_max
attributes.description: Maximum annual out-of-pocket cost an individual member will pay for pharmacy benefits under this benefit group. After this limit is reached, the plan pays 100% of covered drug costs.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302, ERISA, Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: mail_days_supply_limit
attributes.description: Maximum days supply dispensed per fill via mail order pharmacy under this benefit group (e.g., 90 days). Used in mail order utilization and cost-efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: mail_order_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit group mandates mail order dispensing for maintenance medications after a defined number of retail fills. Drives mail order compliance reporting.

attributes.name: pa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization is required for certain drugs under this benefit group. Enables PA utilization analysis and audit of PA approval rates.
attributes.references: ERISA, CMS, Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: pbm_bg_external_code
attributes.description: The PBM's own internal identifier for this benefit group as received in claims feeds or eligibility files. Enables reconciliation between PillarRx's normalized BG record and the source PBM system.

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: The four-digit calendar or fiscal plan year this benefit group is associated with (e.g., 2024). Used for annual deductible and out-of-pocket accumulator resets and year-over-year trend analysis.

attributes.name: quantity_limit_enforced
attributes.description: Indicates whether quantity limits are enforced on drug dispensing for this benefit group. Drives QL exception and override analysis in PBM audit engagements.
attributes.references: ERISA, CMS, Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: retail_days_supply_limit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Benefit Group Retail Days Supply Limit
attributes.description: Maximum days supply dispensed per fill at a retail pharmacy under this benefit group (e.g., 30 days). Drives quantity limit enforcement and mail order mandate analysis.

tag_set.value: Client Benefit Group Retail Days Supply Limit

attributes.name: specialty_coinsurance_pct
attributes.description: Member coinsurance percentage applied to specialty drug claims under this benefit group (e.g., 20.00 = 20%). Used in specialty spend analysis and affordability intelligence reporting.
attributes.references: ERISA, ACA, Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: specialty_oop_max
attributes.description: Annual out-of-pocket cap specific to specialty medications for members in this benefit group. Separate from the overall OOP max when the plan applies a specialty-specific limit.
attributes.references: ACA, ERISA, Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: specialty_pharmacy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether specialty medications must be dispensed through a designated specialty pharmacy network for this benefit group. Drives specialty channel compliance analysis.

attributes.name: step_therapy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether step therapy protocols are enforced for this benefit group, requiring members to try lower-cost alternatives before higher-cost drugs are covered.
attributes.references: ERISA, CMS, Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which this benefit group is no longer active. Null for open-ended groups. Used in eligibility validation and claims adjudication boundary checks.
attributes.references: ERISA, HIPAA, Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: tier1_copay_mail
attributes.description: Fixed member copay for Tier 1 (generic) drugs dispensed via mail order pharmacy under this benefit group. Typically lower than retail to incentivize mail order utilization.

attributes.name: tier1_copay_retail
attributes.description: Fixed member copay amount for Tier 1 (typically generic) drugs dispensed at a retail pharmacy under this benefit group. Core cost-sharing parameter for member OOP analysis.

attributes.name: tier2_copay_mail
attributes.description: Fixed member copay for Tier 2 (preferred brand) drugs dispensed via mail order pharmacy under this benefit group.

attributes.name: tier2_copay_retail
attributes.description: Fixed member copay amount for Tier 2 (typically preferred brand) drugs dispensed at a retail pharmacy under this benefit group.

attributes.name: tier3_copay_mail
attributes.description: Fixed member copay for Tier 3 (non-preferred brand) drugs dispensed via mail order pharmacy under this benefit group.

attributes.name: tier3_copay_retail
attributes.description: Fixed member copay amount for Tier 3 (typically non-preferred brand) drugs dispensed at a retail pharmacy under this benefit group.

attributes.name: tier4_copay_retail
attributes.description: Fixed member copay amount for Tier 4 drugs (typically specialty or non-formulary) dispensed at a retail pharmacy under this benefit group. May be null if tier 4 uses coinsurance instead.

attributes.name: tier_count
attributes.description: Number of formulary cost-sharing tiers defined for this benefit group (e.g., 3 for generic/preferred brand/non-preferred, 4 for specialty tier). Drives copay and coinsurance structure analysis.
attributes.references: CMS Formulary Tier Standards, Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: troop_accumulator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit group applies TrOOP accumulator logic, which excludes third-party copay assistance payments from counting toward the member's OOP maximum.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D TrOOP Rules, ACA Accumulator Adjustment Rules

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit group record was last modified in the PillarRx data platform. Used for change detection in downstream ETL processes and SCD Type-2 history management.
attributes.references: SOC 2, HIPAA Security Rule, Internal PillarRx Data Standard

products.name: cap_program_enrollment
products.description: Records an employer client's enrollment and eligibility configuration for a copay-assistance program (CAP) managed through PillarRx's PAX application. Captures the program name/sponsor, enrollment effective and termination dates, eligible

attributes.name: cap_program_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a CAP program enrollment record in the PAX application. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cap Program Enrollment Benefit Plan Id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employer benefit plan under which this CAP enrollment is scoped. Determines cost-sharing rules and accumulator behavior.

tag_set.value: Cap Program Enrollment Benefit Plan Id

attributes.name: cap_employer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employer client whose benefit plan members are enrolled in this copay assistance program. Links to the client domain.

attributes.name: client_consulting_engagement_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cap Program Enrollment Client Consulting Engagement Id
attributes.description: FK to client.client_consulting_engagement.client_consulting_engagement_id — CAP management is delivered under a consulting engagement; FK ties the enrollment to the engagement that bills for it.

tag_set.value: Cap Program Enrollment Client Consulting Engagement Id

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the member (patient) enrolled in this CAP program. Ties the enrollment to the Member 360 golden record.

attributes.name: primary_employer_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cap Program Enrollment Primary Employer Id
attributes.description: FK to client.employer.employer_id — CAP enrollment is scoped to an employer client population; must resolve to its parent employer.

tag_set.value: Cap Program Enrollment Primary Employer Id

attributes.name: accumulator_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer plan applies an accumulator adjustment program (AAP) that prevents CAP assistance from counting toward the member's deductible or OOP.
attributes.references: CMS Final Rule 2020; ACA §2707; PAX Application

attributes.name: annual_benefit_max
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount of copay assistance the member may receive from this program within a plan year. Null if no annual cap is defined by the sponsor.

attributes.name: annual_benefit_remaining
attributes.description: Remaining dollar amount of copay assistance available to the member for the current plan year (annual_benefit_max minus annual_benefit_used). Null if no annual cap.

attributes.name: annual_benefit_used
attributes.description: Cumulative dollar amount of copay assistance applied to the member's claims under this program in the current plan year. Updated as claims are reconciled in PAX.

attributes.name: bin_number
attributes.description: 6-digit BIN (RxBIN) on the copay card used to route the CAP claim at the pharmacy point of sale. Required for copay card program types.

attributes.name: cap_enrollment_benefit_group_fk
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cap Program Enrollment Cap Enrollment Benefit Group Fk
attributes.description: FK to client.benefit_group.benefit_group_id — CAP eligibility is scoped to eligible benefit group(s); required to target enrolled populations.

tag_set.value: Cap Program Enrollment Cap Enrollment Benefit Group Fk

attributes.name: consent_on_file_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member's signed consent or authorization for CAP program participation and data sharing is on file in PAX, as required by HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR §164.508; PAX Application

attributes.name: copay_card_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cap Program Enrollment Copay Card Number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the physical or virtual copay assistance card issued to the member for this program. Used for card tracking and reconciliation in PAX.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR §164.514; PAX Application

tag_set.value: Cap Program Enrollment Copay Card Number

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CAP enrollment record was first created in the PAX application or the data lakehouse. ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: PAX Application; SOC 2 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: Brand or generic name of the drug covered by this copay assistance enrollment, as recorded at time of enrollment for audit and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the member's CAP enrollment becomes active and copay assistance benefits may be applied to eligible claims.

attributes.name: enrolled_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the PillarRx staff member, hub representative, or system process that initiated the CAP enrollment in PAX.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the member was enrolled in the CAP program (e.g., PAX portal, phone, hub services). Used for operational and engagement analytics.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the member was enrolled in the CAP program. Represents the business event date, distinct from the record audit timestamp.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the member's enrollment in the copay assistance program within PAX.

attributes.name: hub_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer patient services hub (e.g., Lilly Cares, Pfizer RxPathways) associated with this CAP program, if applicable.

attributes.name: income_verification_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cap Program Enrollment Income Verification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the manufacturer program requires income verification or financial need attestation as a condition of CAP enrollment eligibility.

tag_set.value: Cap Program Enrollment Income Verification Required Flag

attributes.name: income_verified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cap Program Enrollment Income Verified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether income verification has been completed and confirmed for this member's CAP enrollment, when required by the program.

tag_set.value: Cap Program Enrollment Income Verified Flag

attributes.name: limited_distribution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is a Limited Distribution Drug (LDD), available only through select specialty pharmacies, affecting where the CAP benefit can be applied.

attributes.name: manufacturer_enrollment_code
attributes.description: Enrollment identifier assigned by the manufacturer or their hub for this member's participation in the copay assistance program. Used for cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: member_id_on_card
attributes.description: Member identifier printed on or associated with the copay assistance card issued to the member. May differ from the internal member_id. PHI/PII per HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR §164.514; PAX Application

attributes.name: ndc
attributes.description: 11-digit FDA National Drug Code identifying the specific drug covered by this CAP enrollment. Ties the enrollment to the drug reference dimension.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; HIPAA Transaction Standard

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by PillarRx staff regarding this CAP enrollment, such as special handling instructions, escalation context, or program-specific conditions.

attributes.name: pa_approval_number
attributes.description: Authorization number issued by the PBM or plan approving the drug for coverage, required for CAP benefit application when prior_auth_required_flag is true.

attributes.name: pax_enrollment_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cap Program Enrollment Pax Enrollment Number
attributes.description: External-facing enrollment reference number assigned by the PAX application. Used for member communications, hub coordination, and manufacturer reconciliation.

tag_set.value: Cap Program Enrollment Pax Enrollment Number

attributes.name: pcn
attributes.description: Processor Control Number (RxPCN) on the copay card used alongside BIN for pharmacy claim routing for this CAP program.

attributes.name: per_fill_benefit_max
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount of copay assistance the member may receive per prescription fill under this program. Null if no per-fill cap is defined.

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: Four-digit calendar year of the employer benefit plan year to which this CAP enrollment and its benefit accumulators apply (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: prior_auth_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a prior authorization (PA) is required by the plan or manufacturer program before CAP benefits can be applied for this enrollment.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the CAP program within the PAX application. Used for reporting and cross-reference.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the copay assistance program as defined by the manufacturer or sponsor (e.g., 'Humira Complete Savings Card').

attributes.name: program_sponsor_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cap Program Enrollment Program Sponsor Name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer or organization sponsoring the copay assistance program (e.g., AbbVie, Pfizer, Janssen). Used for manufacturer program management reporting.

tag_set.value: Cap Program Enrollment Program Sponsor Name

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the copay assistance mechanism. Determines how the benefit is applied and reconciled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: copay_card|coupon|rebate|patient_assistance|foundation_grant — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rx_group
attributes.description: Group identifier on the copay card used for pharmacy claim routing and benefit identification for this CAP program.

attributes.name: specialty_drug_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cap Program Enrollment Specialty Drug Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug covered by this CAP enrollment is classified as a specialty medication (SMN), which may affect program eligibility and benefit limits.
attributes.references: PAX Application; PBM Specialty Drug Classification

tag_set.value: Cap Program Enrollment Specialty Drug Flag

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the member's CAP enrollment ends. Null for open-ended enrollments. May be set by program expiry, member disenrollment, or plan year end.

attributes.description: Contracted AWP discount percentage for brand drugs dispensed via mail-order pharmacy. Used in mail-order guarantee reconciliation.

tag_set.value: Mail Order Brand Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount

attributes.name: mail_dispensing_fee
attributes.description: Contracted per-claim dispensing fee (in USD) paid to mail-order pharmacies under this contract. Used in dispensing-fee guarantee reconciliation.

attributes.name: mail_generic_awp_discount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mail Order Generic Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount
attributes.description: Contracted AWP discount percentage for generic drugs dispensed via mail-order pharmacy. Typically higher than retail due to volume.

tag_set.value: Mail Order Generic Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount

attributes.name: mail_order_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract requires mandatory mail-order dispensing for maintenance medications. Affects member cost-sharing and pharmacy channel routing.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for consulting team annotations regarding contract terms, negotiation history, or audit findings relevant to this contract version.

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days of advance written notice required to terminate this contract. Critical for client transition planning and PBM audit engagement timelines.

attributes.name: pbm_fk
attributes.description: FK to company.pbm.pbm_id — Each contract binds a Client to a specific PBM; the PBM master is required to interpret BIN/PCN routing and contract model. No engineer would ship the contract table without this FK.

attributes.name: claim_pbm_id
attributes.description: FK to company.pbm.pbm_id — The other side of the Client<->PBM contract relationship; required for guarantee reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: plan_year_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Pbm Contract Plan Year End Date
attributes.description: Last day of the employer plan year covered by this contract. Used to scope claims analysis and guarantee reconciliation periods.

tag_set.value: Client Pbm Contract Plan Year End Date

attributes.name: plan_year_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Pbm Contract Plan Year Start Date
attributes.description: First day of the employer plan year covered by this contract. May differ from the contract effective date for mid-year amendments.

tag_set.value: Client Pbm Contract Plan Year Start Date

attributes.name: pricing_model
attributes.description: Contractual pricing arrangement between the client and PBM. Pass-through: client pays actual drug cost. Spread: PBM retains difference. Hybrid: combination of both. CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this agreement.

attributes.name: rebate_guarantee_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate Guarantee Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed minimum rebate amount per member per month (PMPM) that the PBM must pass through to the client. Used in rebate reconciliation.
attributes.references: PCMA; ERISA; Internal PillarRx Audit Standard

tag_set.value: Rebate Guarantee Per Member Per Month (PMPM)

attributes.name: rebate_pass_through_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of manufacturer rebates that the PBM is contractually required to pass through to the client. 100% = full pass-through model.

attributes.name: retail_brand_awp_discount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Retail Brand Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount
attributes.description: Contracted AWP discount percentage for brand drugs dispensed at retail pharmacies. Core input for PBM discount guarantee auditing.

tag_set.value: Retail Brand Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount

attributes.name: retail_dispensing_fee
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Pbm Contract Retail Dispensing Fee
attributes.description: Contracted per-claim dispensing fee (in USD) paid to retail pharmacies under this contract. Component of dispensing-fee guarantee auditing.

tag_set.value: Client Pbm Contract Retail Dispensing Fee

attributes.name: retail_generic_awp_discount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Retail Generic Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount
attributes.description: Contracted AWP discount percentage for generic drugs dispensed at retail pharmacies. Used in PBM guarantee reconciliation and audit.

tag_set.value: Retail Generic Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount

attributes.name: rx_bin
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pharmacy Claim Routing Bank Identification Number (RxBIN)
attributes.description: Six-digit Bank Identification Number (BIN) used to route pharmacy claims to the correct PBM processor under this contract. Required for claims adjudication.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; HIPAA Transaction Standards

tag_set.value: Pharmacy Claim Routing Bank Identification Number (RxBIN)

attributes.name: rx_group
attributes.description: Pharmacy benefit group identifier used in claim adjudication to identify the specific benefit plan under this contract at the point of dispensing.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; HIPAA Transaction Standards

attributes.name: rx_pcn
attributes.description: Processor Control Number (PCN) used alongside RxBIN to route pharmacy claims to the correct PBM plan or benefit group under this contract.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; HIPAA Transaction Standards

attributes.name: scc_version
attributes.description: Version label for this Type-2 slowly changing contract record (e.g., 'v1', 'v2'). Supports historical contract term tracking across amendments and renewals.

attributes.name: specialty_brand_awp_discount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Specialty Brand Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount
attributes.description: Contracted AWP discount percentage for brand specialty drugs. Critical for specialty spend monitoring and PBM audit deliverables.

tag_set.value: Specialty Brand Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount

attributes.name: specialty_carve_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether specialty drug management is carved out to a separate specialty PBM or vendor rather than managed under this primary PBM contract.

attributes.name: specialty_dispensing_fee
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Pbm Contract Specialty Dispensing Fee
attributes.description: Contracted per-claim dispensing fee (in USD) paid to specialty pharmacies under this contract. Specialty fee structures often differ from retail.

tag_set.value: Client Pbm Contract Specialty Dispensing Fee

attributes.name: specialty_drug_list_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Pbm Contract Specialty Drug List Name
attributes.description: Name of the specialty drug list (Limited Distribution Drug list or specialty tier) applied under this contract for specialty medication management.

tag_set.value: Client Pbm Contract Specialty Drug List Name

attributes.name: specialty_generic_awp_discount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Specialty Generic Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount
attributes.description: Contracted AWP discount percentage for generic specialty drugs. Specialty pharmacy spend is a primary cost driver requiring separate tracking.

tag_set.value: Specialty Generic Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this contract version ceases to be binding. Null for open-ended or currently active contracts. EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for Type-2 history tracking.

attributes.name: three_forty_b_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the 340B federal drug discount program applies to any covered entities under this contract. Affects drug cost calculations and audit scope.
attributes.references: HRSA 340B Program; Internal PillarRx Audit Standard

products.name: company_benefit_group
products.description: Effective-dated plan-design unit (benefit group / BG) governing pharmacy benefit rules for a cohort of members under a Client. Stores RxGroup identifier, BIN, PCN, formulary tier structure, deductible, copay/coinsurance schedule, MOOP, DAW policy

attributes.name: company_benefit_group_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Company Benefit Group Company Benefit Group Id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the benefit group record in the PillarRx data platform. Primary key for the company_benefit_group entity.

tag_set.value: Company Benefit Group Company Benefit Group Id

attributes.name: company_client_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Company Benefit Group Company Client Id
attributes.description: FK to company.company_client.company_client_id — A benefit group is a plan-design unit under a Client; eligibility and claims scope through this FK.

tag_set.value: Company Benefit Group Company Client Id

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts) that administers this benefit group on behalf of the client.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: division_formulary_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formulary (covered drug list) assigned to this benefit group, defining which drugs are covered and at what tier.
attributes.references: PillarRx Drug Reference; CMS Formulary Guidance

attributes.name: primary_company_client_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employer client under whose plan this benefit group is defined. Aligns with the Company > Division > Client hierarchy.

attributes.name: accumulator_integration_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Company Benefit Group Accumulator Integration Type
attributes.description: Defines how copay assistance program (CAP) payments are treated in deductible and OOP accumulators. Determines whether manufacturer copay card amounts count toward member cost-sharing.
attributes.references: PillarRx PAX Application; CMS Accumulator Adjustment Program Guidance; ACA

tag_set.value: Company Benefit Group Accumulator Integration Type

attributes.name: benefit_group_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code identifying the benefit group as assigned by the PBM or employer plan. Used for claims routing and eligibility matching.

attributes.name: benefit_group_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Company Benefit Group Benefit Group Name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the benefit group as defined by the employer plan (e.g., 'Active Employees PPO', 'Retirees HRA'). Used in reporting and member communications.

tag_set.value: Company Benefit Group Benefit Group Name

attributes.name: benefit_group_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Company Benefit Group Benefit Group Status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the benefit group. Drives eligibility adjudication and reporting inclusion. Active groups are currently in force for member enrollment.

tag_set.value: Company Benefit Group Benefit Group Status

attributes.name: company_client_fk
attributes.business_glossary_term: Company Benefit Group Company Client Fk
attributes.description: FK to company.company_client.company_client_id — Benefit groups belong to a Client; eligibility and claims resolve plan design through this FK.

tag_set.value: Company Benefit Group Company Client Fk

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit group record was first created in the PillarRx data platform. Audit field for data governance and lineage tracking.
attributes.references: PillarRx Data Governance Standard; SOC 2; HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: daw_brand_penalty_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dispense As Written (DAW) Brand Penalty Amount
attributes.description: Additional dollar amount charged to the member when a brand drug is dispensed and a generic equivalent is available (DAW penalty). Null if daw_policy does not impose a penalty.
attributes.references: NCPDP DAW Code Standard; PillarRx Benefit Design Standard

tag_set.value: Dispense As Written (DAW) Brand Penalty Amount

attributes.name: daw_policy
attributes.description: Plan policy governing how Dispense As Written (DAW) codes affect member cost-sharing. Determines whether members pay a brand penalty when a generic equivalent is available.
attributes.references: NCPDP DAW Code Standard; PillarRx Benefit Design Standard

attributes.name: deductible_family_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate dollar amount a family unit must pay out-of-pocket for covered pharmacy claims before the plan begins to pay for any family member.
attributes.references: ACA; ERISA; IRS HSA Deductible Guidance

attributes.name: deductible_individual_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount an individual member must pay out-of-pocket for covered pharmacy claims before the plan begins to pay. Resets each plan year.
attributes.references: ACA; ERISA; IRS HSA Deductible Guidance

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this benefit group design becomes effective and governs pharmacy benefit adjudication for enrolled members. Start of the plan year or mid-year amendment date.

attributes.name: formulary_tier_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Company Benefit Group Formulary Tier Count
attributes.description: Number of cost-sharing tiers defined in the formulary structure for this benefit group (e.g., 3-tier: generic/preferred brand/non-preferred brand).
attributes.references: PillarRx Drug Reference; CMS Formulary Guidance

tag_set.value: Company Benefit Group Formulary Tier Count

attributes.name: is_current_record
attributes.description: Type-2 Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD) flag. True indicates this is the currently active version of the benefit group record. False indicates a historical version superseded by a later amendment.
attributes.references: PillarRx Data Warehouse SCD Standard; Kimball Data Warehouse Methodology

attributes.name: ldd_carve_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether limited distribution drugs (LDD) are carved out to a specific specialty pharmacy or handled under a separate benefit arrangement for this benefit group.
attributes.references: PillarRx Specialty Pharmacy Standard; FDA LDD Guidance

attributes.name: mail_days_supply_standard
attributes.description: Standard days supply allowed per mail-order pharmacy fill under this benefit group (e.g., 90 days). Typically 3x the retail days supply.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; PillarRx Benefit Design Standard

attributes.name: mail_order_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit group mandates mail-order dispensing for maintenance medications after a defined number of retail fills. True = mandatory mail-order program in effect.

attributes.name: mail_order_mandatory_fill_threshold
attributes.business_glossary_term: Company Benefit Group Mail Order Mandatory Fill Threshold
attributes.description: Number of retail fills allowed for a maintenance drug before mail-order becomes mandatory. Applicable only when mail_order_mandatory is True.

tag_set.value: Company Benefit Group Mail Order Mandatory Fill Threshold

attributes.name: moop_family_amount
attributes.description: Maximum aggregate dollar amount a family unit pays in cost-sharing per plan year before the plan covers 100% of covered pharmacy costs for all family members.

attributes.name: moop_individual_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount an individual member pays in cost-sharing per plan year before the plan covers 100% of covered pharmacy costs. ACA-mandated limit.

attributes.name: plan_year_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Company Benefit Group Plan Year End Date
attributes.description: Last day of the benefit plan year associated with this benefit group. Marks the end of the accumulator period for deductible and out-of-pocket tracking.
attributes.references: ERISA; ACA; DOL Plan Year Guidance

tag_set.value: Company Benefit Group Plan Year End Date

attributes.name: plan_year_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Company Benefit Group Plan Year Start Date
attributes.description: First day of the benefit plan year associated with this benefit group. Deductible and out-of-pocket accumulators reset on this date annually.
attributes.references: ERISA; ACA; DOL Plan Year Guidance

tag_set.value: Company Benefit Group Plan Year Start Date

attributes.name: prior_auth_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit group applies prior authorization (PA) requirements for certain drug classes or tiers. True = PA program is active for this benefit group.
attributes.references: PillarRx Prior Authorization Analytics; CMS PA Guidance

attributes.name: quantity_limit_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether quantity limit (QL) edits are applied to claims under this benefit group, restricting the dispensed quantity to plan-defined maximums.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; PillarRx Benefit Design Standard

attributes.name: rebate_pass_through
attributes.description: Indicates whether manufacturer rebates collected by the PBM are passed through to the employer client plan. True = pass-through (transparent) model; False = spread/retained model.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Audit Standard; ERISA; DOL Transparency Guidance

attributes.name: record_effective_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Company Benefit Group Record Effective Date
attributes.description: Date on which this specific SCD Type-2 version of the benefit group record became the active version in the data platform. Distinct from the business effective_date.
attributes.references: PillarRx Data Warehouse SCD Standard; Kimball Data Warehouse Methodology

tag_set.value: Company Benefit Group Record Effective Date

attributes.name: record_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Company Benefit Group Record Expiration Date
attributes.description: Date on which this SCD Type-2 version of the benefit group record was superseded by a newer version. Null for the current active record. Enables point-in-time historical queries.
attributes.references: PillarRx Data Warehouse SCD Standard; Kimball Data Warehouse Methodology

tag_set.value: Company Benefit Group Record Expiration Date

attributes.name: retail_days_supply_standard
attributes.description: Standard days supply allowed per retail pharmacy fill under this benefit group (e.g., 30 days). Drives quantity limit edits and cost-sharing calculations.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; PillarRx Benefit Design Standard

attributes.name: rx_bin
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pharmacy Claim Routing Bank Identification Number (RxBIN)
attributes.description: Six-digit Bank Identification Number (BIN) printed on the member ID card and transmitted on pharmacy claims to route the claim to the correct PBM processor.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard Version D.0; ANSI X9

tag_set.value: Pharmacy Claim Routing Bank Identification Number (RxBIN)

attributes.name: rx_group
attributes.description: RxGroup code transmitted on pharmacy claims to identify the benefit group at point-of-sale. Used by pharmacies to route claims to the correct PBM plan.

attributes.name: rx_pcn
attributes.description: Processor Control Number (PCN) used alongside RxBIN to further route pharmacy claims to the correct PBM sub-processor or plan segment.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Company Benefit Group Source System Code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system from which this benefit group record was ingested (e.g., 'EMS' for Eligibility Management System, 'CVS' for CVS Caremark feed).

tag_set.value: Company Benefit Group Source System Code

attributes.name: specialty_coinsurance_pct
attributes.description: Member coinsurance rate (as a decimal, e.g., 0.20 = 20%) applied to specialty medication claims. Used when specialty drugs are subject to coinsurance rather than a flat copay.

attributes.name: specialty_oop_max_amount
attributes.description: Maximum annual out-of-pocket amount a member pays specifically for specialty medications under this benefit group, if a separate specialty OOP cap is defined.
attributes.references: PillarRx Benefit Design Standard; ACA Section 1302

attributes.name: specialty_pharmacy_network
attributes.description: Defines the specialty pharmacy network structure for this benefit group. Determines which specialty pharmacies members may use for specialty medication dispensing.
attributes.references: NCPDP Pharmacy File; PillarRx Benefit Design Standard

attributes.name: step_therapy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether step therapy (ST) protocols are enforced under this benefit group, requiring members to try lower-cost alternatives before accessing higher-tier drugs.
attributes.references: PillarRx Prior Authorization Analytics; CMS Step Therapy Guidance

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this benefit group design ceases to be effective. Null for open-ended active groups. Supports Type-2 SCD history for plan design changes.

attributes.name: tier1_copay_mail_amount
attributes.description: Fixed member copay for Tier 1 (generic) drugs dispensed via mail-order pharmacy. Typically lower than retail to incentivize mail-order utilization.

attributes.name: tier1_copay_retail_amount
attributes.description: Fixed member copay for Tier 1 (typically generic) drugs dispensed at a retail pharmacy. Core cost-sharing parameter for plan design analysis.

attributes.name: tier2_copay_mail_amount
attributes.description: Fixed member copay for Tier 2 (preferred brand) drugs dispensed via mail-order pharmacy.

attributes.name: tier2_copay_retail_amount
attributes.description: Fixed member copay for Tier 2 (typically preferred brand) drugs dispensed at a retail pharmacy.

attributes.name: tier3_copay_mail_amount
attributes.description: Fixed member copay for Tier 3 (non-preferred brand) drugs dispensed via mail-order pharmacy.

attributes.name: tier3_copay_retail_amount
attributes.description: Fixed member copay for Tier 3 (typically non-preferred brand) drugs dispensed at a retail pharmacy.

attributes.name: tier4_copay_retail_amount
attributes.description: Fixed member copay for Tier 4 (typically specialty or non-formulary) drugs dispensed at a retail pharmacy. Null if the benefit group has fewer than 4 tiers.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit group record was last modified in the PillarRx data platform. Used for change detection and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: PillarRx Data Governance Standard; SOC 2; HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: tertiary_company_client_id

attributes.name: actual_go_live_date

attributes.name: baa_executed

attributes.name: client_contact_email

attributes.name: pbm_audit_in_scope

attributes.name: pbm_data_agreement_signed

attributes.name: target_go_live_date

attributes.name: due_date

attributes.name: fee_status

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code in NetSuite/Brown & Brown Finance to which this consulting fee revenue is posted for financial reporting and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the invoice was formally issued to the client. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this billing transaction.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible invoice reference number issued to the client for this consulting fee billing event. Sourced from NetSuite/Brown & Brown Finance AR module.

attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has formally disputed this invoice. When true, the fee is placed on hold pending resolution and excluded from collectible AR.

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee is part of a recurring billing schedule (e.g., monthly retainer) as opposed to a one-time or milestone-based charge.

attributes.name: member_count
attributes.description: Number of eligible health plan members used as the basis for per-member fee calculations (Per Member Per Month or Per Member Per Year fee types).

attributes.name: milestone_name
attributes.description: Name or description of the engagement milestone triggering this billing event when fee_type is milestone (e.g., 'PBM Audit Report Delivery', 'Onboarding Complete').

attributes.name: net_fee_amount
attributes.description: Final net consulting fee amount due after applying adjustments (billed_amount + adjustment_amount). Represents the client's actual payment obligation.

attributes.name: netsuite_invoice_code
attributes.description: Internal invoice record identifier in the NetSuite/Brown & Brown Finance AR system. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the data warehouse and the financial system of record.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text internal notes or client-facing memo line associated with this consulting fee billing event. May include context for adjustments or special billing arrangements.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on this invoice (net_fee_amount minus paid_amount). Used for AR aging and collections management.

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Total amount actually received from the client against this invoice. May differ from net_fee_amount if partial payments or disputes exist.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the client remitted payment for this invoice (e.g., ACH, wire transfer, check). Populated upon payment receipt.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which payment was received from the client for this invoice. Null if payment has not yet been received.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms governing when the client must remit payment (e.g., Net 30). Drives due_date calculation and AR aging bucket assignment.

attributes.name: pmpm_rate
attributes.description: Per Member Per Month consulting fee rate applied when fee_type is per_member. Multiplied by member_count and months in billing period to derive billed_amount.

attributes.name: salesforce_opportunity_code
attributes.description: Reference to the Salesforce CRM opportunity record associated with this consulting engagement and fee. Enables CRM-to-billing reconciliation.

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the consulting service type billed. Aligns with Pillarrx core business functions for revenue reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]

attributes.name: service_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the consulting services rendered during the billing period, as it appears on the client invoice (e.g., PBM audit, CAP management, benchmarking).

attributes.description: Timestamp when this consulting fee record was last modified in the enterprise data warehouse. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements.

attributes.description: Reason for voiding this consulting fee record. Populated only when fee_status is void (e.g., duplicate invoice, client contract termination, billing error).
