attributes.description: FK to company.company_client.company_client_id — Contacts belong to a Client; CRM joins require this FK.

tag_set.value: Client Contact Tertiary Company Client Id

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the contact's business mailing address. Used for formal correspondence and consulting deliverable distribution.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (suite, floor, mail stop) for the contact's business mailing address.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City component of the contact's business mailing address.

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record. Inactive or terminated contacts are retained for historical audit trail but excluded from active communications.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the contact's business mailing address (e.g., USA, CAN).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this client contact record was first created in the PillarRx enterprise data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR §164.312

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Organizational department of the contact at the employer client (e.g., Human Resources, Finance, Legal, Benefits Administration).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this contact became active and authorized to represent the client in PillarRx engagements. Used for eligibility and access control in consulting workflows.

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary business email address for the contact. Used for consulting report delivery, CAP program communications, and PBM audit correspondence.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR §164.514; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: fax
attributes.description: Business fax number for the contact. Used for formal document transmission in benefits administration and PBM audit workflows.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the client contact person (e.g., HR benefits manager, billing contact, executive sponsor).

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the designated primary point of contact for the client. Each client should have exactly one primary contact per role type.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title of the contact at the employer client organization (e.g., Director of Benefits, VP of Human Resources, CFO).

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name of the client contact person.

attributes.name: linkedin_url
attributes.description: LinkedIn profile URL for the contact. Used by PillarRx consulting team for relationship management and executive sponsor engagement tracking in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile phone number for the contact, stored in E.164 format. Used for urgent communications and two-factor authentication where applicable.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes captured by the PillarRx consulting team regarding this contact, including relationship context, communication preferences, or engagement history.

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for the contact, stored in E.164 format. Used for direct outreach by PillarRx consulting team.

attributes.name: phone_extension
attributes.description: Optional phone extension for the contact's direct line within the employer organization's phone system.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the contact's business mailing address.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: The contact's preferred channel for receiving communications from PillarRx consulting team.

attributes.name: receives_cap_communications
attributes.business_glossary_term: Receives Copay Assistance Program (CAP) Communications Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact receives communications related to the Copay Assistance Program (CAP) managed via the PAX application.

tag_set.value: Receives Copay Assistance Program (CAP) Communications Indicator

attributes.name: receives_invoices
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact receives consulting fee invoices from PillarRx. Aligns with the billing contact role for NetSuite/Brown & Brown Finance AR workflows.

attributes.name: receives_reports
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is on the distribution list for PillarRx consulting reports, benchmarking analyses, and PBM audit deliverables.

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: Functional role this contact plays in the PillarRx client engagement. Drives routing of communications, invoices, and consulting deliverables. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product if roles expand]

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the contact's business mailing address (e.g., MI, TX, CA).

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this contact's association with the client was terminated (e.g., employee departure, role change). Null if the contact is currently active.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this client contact record was last modified. Used for change detection in ETL pipelines and Salesforce CRM synchronization.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR §164.312

products.name: subscriber
products.description: Master record for the primary policyholder (subscriber) on an employer Client's health plan. A subscriber is the employee/certificate holder to whom one or more members (dependents: spouse, child, other) are linked.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the subscriber (primary policyholder) record within the PillarRx data platform.

attributes.name: primary_company_benefit_group_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Subscriber Primary Company Benefit Group Id
attributes.description: FK to company.company_benefit_group.company_benefit_group_id — Subscriber enrolls under a benefit group; needed for plan-design-aware eligibility.

tag_set.value: Subscriber Primary Company Benefit Group Id

attributes.name: company_client_id
attributes.description: FK to company.company_client.company_client_id — VREQ-004/VREQ-007: subscribers are scoped to Company/Client. The subscriber master is useless without its Client FK.

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts) through which this subscriber's pharmacy benefits are administered.

attributes.name: employer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employer client whose health plan this subscriber is enrolled under within the Company > Division > Client hierarchy.

attributes.name: pbm_subscriber_id
attributes.description: The subscriber identifier as assigned by the PBM source system. Used to correlate subscriber records across PBM claims feeds during normalization and Member 360 identity resolution.

attributes.name: subscriber_company_benefit_group_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Subscriber Subscriber Company Benefit Group Id
attributes.description: FK to company.company_benefit_group.company_benefit_group_id — Subscribers enroll under a benefit group; required to resolve plan-design rules for a subscriber's members.

tag_set.value: Subscriber Subscriber Company Benefit Group Id

attributes.name: subscriber_company_client_id
attributes.description: FK to company.company_client.company_client_id — Subscribers are policyholders on a Client's plan — scoped to Company/Client per VREQ-004.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the subscriber's residence. Used for member communications, eligibility verification, and geographic analytics.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (apartment, suite, unit) for the subscriber's residence. Supplements address_line1 when applicable.

attributes.name: benefit_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the benefit group (BG) to which this subscriber is assigned. Determines formulary, copay tiers, deductible, and MOOP parameters applicable to the subscriber.

attributes.name: cap_enrolled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber is enrolled in a Copay Assistance Program (CAP) managed through the PAX application. Drives CAP eligibility checks during claims processing.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the subscriber's residential address. Used for geographic segmentation and regional pharmacy utilization analysis.

attributes.name: cobra_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber is enrolled under COBRA continuation coverage following a qualifying event. Affects premium responsibility and benefit administration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the subscriber record was first created in the PillarRx data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the subscriber. Used for age-band analysis, Medicare eligibility determination, and member identity resolution across PBM sources.

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: Number of active dependent members (spouse, child, other) linked to this subscriber under the employer health plan. Used for family-level benefit accumulator analysis.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subscriber's pharmacy benefit coverage became effective under the employer health plan. Defines the start of eligibility for claims adjudication.

attributes.name: eligibility_load_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subscriber's eligibility record was loaded into the PillarRx platform from the source eligibility file. Used for data freshness monitoring and onboarding reconciliation.

attributes.name: eligibility_source_file
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the eligibility file from which this subscriber record was loaded. Supports data lineage tracking and eligibility file reconciliation during client onboarding.

attributes.name: eligibility_system_code
attributes.description: Subscriber identifier assigned by the Eligibility Management System. Used to link subscriber records to benefit group assignments and enrollment data.

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the subscriber. Used for CAP communications, eligibility notifications, and member outreach via the PAX application.

attributes.name: employee_number
attributes.description: Employer-assigned employee identifier for the subscriber. Used to correlate subscriber records with HR/payroll systems during eligibility file processing and client onboarding.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first (given) name of the subscriber as the primary policyholder on the employer health plan.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Biological sex/gender of the subscriber as reported by the PBM or eligibility source. M=Male, F=Female, U=Unknown. Used in clinical and demographic analytics.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last (family/surname) name of the subscriber as the primary policyholder on the employer health plan.

attributes.name: mbi
attributes.description: CMS-assigned Medicare Beneficiary Identifier (MBI) for subscribers enrolled in Medicare. Required for RDS program reporting and Medicare coordination of benefits.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Beneficiary Identifier Program; 42 CFR §422

attributes.name: mdm_golden_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Master Data Management (MDM) Golden Record ID
attributes.description: The golden-record identifier assigned by the Member 360 / MDM platform after cross-PBM identity resolution. Links this subscriber to their unified identity across all PBM sources.

tag_set.value: Master Data Management (MDM) Golden Record ID

attributes.name: member_id_at_pbm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Member ID at Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM)
attributes.description: The subscriber's member identifier as assigned by the PBM. This is the ID printed on the pharmacy benefit card and used in claim transactions. Distinct from the internal subscriber_id.

tag_set.value: Member ID at Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM)

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the subscriber. Often sparse from PBM source feeds; populated when available from eligibility files.

attributes.name: pbm_source
attributes.description: Name of the PBM source system from which this subscriber record was ingested (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts). Supports multi-PBM normalization.

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the subscriber. Often sparse from PBM sources; populated from eligibility files when available.

attributes.name: plan_year_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the benefit plan year applicable to this subscriber. Used to reset deductible and out-of-pocket accumulators for annual claims analysis.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the subscriber's residential address. Used for geographic pharmacy access analysis and regional benchmarking.

attributes.name: rds_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber qualifies for the CMS Retiree Drug Subsidy (RDS) program. Applicable to retiree subscribers with creditable prescription drug coverage.
attributes.references: CMS RDS Program; 42 CFR §423 Subpart R

attributes.name: rx_bin
attributes.description: Six-digit Bank Identification Number (BIN) used to route pharmacy claims to the correct PBM processor. Printed on the member's pharmacy benefit card.

attributes.name: rx_group
attributes.description: Pharmacy benefit group identifier (RxGroup) used for claim routing and adjudication at the PBM. Printed on the member's pharmacy benefit card.

attributes.name: rx_pcn
attributes.description: Processor Control Number (PCN) used alongside RxBIN to route pharmacy claims to the correct PBM adjudication platform.

attributes.name: ssn_last4
attributes.description: Last four digits of the subscriber's Social Security Number. Used for identity verification and matching across eligibility sources. Full SSN is never stored.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the subscriber's residential address. Used for state-level benefit compliance and geographic reporting.

attributes.name: subscriber_client_fk
attributes.description: FK to company.company_client.company_client_id — VREQ-004: subscribers are scoped to Company/Client not Division; the FK realizes that scoping.

attributes.name: subscriber_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subscriber's enrollment on the employer health plan. Drives eligibility determination for pharmacy benefit adjudication.

attributes.name: subscriber_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subscriber's relationship to the employer plan. Determines benefit eligibility rules, RDS applicability, and COBRA administration.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subscriber's pharmacy benefit coverage ended. Null for currently active subscribers. Used for eligibility validation and claims audit.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the subscriber record was last modified in the PillarRx data platform. Used to detect eligibility changes and trigger downstream refresh processes.

products.name: client_division_assignment
products.description: Bridge enabling a client to span multiple divisions and receive separate division-specific data

attributes.name: client_division_assignment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Division Assignment Client Division Assignment Id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the client-to-division assignment record. Primary key for this bridge entity linking an employer client to one or more organizational divisions.

tag_set.value: Client Division Assignment Client Division Assignment Id

attributes.name: org_division_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Division Assignment Client Assignment Division Fk
attributes.description: FK to company.org_division.org_division_id — Bridge resolves Client<->Division many-to-many; needs the Division leg.

tag_set.value: Client Division Assignment Client Assignment Division Fk

attributes.name: client_division_fk
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Division Assignment Client Division Fk
attributes.description: FK to company.org_division.org_division_id — Bridge endpoint — Division side of the multi-division assignment.

tag_set.value: Client Division Assignment Client Division Fk

attributes.name: client_division_org_division_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Division Assignment Client Division Org Division Id
attributes.description: FK to company.org_division.org_division_id — Bridge side pointing to the Division a Client is assigned to (multi-division span support).

tag_set.value: Client Division Assignment Client Division Org Division Id

attributes.name: client_org_division_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational division to which the client is assigned. A client may be linked to multiple divisions when data is delivered or scoped at the division grain.

attributes.name: company_client_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Division Assignment Company Client Id
attributes.description: FK to company.company_client.company_client_id — Bridge endpoint — Client side of the multi-division assignment.

tag_set.value: Client Division Assignment Company Client Id

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to company.pbm. Business justification: Division assignment may be scoped to a specific PBM (clients can have different PBMs for different divisions). Currently denormalized as pbm_source (STRING).

attributes.name: division_pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to division.division_pbm_contract. Business justification: Assignment tracks which division-specific PBM contract applies to client's division scope. Critical for claims routing, audit scope determination, and guarantee tracking.

attributes.name: assignment_org_division_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Division Assignment Assignment Org Division Id
attributes.description: FK to company.org_division.org_division_id — Bridge must resolve its Division endpoint; without both FKs the VREQ-004 multi-division modeling is non-functional.

tag_set.value: Client Division Assignment Assignment Org Division Id

attributes.name: primary_company_client_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employer client being assigned to a division. Supports multi-division client scoping within the Company > Division > Client hierarchy.

attributes.name: tertiary_company_client_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Division Assignment Tertiary Company Client Id
attributes.description: FK to company.company_client.company_client_id — Bridge resolves Client<->Division many-to-many; needs the Client leg.

tag_set.value: Client Division Assignment Tertiary Company Client Id

attributes.name: assignment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business rationale for creating or modifying this client-division assignment. Documents why a client spans multiple divisions or was reassigned.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the client-division assignment. Drives whether claims, eligibility, and reporting for this client are scoped to the linked division.

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the purpose of the client-division link. Primary indicates the default division; secondary or reporting assignments support multi-division analytics and claims scoping.

attributes.name: cap_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Copay Assistance Program (CAP) is active for members under this client-division assignment. Drives PAX application enrollment and copay card reconciliation workflows.

attributes.name: claims_scoped_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Division Assignment Claims Scoped Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether pharmacy claims for this client are delivered and scoped at the division grain under this assignment. Drives PBM claims feed partitioning and reporting segmentation.

tag_set.value: Client Division Assignment Claims Scoped Flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this client-division assignment record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail anchor for the records lifecycle.

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has provided consent for PillarRx to receive and process claims and eligibility data scoped to this division assignment. Required for HIPAA BAA compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR Part 164; HITECH Act

attributes.name: dir_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) fees apply to pharmacy reimbursements under this client-division assignment. Relevant for Medicare Part D plan auditing.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D DIR Policy; 42 CFR Part 423

tag_set.value: Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) Applicable Flag

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the client-division assignment becomes active and binding for claims scoping, eligibility management, and consulting reporting purposes.

attributes.name: eligibility_scoped_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Division Assignment Eligibility Scoped Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether member eligibility data for this client is managed and scoped at the division level under this assignment. Supports multi-division benefit group administration.

tag_set.value: Client Division Assignment Eligibility Scoped Flag

attributes.name: external_assignment_code
attributes.description: Identifier for this client-division assignment as recorded in an external or upstream source system (e.g., Salesforce, PBM feed, eligibility management system). Supports cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: hipaa_baa_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA) On File Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signed HIPAA Business Associate Agreement is on file for this client-division assignment, authorizing PillarRx to handle PHI on behalf of the client.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR Part 164.504(e); HITECH Act

tag_set.value: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA) On File Flag

attributes.name: is_primary_division
attributes.description: Indicates whether this division is the primary organizational division for the client. Exactly one active assignment per client should carry this flag as true for unambiguous default scoping.

attributes.name: medical_integration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether medical claims data is integrated with pharmacy claims for Total Cost of Care (TCOC) analysis under this client-division assignment.

attributes.name: member_count
attributes.description: Number of active members associated with this client-division assignment at the time of last eligibility load. Used for PMPM rate calculations and division-level capacity planning.

attributes.name: override_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment was manually overridden from the default division scoping logic. Flags records requiring additional audit scrutiny in the eligibility management system.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the default division assignment logic was overridden. Populated only when override_indicator is true. Supports audit trail for eligibility scoping decisions.

attributes.name: pass_through_pricing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PBM contract for this client-division assignment operates under a pass-through (transparent) pricing model rather than a spread-based model.

attributes.name: plan_year_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Division Assignment Plan Year End Date
attributes.description: End date of the benefit plan year applicable to this client-division assignment. Defines the boundary for annual claims aggregation, OOP accumulator resets, and consulting deliverable scoping.
attributes.references: ERISA; DOL; Internal PillarRx Data Standards

tag_set.value: Client Division Assignment Plan Year End Date

attributes.name: plan_year_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Division Assignment Plan Year Start Date
attributes.description: Start date of the benefit plan year applicable to this client-division assignment. Used to align claims analysis periods, deductible resets, and PMPM/PMPY reporting cycles.
attributes.references: ERISA; DOL; Internal PillarRx Data Standards

tag_set.value: Client Division Assignment Plan Year Start Date

attributes.name: prior_auth_tracking_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization analytics are enabled for this client-division assignment. Activates PA data ingestion and reporting in the consulting analytics suite.

attributes.name: rds_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client under this division assignment qualifies for the CMS Retiree Drug Subsidy program, applicable to employer-sponsored retiree prescription drug coverage.
attributes.references: CMS Retiree Drug Subsidy Program; 42 CFR Part 423 Subpart R

attributes.name: rebate_pass_through
attributes.description: Indicates whether manufacturer rebates are passed through to the client under the PBM contract associated with this client-division assignment. Relevant for pass-through pricing model audits.

attributes.name: reporting_scoped_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Client Division Assignment Reporting Scoped Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether consulting analytics and BI reporting for this client are segmented at the division grain under this assignment. Enables division-level benchmarking and trend analysis.

tag_set.value: Client Division Assignment Reporting Scoped Flag

attributes.name: rx_bin
attributes.description: Six-digit Bank Identification Number used for pharmacy claim routing to the PBM under this client-division assignment. Identifies the payer in the NCPDP claims adjudication network.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; Internal PillarRx Data Standards

attributes.name: rx_group
attributes.description: The RxGroup code used by the PBM to identify the benefit group associated with this client-division assignment. Used for claims routing and eligibility matching at the division grain.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; Internal PillarRx Data Standards

attributes.name: rx_pcn
attributes.description: Processor Control Number used alongside RxBIN to route pharmacy claims to the correct PBM processor for this client-division assignment. Enables sub-routing within a BIN.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; Internal PillarRx Data Standards

attributes.name: salesforce_record_code
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM record identifier corresponding to this client-division assignment. Enables bidirectional synchronization between the data lakehouse and the CRM for client management workflows.

attributes.name: specialty_carve_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether specialty pharmacy benefits are carved out to a separate PBM or specialty pharmacy network for members under this client-division assignment.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the client-division assignment ends. Null indicates an open-ended active assignment. Used to enforce temporal scoping of claims and eligibility data.

attributes.name: three_forty_b_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client under this division assignment is eligible to participate in the federal 340B drug discount program administered by HRSA.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this client-division assignment record. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.

products.name: tenant_change_log
products.description: Audit/change-log capturing every material change to tenant and contract master records — organization, org_division, company_client, client_pbm_contract, and company_benefit_group.

attributes.name: tenant_change_log_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tenant Change Log Tenant Change Log Id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each audit/change-log record capturing a material change to a tenant or contract master record. Role: EVENT_LOG.

tag_set.value: Tenant Change Log Tenant Change Log Id

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Surrogate identifier of the PBM associated with the changed record. Populated for changes to client_pbm_contract or company_benefit_group records; null for organization-level changes.

attributes.name: division_id
attributes.description: Surrogate identifier of the org_division within the Company > Division > Client hierarchy to which the changed record belongs. Null when the change is at the organization level.

attributes.name: employer_id
attributes.description: Surrogate identifier of the employer client (company_client) to which the changed record belongs. Null when the change is at the organization or division level.

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Surrogate identifier of the top-level organization (Company) in the Company > Division > Client hierarchy to which the changed record belongs. Enables tenant-scoped audit queries.

attributes.name: rolled_back_from_log_id
attributes.description: References the tenant_change_log_id of the original change entry that this rollback reverses. Null when rollback_flag is false. Enables full change chain reconstruction.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval state for the change. Financially material or sensitive changes may require explicit approval before taking effect. AUTO_APPROVED for low-risk system-initiated changes.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or display name of the PillarRx staff member who approved the change. Null for auto-approved or pending changes. Required for financially material contract field changes.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when the change was approved or rejected. Null for pending or auto-approved changes. Supports SLA tracking for change governance workflows.

attributes.name: batch_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the ETL batch, file load, or bulk-update job that produced this change event. Supports bulk-change investigation and PBM feed reconciliation audits.
attributes.references: SOC 2 CC7.2; Internal PillarRx ETL standards

attributes.name: benefit_group_code
attributes.description: Benefit group code from the company_benefit_group record at the time of the change. Populated when target_table is company_benefit_group; null otherwise.

attributes.name: change_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the change event to support trend analysis and audit reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ONBOARDING|CONTRACT_RENEWAL|BENEFIT_CHANGE|CORRECTION|TERMINATION|REACTIVATION — promote to reference product if values expand]

attributes.name: change_description
attributes.description: Human-readable narrative summarizing the business impact of the change (e.g., 'Updated AWP discount from 18% to 20% for brand drugs effective 2025-01-01'). Supports consulting audit deliverables.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or structured rationale explaining why the change was made (e.g., 'PBM contract renewal', 'client onboarding correction', 'benefit group restructure'). Supports audit trail review.

attributes.name: change_source_system
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tenant Change Log Change Source System
attributes.description: Operational system that originated the change event (e.g., Eligibility Management System, PAX, PBM Claims Feed, Salesforce CRM, or manual data entry). Supports lineage tracing.

tag_set.value: Tenant Change Log Change Source System

attributes.name: change_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time (UTC) when the change event was committed to the source system. This is the principal event time for the log entry, distinct from the ETL load time.

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: Category of data modification applied to the master record: INSERT (new record), UPDATE (field change), DELETE (hard removal), SOFT_DELETE (status deactivation), or RESTORE (reactivation).

attributes.name: changed_by_user
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tenant Change Log Changed By User
attributes.description: Username or system account identifier of the actor who initiated the change. May be a human user (PillarRx consultant) or an automated ETL/integration process.

tag_set.value: Tenant Change Log Changed By User

attributes.name: changed_field
attributes.description: Name of the specific column/attribute within the target table that was modified. Null for INSERT or DELETE events where the entire record is the unit of change.

attributes.name: changed_record_reference
attributes.description: Surrogate identifier of the specific master record that was modified (e.g., the organization_id, company_client_id, or client_pbm_contract_id that changed).

attributes.name: client_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code identifying the employer client at the time of the change. Denormalized for audit readability and cross-system correlation.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: External contract number from the client_pbm_contract record at the time of the change. Denormalized for audit readability without requiring a join to the contract table.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when this change log record was first written to the Enterprise Data Warehouse / Analytics Lakehouse Silver layer. Distinct from change_timestamp (the source event time).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The business-effective date on which the change takes operational effect (e.g., plan year start, contract renewal date). May differ from change_timestamp for retroactive or future-dated changes.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the client or system that submitted the change request. Used for security monitoring and forensic audit. May be considered PII in some jurisdictions.
attributes.references: SOC 2 CC7.2; HIPAA Security Rule §164.312(b); NIST CSF DE.CM-1

attributes.name: is_contract_financial_field
attributes.description: Flags changes to financially material contract fields such as AWP discount rates, dispensing fees, rebate guarantees, or Generic Effective Rate (GER). Supports PBM audit and contract reconciliation workflows.

attributes.name: is_sensitive_field

attributes.name: new_value
attributes.description: String-serialized new value of the changed field after the modification was applied. Null for DELETE events. May contain sensitive business data depending on the target field.

attributes.name: old_value
attributes.description: String-serialized prior value of the changed field before the modification was applied. Null for INSERT events. May contain sensitive business data depending on the target field.

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: Four-digit plan year (e.g., 2025) to which the change is associated. Enables plan-year-scoped audit reporting for PBM contract guarantee reconciliation and benefit group analysis.

attributes.name: prior_record_version
attributes.description: Version sequence number of the master record before this change was applied. Supports Type-2 Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD) history reconstruction and point-in-time queries.

attributes.name: session_code
attributes.description: Application session identifier associated with the user action that triggered the change. Supports forensic investigation of unauthorized or erroneous modifications.

attributes.name: target_table

attributes.name: contract_number

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the PBM contract. Drives eligibility for claims processing, audit activities, and reporting inclusion.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the PBM pricing model. Pass-through contracts expose actual drug costs; spread contracts allow PBM margin; ASO contracts are fee-only. Critical for audit and benchmarking.
attributes.references: PCMA; ERISA; Internal PillarRx Consulting Standards

attributes.name: contract_version
attributes.description: Version or amendment number of the contract document (e.g., '1.0', '2.1', 'Amendment 3'). Tracks the evolution of contract terms over time.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PBM contract record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX; HIPAA Security Rule; Internal PillarRx Audit Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this contract record. Typically USD for domestic employer-sponsored plans.

attributes.name: dir_fee_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) Fee Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) fees apply under this contract. DIR fees are post-point-of-sale adjustments that affect net pharmacy reimbursement.

tag_set.value: Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) Fee Indicator

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the PBM contract becomes binding and claims processing under its terms begins. Aligns with plan year start in most employer-sponsored plans.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the PBM contract was fully executed (signed by all parties). May differ from the effective date when contracts are signed retroactively.

attributes.name: formulary_type
attributes.description: Classification of the formulary structure under this contract. Open formularies cover all drugs; closed formularies restrict to a defined list; incentive formularies use tiered cost-sharing.

attributes.name: gdr_guarantee_pct
attributes.description: Contracted minimum Generic Dispensing Rate (GDR) guaranteed by the PBM. Failure to meet this threshold may trigger financial penalties or credits under the contract.
attributes.references: PCMA; Internal PillarRx PBM Audit Standards

attributes.name: generic_awp_discount_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generic Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Percentage
attributes.description: Contracted percentage discount off AWP for generic drugs dispensed at retail pharmacies. Used in Generic Dispensing Rate (GDR) and savings analysis.
attributes.references: PCMA; Internal PillarRx PBM Audit Standards

tag_set.value: Generic Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Percentage

attributes.name: guaranteed_rebate_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Rebate Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: Minimum guaranteed rebate amount per member per month (PMPM) committed by the PBM under this contract. Used in rebate reconciliation and guarantee auditing.
attributes.references: PCMA; Internal PillarRx Rebate Audit Standards

tag_set.value: Guaranteed Rebate Per Member Per Month (PMPM)

attributes.name: mail_brand_awp_discount_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mail Order Brand Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Percentage
attributes.description: Contracted AWP discount percentage for brand-name drugs dispensed through mail-order pharmacy. Typically higher than retail brand discount.
attributes.references: PCMA; Internal PillarRx PBM Audit Standards

tag_set.value: Mail Order Brand Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Percentage

attributes.name: mail_dispensing_fee
attributes.description: Contracted flat dispensing fee (in USD) paid per mail-order prescription fill. Mail dispensing fees are typically lower than retail due to volume efficiencies.

attributes.name: mail_generic_awp_discount_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mail Order Generic Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Percentage
attributes.description: Contracted AWP discount percentage for generic drugs dispensed through mail-order pharmacy. Used in mail-order savings and GDR analysis.
attributes.references: PCMA; Internal PillarRx PBM Audit Standards

tag_set.value: Mail Order Generic Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Percentage

attributes.name: member_id_prefix
attributes.business_glossary_term: Division Pbm Contract Member Id Prefix
attributes.description: Prefix applied to member identifiers under this PBM contract. Used during Member 360 identity resolution to distinguish PBM-specific member ID formats across sources.

tag_set.value: Division Pbm Contract Member Id Prefix

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for consultant or analyst annotations regarding contract terms, negotiation history, exceptions, or audit findings not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: pcn
attributes.description: Processor Control Number (RxPCN) used in conjunction with BIN to route pharmacy claims to the correct PBM sub-processor or benefit plan. Required for claims adjudication.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; HIPAA Transaction Standards

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Division Pbm Contract Performance Guarantee Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PBM contract includes performance guarantees (e.g., GDR targets, clinical program outcomes, member satisfaction). Triggers guarantee reconciliation workflows.
attributes.references: PCMA; Internal PillarRx PBM Audit Standards

tag_set.value: Division Pbm Contract Performance Guarantee Indicator

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Type of health plan covered by this PBM contract. Determines applicable regulatory framework (ERISA for commercial, CMS for Medicare Part D, etc.).

attributes.name: pricing_model
attributes.description: The drug ingredient cost pricing methodology specified in the contract. Determines how pharmacy reimbursement is calculated (e.g., AWP Discount, MAC, Guaranteed Effective Rate).

attributes.name: rebate_pass_through_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Division Pbm Contract Rebate Pass Through Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether manufacturer rebates collected by the PBM are passed through 100% to the plan (True) or retained partially by the PBM as spread (False). Critical transparency metric.

tag_set.value: Division Pbm Contract Rebate Pass Through Indicator

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to contract termination date by which either party must provide written notice to prevent auto-renewal or to initiate termination.

attributes.name: retail_dispensing_fee
attributes.business_glossary_term: Division Pbm Contract Retail Dispensing Fee
attributes.description: Contracted flat dispensing fee (in USD) paid to retail pharmacies per prescription fill under this PBM contract. A key component of total pharmacy reimbursement.

tag_set.value: Division Pbm Contract Retail Dispensing Fee

attributes.name: rx_group
attributes.description: Pharmacy benefit group identifier (RxGroup) printed on the member ID card. Used by pharmacies to identify the benefit plan and apply correct cost-sharing at adjudication.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; HIPAA Transaction Standards

attributes.name: specialty_awp_discount_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Specialty Drug Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Percentage
attributes.description: Contracted percentage discount off AWP for specialty medications (SMN). Specialty spend is a primary cost driver and this rate is a key audit guarantee.
attributes.references: PCMA; Internal PillarRx Specialty Pharmacy Standards

tag_set.value: Specialty Drug Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Percentage

attributes.name: spread_pricing_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Division Pbm Contract Spread Pricing Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PBM retains a spread (difference between plan-paid amount and pharmacy reimbursement). False for pass-through contracts. Key audit and transparency flag.
attributes.references: PCMA; ERISA; State PBM Transparency Laws

tag_set.value: Division Pbm Contract Spread Pricing Indicator

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the PBM contract ends or is terminated. Nullable for open-ended contracts. Claims with a Date of Service (DOS) after this date are out-of-contract.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PBM contract record was last modified. Used for change tracking, ETL incremental loads, and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SOX; HIPAA Security Rule; Internal PillarRx Audit Standards

products.name: pbm_guarantee_period
products.description: Defines a discrete measurement period (typically annual or semi-annual) during which PBM performance guarantees are evaluated against a specific PBM contract.

attributes.name: pbm_guarantee_period_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) Guarantee Period ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a PBM guarantee period record. Primary key for this entity.

tag_set.value: Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) Guarantee Period ID

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM entity (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts) whose performance guarantees are being measured in this period.

attributes.name: division_pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM contract under which this guarantee period is evaluated. Links the period to its governing contract terms.

attributes.name: employer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employer client whose pharmacy spend is subject to PBM performance guarantees during this period.

attributes.name: actual_member_months
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Period Actual Member Months
attributes.description: Actual number of member months recorded during this guarantee period. Used as the denominator for PMPM calculations and to validate eligibility for guarantee measurement.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Period Actual Member Months

attributes.name: audit_completion_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Period Audit Completion Date
attributes.description: Date on which the PBM performance audit for this guarantee period was completed and findings were finalized. Used to track consulting engagement timelines.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Period Audit Completion Date

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current status of the PBM performance audit for this guarantee period. Tracks PillarRx consulting audit workflow from initiation through findings delivery to the client.

attributes.name: awp_discount_guarantee_brand
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Guarantee — Brand
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed AWP discount percentage for brand drugs during this period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1800 = 18.00%). Baseline for PBM audit.

tag_set.value: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Guarantee — Brand

attributes.name: awp_discount_guarantee_generic
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Guarantee — Generic
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed AWP discount percentage for generic drugs during this period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8500 = 85.00%). Baseline for PBM audit.

tag_set.value: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Guarantee — Generic

attributes.name: awp_discount_guarantee_specialty
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Guarantee — Specialty
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed AWP discount percentage for specialty drugs during this period. Expressed as a decimal. Specialty spend is a primary driver of total pharmacy cost.

tag_set.value: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Guarantee — Specialty

attributes.name: ber_guarantee
attributes.description: Brand Effective Rate (BER) guarantee for this period, representing the blended net cost per brand claim after all discounts and rebates. Expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: client_report_delivered_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Period Client Report Delivered Date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the guarantee period performance report was delivered to the employer client. Used to measure consulting engagement timeliness and SLA adherence.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Period Client Report Delivered Date

attributes.name: client_report_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Period Client Report Due Date
attributes.description: Date by which PillarRx must deliver the guarantee period performance report to the employer client. Drives consulting engagement scheduling and deliverable tracking.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Period Client Report Due Date

attributes.name: contract_fk
attributes.description: FK to division.pbm_contract.pbm_contract_id — A guarantee period measures a specific PBM contract; parent FK required for reconciliation chain.

attributes.name: contract_year_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Period Contract Year Number
attributes.description: Sequential year number within the PBM contract term (e.g., Year 1, Year 2, Year 3). Used to track guarantee escalation schedules and multi-year contract performance.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Period Contract Year Number

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this guarantee period record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2; HIPAA Security Rule; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: dir_applicable_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) Applicable Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) fees apply during this guarantee period. DIR fees affect net drug cost and are subject to CMS regulatory scrutiny.

tag_set.value: Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) Applicable Indicator

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_guarantee_mail
attributes.description: Maximum guaranteed dispensing fee per mail-order claim for this period. Expressed in USD. Mail-order dispensing fees are typically lower than retail on a per-fill basis.

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_guarantee_retail
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Period Dispensing Fee Guarantee Retail
attributes.description: Maximum guaranteed dispensing fee per retail claim for this period. Expressed in USD. Compared against actual dispensing fees paid to assess PBM compliance.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Period Dispensing Fee Guarantee Retail

attributes.name: dispute_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the nature of the dispute, including the specific guarantee metric(s) contested and the basis for the disagreement with the PBM.

attributes.name: dispute_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client or PillarRx has formally disputed the PBM's performance results or remediation position for this guarantee period.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Last date of the measurement window for PBM performance guarantee evaluation. Claims with a date of service within start_date and end_date are included.

attributes.name: evaluation_year
attributes.description: Calendar or plan year (e.g., 2024) associated with this guarantee period. Supports year-over-year trend analysis and annual reconciliation reporting.

attributes.name: gdr_guarantee
attributes.description: Minimum guaranteed Generic Dispensing Rate (GDR) for this period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8800 = 88.00%). Low GDR may indicate formulary or substitution issues.

attributes.name: ger_guarantee
attributes.description: Guaranteed Effective Rate (GER) for brand drugs, representing the net effective AWP discount after rebates for this period. Expressed as a decimal. Key PBM audit metric.

attributes.name: guarantee_period_contract_fk
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Period Guarantee Period Contract Fk
attributes.description: FK to division.pbm_contract.pbm_contract_id — A guarantee period is 'evaluated against a specific PBM contract' — this transaction->master FK is the backbone of the reconciliation chain and no engineer would ship without it.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Period Guarantee Period Contract Fk

attributes.name: guarantee_period_pbm_contract_fk
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Period Guarantee Period Pbm Contract Fk
attributes.description: FK to division.pbm_contract.pbm_contract_id — Each guarantee period evaluates a specific PBM contract. Transaction->master link required for reconciliation lineage.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Period Guarantee Period Pbm Contract Fk

attributes.name: guarantee_shortfall_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Period Guarantee Shortfall Amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount by which the PBM failed to meet financial guarantees during this period. Expressed in USD. Positive value indicates a shortfall owed to the client by the PBM.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Period Guarantee Shortfall Amount

attributes.name: mac_guarantee_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Maximum Allowable Cost (MAC) pricing guarantee applies to this period. When true, the PBM is contractually bound to a specific MAC list and pricing methodology.

attributes.name: measurement_basis
attributes.description: Defines the claim population used to measure PBM performance against guarantees (e.g., paid claims net of reversals). Ensures consistent audit methodology.

attributes.name: minimum_member_months
attributes.description: Minimum number of member months required for the guarantee period to be eligible for performance measurement. Protects against small-sample distortions in guarantee calculations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for analyst or consultant notes regarding this guarantee period, such as methodology exceptions, PBM communications, or client-specific context.

attributes.name: pass_through_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PBM contract for this period operates on a pass-through (transparent) pricing model. Pass-through contracts eliminate spread pricing and require full rebate disclosure.

attributes.name: pbm_contract_fk
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Period Pbm Contract Fk
attributes.description: FK to division.pbm_contract.pbm_contract_id — A guarantee measurement period is evaluated against a specific PBM contract; master->period lineage required for variance tracing.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Period Pbm Contract Fk

attributes.name: pbm_data_received_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Period Pbm Data Received Date
attributes.description: Actual date on which PBM claims data and performance reports were received by PillarRx for this guarantee period. Compared against submission deadline for compliance tracking.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Period Pbm Data Received Date

attributes.name: pbm_submission_deadline
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the PBM must submit claims data and performance reports for this guarantee period. Missed deadlines may trigger contract remedies.

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the guarantee period, such as 'CY2024 Annual Guarantee Period' or '2024 H1 Semi-Annual Review'. Used in reporting and client deliverables.

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the guarantee period. Drives workflow routing for audit, reconciliation, and client reporting activities.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the measurement cadence for this guarantee period. Drives how performance results are aggregated and reported to the client.

attributes.name: rebate_guarantee_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate Guarantee Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: Minimum guaranteed rebate amount per member per month (PMPM) for this period. Expressed in USD. Used to assess whether PBM rebate pass-through meets contractual minimums.

tag_set.value: Rebate Guarantee Per Member Per Month (PMPM)

attributes.name: remediation_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount agreed upon or paid by the PBM to remediate guarantee shortfalls for this period. Expressed in USD. May differ from shortfall_amount after negotiation.

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the remediation process for any guarantee shortfall identified in this period. Tracks the resolution lifecycle from identification through payment or waiver.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: First date of the measurement window during which PBM performance guarantees are evaluated. Aligns with the contract year or sub-period definition.

attributes.name: total_claim_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Period Total Claim Count
attributes.description: Total number of pharmacy claims included in the guarantee period measurement population. Used to validate statistical significance and support PBM audit reconciliation.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Period Total Claim Count

attributes.name: total_drug_spend
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Period Total Drug Spend
attributes.description: Total plan-paid drug spend (ingredient cost plus dispensing fees) during this guarantee period. Expressed in USD. Primary financial baseline for guarantee reconciliation.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Period Total Drug Spend

attributes.name: total_rebates_received
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Period Total Rebates Received
attributes.description: Total rebate dollars received from the PBM during this guarantee period. Expressed in USD. Compared against rebate guarantee to identify shortfalls requiring remediation.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Period Total Rebates Received

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this guarantee period record was last modified. Used to detect stale records and support incremental ETL processing in the Databricks lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOC 2; HIPAA Security Rule; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

products.name: pbm_guarantee_result
products.description: Transactional record capturing the outcome of a PBM guarantee reconciliation for a specific guarantee period and metric. References its parent pbm_guarantee_period.

attributes.name: pbm_guarantee_result_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) Guarantee Result ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a PBM guarantee reconciliation result record. Primary key for this entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

tag_set.value: Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) Guarantee Result ID

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts) against whose contractual guarantee this result is measured.

attributes.name: employer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employer client whose PBM guarantee is being reconciled. Supports multi-tenant scoping within the Company > Division > Client hierarchy.

attributes.name: pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM contract that defines the guarantee terms being evaluated. Ties the result to the governing contractual agreement.

attributes.name: pbm_guarantee_period_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Result Guarantee Period Fk Id
attributes.description: FK to division.pbm_guarantee_period.pbm_guarantee_period_id — Each result row is 'the outcome of a PBM guarantee reconciliation for a specific guarantee period' — mandatory header->line FK.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Result Guarantee Period Fk Id

attributes.name: pbm_period_fk
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Result Pbm Period Fk
attributes.description: FK to division.pbm_guarantee_period.pbm_guarantee_period_id — Each result rolls up to its guarantee period; without this the reconciliation chain cannot be traced for variance root-cause.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Result Pbm Period Fk

attributes.name: primary_pbm_guarantee_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent PBM guarantee period under which this result was evaluated. Links result to its measurement window and contract context.

attributes.name: actual_value
attributes.description: The actual measured value achieved by the PBM for the guarantee metric during the evaluation period. Compared against guaranteed_value to determine pass/fail.

attributes.name: awp_basis
attributes.description: Total AWP of drugs in the evaluation population. Used as the denominator for AWP discount guarantee calculations and PBM audit benchmarking.
attributes.references: Medi-Span; First DataBank (FDB); Internal PillarRx Data Standard

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Pharmacy dispensing channel scope for this guarantee result (retail, mail order, specialty, or all channels combined). Affects benchmark applicability.

attributes.name: claim_count
attributes.description: Number of pharmacy claims included in the guarantee evaluation population for this result. Used to validate statistical significance and audit scope.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this guarantee result record was first captured in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this record. Typically USD for PillarRx domestic employer clients.

attributes.name: dir_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) Included Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) fees are included in the guarantee calculation. Affects net effective discount and plan cost analysis.
attributes.references: CMS; ERISA; Internal PillarRx Data Standard

tag_set.value: Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) Included Indicator

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal dispute was filed against this guarantee result. Establishes the dispute timeline for resolution tracking and SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of the basis for disputing this guarantee result. Captured when is_disputed is True; used in PBM correspondence and audit documentation.

attributes.name: drug_category
attributes.description: Drug classification scope to which this guarantee result applies. Determines whether the metric covers brand, generic, specialty, or all drug categories.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the guarantee metric was formally evaluated and this result record was produced. Principal business event date for this transaction.

attributes.name: ger_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Guaranteed Effective Rate (GER) applies to this guarantee metric. GER guarantees a blended effective discount rate across the drug mix.

attributes.name: guarantee_metric_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Result Guarantee Metric Code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific guarantee metric being evaluated (e.g., AWP_DISCOUNT_BRAND, GDR, DISPENSING_FEE, REBATE_GUARANTEE). Drives reporting categorization.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Result Guarantee Metric Code

attributes.name: guarantee_metric_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Result Guarantee Metric Name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the guarantee metric being evaluated (e.g., 'Brand AWP Discount', 'Generic Dispensing Rate', 'Dispensing Fee Guarantee'). Used in client reports.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Result Guarantee Metric Name

attributes.name: guarantee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the guarantee category. Segments results by the type of PBM contractual commitment being audited (e.g., discount, dispensing fee, rebate, GDR).

attributes.name: guaranteed_value
attributes.description: The contractually committed guarantee threshold value (e.g., AWP discount percentage, dispensing fee cap, GDR target). Expressed in the unit defined by guarantee_metric_code.

attributes.name: is_disputed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PBM or client has formally disputed this guarantee result. Triggers dispute workflow and holds remedy payment pending resolution.

attributes.name: is_pass
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the PBM met the contractual guarantee threshold. True = guarantee met; False = guarantee missed and remedy may apply.

attributes.name: is_reconciled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this guarantee result has been fully reconciled, including remedy payment receipt and client sign-off. Closes the audit cycle for this metric.

attributes.name: metric_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the guarantee metric values (guaranteed_value, actual_value, variance_value). Enables correct interpretation of numeric results across different metric types.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing analyst observations, PBM communications, or contextual details about this guarantee result. Used in consulting deliverables and audit documentation.

attributes.name: pbm_report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or name of the PBM-issued performance report from which pbm_reported_value was sourced. Supports audit traceability back to PBM documentation.

attributes.name: pbm_reported_value
attributes.description: The guarantee metric value as self-reported by the PBM in their performance report. Compared to actual_value (PillarRx-calculated) to identify discrepancies for audit.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the measurement period covered by this guarantee result. Denormalized from the parent guarantee period for reporting convenience.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the measurement period covered by this guarantee result. Denormalized from the parent guarantee period for reporting convenience.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this guarantee result was marked as fully reconciled. Null if is_reconciled is False. Used for period-close reporting.

attributes.name: remedy_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount owed by the PBM to the client as a financial remedy for failing to meet the guarantee. Zero if the guarantee was met or waived.

attributes.name: remedy_due_date
attributes.description: Contractually required date by which the PBM must remit the remedy payment to the client. Drives accounts receivable follow-up and PBM performance tracking.

attributes.name: remedy_paid_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount actually received from the PBM as remedy payment. May differ from remedy_amount if disputed or partially settled.

attributes.name: remedy_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the PBM remedy payment was actually received by the client. Compared to remedy_due_date to identify late payments.

attributes.name: remedy_variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between remedy_amount and remedy_paid_amount. Tracks outstanding or disputed remedy balances for follow-up and client reporting.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which a disputed guarantee result was formally resolved. Null if dispute is still open. Used to measure dispute cycle time.

attributes.name: result_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this guarantee result record, used in client deliverables, audit reports, and PBM correspondence.

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the guarantee result. Indicates whether the PBM met, missed, or is under review for the evaluated guarantee metric.

attributes.name: source_file_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Guarantee Result Source File Name
attributes.description: Name of the source data file from which this guarantee result was loaded or derived. Supports ETL lineage, reprocessing, and audit traceability.

tag_set.value: Pbm Guarantee Result Source File Name

attributes.name: total_drug_spend
attributes.description: Total pharmacy drug spend included in the guarantee evaluation population. Provides financial context for the scale of the guarantee measurement.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this guarantee result record was last modified. Tracks revisions from dispute resolution, restatements, or PBM data corrections.

attributes.name: variance_value
attributes.description: Difference between actual_value and guaranteed_value. Positive variance indicates PBM outperformed; negative indicates underperformance and potential financial remedy.

products.name: division_formulary
products.description: Master record for a drug formulary (covered drug list) associated with a benefit group and PBM contract. Captures the formulary name, formulary ID assigned by the PBM, effective date range, formulary type (open, closed, incentive), number of tiers

attributes.name: division_formulary_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the formulary record in the PillarRx data lakehouse. Primary key for the formulary dimension.

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: FK to company.pbm

attributes.name: employer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employer client whose benefit plan uses this formulary. Supports multi-tenant scoping within the Company > Division > Client hierarchy.
