attributes.description: Date on which this formulary drug placement expires or is removed. Null indicates an open-ended placement with no defined end. Supports Type-2 SCD history tracking.
attributes.references: CMS Formulary Standards; ERISA Plan Document Requirements

attributes.name: therapeutic_class_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Formulary Drug Placement Therapeutic Class Code
attributes.description: Drug therapeutic class code from Medi-Span or First DataBank (FDB) classification system associated with this formulary placement. Supports formulary analysis by drug class.

tag_set.value: Formulary Drug Placement Therapeutic Class Code

attributes.name: therapeutic_class_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Formulary Drug Placement Therapeutic Class Name
attributes.description: Human-readable therapeutic class name corresponding to the therapeutic class code for this formulary drug placement. Used in formulary reporting and consulting deliverables.

tag_set.value: Formulary Drug Placement Therapeutic Class Name

attributes.name: tier_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the formulary tier assigned to this drug (e.g., 'Generic', 'Preferred Brand', 'Non-Preferred Brand', 'Specialty'). Supports reporting and member communications.

attributes.name: tier_number
attributes.description: Numeric tier level assigned to this drug on the formulary (e.g., 1=Generic, 2=Preferred Brand, 3=Non-Preferred Brand, 4=Specialty). Drives member cost-sharing.
attributes.references: CMS Formulary Standards; NCPDP Formulary and Benefit Standard

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this formulary drug placement record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks changes for SCD Type-2 history and audit compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule; SOC 2 Audit Requirements

products.name: prior_auth_rule
products.description: Master record defining a prior authorization (PA) or step therapy (ST) rule applied within a benefit group or formulary. Captures the rule type (PA, ST, QL), the target NDC or GPI drug class, the clinical criteria summary, the step therapy predecessor
products.reference: Prior Authorization / Step Therapy / Quantity Limit Rule

attributes.name: prior_auth_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the prior authorization or step therapy rule record in the Pillarrx lakehouse.

attributes.name: client_benefit_group_id
attributes.description: Reference to the benefit group under which this PA or ST rule is enforced, scoping the rule to a specific employer plan benefit design.

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts) that administers and enforces this prior authorization rule.

attributes.name: division_benefit_group_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Auth Rule Division Benefit Group Id
attributes.description: FK to division.division_benefit_group.division_benefit_group_id — PA/ST rules are applied within a benefit group or formulary; benefit-group scoping is needed for UM compliance analysis.

tag_set.value: Prior Auth Rule Division Benefit Group Id

attributes.name: division_formulary_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formulary on which this rule is defined. A rule may be formulary-scoped rather than benefit-group-scoped when the PBM manages rules at the formulary level.
attributes.references: NCPDP; CMS Part D Formulary Standards

attributes.name: prior_version_rule_prior_auth_rule_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the previous version of this rule record. Enables Type-2 slowly changing dimension history traversal for audit and trend analysis.

attributes.name: age_max_years
attributes.description: Maximum member age in years for this rule to apply. Used for pediatric or geriatric-specific PA criteria. Null if no upper age restriction.

attributes.name: age_min_years
attributes.description: Minimum member age in years required for this rule to apply or for the drug to be approved without PA. Null if no age restriction.

attributes.name: appeals_allowed_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member or prescriber may file a formal appeal if the PA request is denied under this rule. Required for ERISA plan compliance.
attributes.references: ERISA; ACA; DOL Claims Procedure Regulations

attributes.name: approval_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of days a PA approval remains valid once granted before re-authorization is required. Drives PA renewal workflow in the Prior Authorization Analytics module.

attributes.name: clinical_criteria_summary
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Auth Rule Clinical Criteria Summary
attributes.description: Plain-language summary of the clinical criteria a member must meet to satisfy this PA or ST rule (e.g., 'Diagnosis of moderate-to-severe RA; trial of 2 DMARDs required').

tag_set.value: Prior Auth Rule Clinical Criteria Summary

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this prior authorization rule record was first created in the Pillarrx lakehouse. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: diagnosis_code_required
attributes.description: ICD-10-CM diagnosis code that must be present on the PA request for approval. Comma-separated list if multiple qualifying diagnoses exist.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this prior authorization or utilization management rule becomes enforceable for claims adjudication.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; CMS Part D

attributes.name: formulary_tier
attributes.description: Formulary cost-sharing tier to which the target drug belongs under this rule. Tier placement affects member cost share and PA applicability.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Standards; NCPDP

attributes.name: gender_restriction
attributes.description: Gender restriction for this rule: M=Male only, F=Female only, U=No restriction (unrestricted). Applies to gender-specific clinical criteria.

attributes.name: limited_distribution_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the target drug is a limited distribution drug (LDD) available only through select specialty pharmacies, adding an additional access control layer.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for consultant or analyst annotations regarding this rule, such as PBM-specific nuances, client exceptions, or audit findings.

attributes.name: override_allowed_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pharmacist or prescriber override is permitted at point of sale without a formal PA approval (e.g., emergency supply override).
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; State Board of Pharmacy

attributes.name: pbm_rule_reference_code
attributes.description: Native identifier assigned by the PBM system to this rule in their adjudication platform. Used for cross-referencing during PBM audits and guarantee reconciliation.

attributes.name: quantity_limit_days
attributes.description: Number of days in the measurement period for the quantity limit (e.g., 30 days, 90 days). Defines the rolling window for QL enforcement.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; CMS Part D

attributes.name: quantity_limit_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity limit value (e.g., tablets, mL, units). Required when quantity_limit_value is populated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tablets|capsules|mL|units|patches|vials|grams|mcg — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: quantity_limit_value
attributes.description: Maximum dispensable quantity allowed per fill or per period under a quantity limit rule (e.g., 30 tablets per 30 days). Null for non-QL rule types.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; CMS Part D

attributes.name: renewal_required_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PA rule requires periodic renewal after the initial approval duration expires, triggering re-evaluation of clinical criteria.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code assigned by the PBM or plan to uniquely identify this PA/ST/QL rule within their system. Used for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the prior authorization or utilization management rule (e.g., 'Humira PA Criteria', 'Specialty Step Therapy - TNF Inhibitors').

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rule: active (enforced), inactive (suspended), pending (approved but not yet effective), retired (superseded or removed).

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classifies the utilization management rule: PA=Prior Authorization, ST=Step Therapy, QL=Quantity Limit, NF=Non-Formulary, SP=Specialty Designation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PA|ST|QL|NF|SP|DAW — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; CMS Part D

attributes.name: rule_version
attributes.description: Version number of this rule definition (e.g., '1.0', '2.3'). Incremented when clinical criteria or parameters are updated. Supports Type-2 SCD history tracking.

attributes.name: specialty_drug_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Auth Rule Specialty Drug Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rule governs a specialty medication (SMN), which typically requires specialty pharmacy dispensing and enhanced clinical management.
attributes.references: NCPDP; CMS Part D Specialty Tier Definition

tag_set.value: Prior Auth Rule Specialty Drug Indicator

attributes.name: step_sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this drug in the step therapy ladder (1=first-line, 2=second-line, etc.). Null for PA and QL rules that are not step-based.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; CMS Step Therapy Policy

attributes.name: step_therapy_predecessor_name
attributes.description: Brand or generic name of the step therapy predecessor drug. Denormalized for readability in PA analytics and consulting deliverables.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; CMS Step Therapy Policy

attributes.name: step_therapy_predecessor_ndc
attributes.business_glossary_term: Step Therapy (ST) Predecessor National Drug Code (NDC)
attributes.description: 11-digit NDC of the first-line drug that must be tried and failed before the target drug is approved under a step therapy rule. Null for non-ST rule types.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; CMS Step Therapy Policy

tag_set.value: Step Therapy (ST) Predecessor National Drug Code (NDC)

attributes.name: target_drug_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Auth Rule Target Drug Name
attributes.description: Brand or generic drug name associated with the target NDC or GPI. Denormalized for readability in reporting and consulting deliverables.

tag_set.value: Prior Auth Rule Target Drug Name

attributes.name: target_gpi
attributes.description: 14-digit Medi-Span Generic Product Identifier representing the drug class or therapeutic group to which this rule applies when scoped above the NDC level.

attributes.name: target_ndc
attributes.description: 11-digit FDA National Drug Code identifying the specific drug product to which this rule applies. Mutually exclusive with target_gpi when rule is NDC-level.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; HIPAA Transaction Standard

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this rule ceases to be enforceable. Null indicates the rule is open-ended with no scheduled end date.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; CMS Part D

attributes.name: therapeutic_class_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Auth Rule Therapeutic Class Code
attributes.description: Drug therapeutic class code (e.g., Medi-Span or FDB therapeutic class) identifying the clinical category of drugs governed by this rule.

tag_set.value: Prior Auth Rule Therapeutic Class Code

attributes.name: therapeutic_class_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Auth Rule Therapeutic Class Name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the therapeutic drug class (e.g., 'TNF Inhibitors', 'SGLT2 Inhibitors') for reporting and consulting analysis.

tag_set.value: Prior Auth Rule Therapeutic Class Name

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this prior authorization rule record. Used for change detection and incremental ETL processing.

products.name: prior_auth_request
products.description: Transactional record capturing an individual prior authorization request submitted for a member and drug under a specific benefit group. Stores the requesting prescriber NPI, the target NDC, the clinical indication, the submission date, the PBM decision

attributes.name: prior_auth_request_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the prior authorization request record in the PillarRx lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Auth Request Benefit Plan Id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific benefit plan or benefit group under which this PA request is evaluated. Determines formulary tier and cost-sharing rules.

tag_set.value: Prior Auth Request Benefit Plan Id

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the PBM (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts) that adjudicates this PA request on behalf of the plan.

attributes.name: division_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the PillarRx division responsible for managing this client engagement. Supports multi-tenant data scoping.

attributes.name: employer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employer client (plan sponsor) under whose benefit plan this PA request was submitted. Links to the Company > Division > Client hierarchy.

attributes.name: linked_rx_claim_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the pharmacy claim (rx_claim) that was adjudicated using this PA authorization. Enables PA-to-claim linkage for audit and utilization analysis.

attributes.name: prior_auth_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to division.prior_auth_rule. Business justification: Links a PA request to the specific PA rule that triggered it. Prior auth requests are evaluated against PA rules defined in the benefit group/formulary.

attributes.name: appeal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the appeal of a denied PA was formally submitted. Null if no appeal has been filed.

attributes.name: appeal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal appeal has been filed against a PA denial decision. Triggers appeal tracking workflow in the Prior Authorization Analytics module.
attributes.references: ERISA; CMS; State PBM Transparency Laws

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the PA appeal review. Overturned appeals result in authorization; upheld appeals confirm the original denial.
attributes.references: ERISA; CMS; State PBM Transparency Laws

attributes.name: clinical_indication
attributes.description: Diagnosis or clinical rationale submitted by the prescriber to support the PA request. Contains PHI. Used for clinical appropriateness review.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PA request record was first created in the PillarRx lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: days_supply_requested
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Auth Request Days Supply Requested
attributes.description: Number of days supply of the drug requested in the PA submission. Used to evaluate quantity limit compliance and dispensing channel appropriateness.

tag_set.value: Prior Auth Request Days Supply Requested

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: Calendar date the PBM or plan issued a final decision (approval, denial, or cancellation) on the PA request.

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the PA decision was rendered. Used to compute exact turnaround hours for SLA and regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code issued by the PBM indicating the reason for PA denial (e.g., not medically necessary, step therapy required, non-formulary). Null if approved.

attributes.name: denial_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text or standardized description of the denial reason provided by the PBM. Supports member communication and consulting audit analysis.

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: Brand or generic name of the drug for which PA is requested. Sourced from Medi-Span or FDB. Supports human-readable reporting without dimension join.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which an approved PA authorization is valid for claim adjudication. Claims filled before this date will not satisfy the PA requirement.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the approved PA authorization expires. Claims filled after this date require a new PA submission.

attributes.name: formulary_tier
attributes.description: Formulary tier of the requested drug under the applicable benefit plan at the time of PA submission. Influences cost-sharing and PA criteria.

attributes.name: icd10_diagnosis_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Auth Request Icd10 Diagnosis Code
attributes.description: ICD-10-CM diagnosis code submitted with the PA request to establish medical necessity. PHI. Supports clinical analytics and denial pattern analysis.

tag_set.value: Prior Auth Request Icd10 Diagnosis Code

attributes.name: is_specialty_drug
attributes.description: Indicates whether the requested drug is classified as a specialty medication (SMN). Specialty drugs typically have higher PA rates and require additional clinical review.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or supplemental clinical documentation attached to the PA request by the prescriber, plan, or PillarRx consulting team.

attributes.name: pa_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned PA reference number issued by the PBM or plan upon submission. Used for claim adjudication linkage and audit trail.

attributes.name: pa_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the PA request. Drives workflow routing, member notification, and consulting audit reporting.

attributes.name: pa_type
attributes.description: Classification of the PA request by processing urgency or timing. Expedited PAs have regulatory turnaround requirements under CMS and state law.

attributes.name: pbm_name
attributes.description: Name of the PBM that processed this PA request (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts). Denormalized for direct reporting without dimension join.

attributes.name: pbm_pa_reference
attributes.description: PBM-assigned internal reference number for this PA request as received in the PBM claims feed or PA data extract. Supports cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: prescriber_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit NPI of the prescribing provider who initiated the PA request. Sourced from NPPES. Used for prescriber-level PA analytics.

attributes.name: quantity_limit_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity limit value (e.g., tablets, ml, days supply). Required to interpret the quantity_limit_value correctly.

attributes.name: quantity_limit_value
attributes.description: Maximum quantity or days supply authorized per fill or period under the PA approval. Null if no quantity limit applies to this PA.

attributes.name: source_file_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Auth Request Source File Name
attributes.description: Name of the source data file from which this PA record was loaded. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and ETL troubleshooting.

tag_set.value: Prior Auth Request Source File Name

attributes.name: step_therapy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PA denial or criteria requires the member to try a preferred (step) drug before the requested drug will be authorized.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Calendar date the PA request was formally submitted to the PBM or plan. Used to calculate turnaround time and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the PA request was submitted. Supports SLA measurement and expedited PA regulatory turnaround tracking.

attributes.name: turnaround_hours
attributes.description: Elapsed hours from PA submission to decision. Stored as a business-captured field from the PBM feed; not derived in this layer. Used for SLA and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PA request record was last modified in the PillarRx lakehouse. Tracks status changes, appeal updates, and data corrections.

products.name: rebate_contract
products.description: Master record for a manufacturer rebate contract associated with a PBM contract and formulary. Captures the manufacturer name, drug brand or therapeutic class covered, rebate type (base, performance, market share), guaranteed rebate per unit or PMPM

attributes.name: rebate_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the manufacturer rebate contract record in the PillarRx data lakehouse.

attributes.name: division_pbm_contract_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate Contract Division Pbm Contract Id
attributes.description: FK to division.division_pbm_contract.division_pbm_contract_id — Rebate contracts are associated with a PBM contract per the description; needed to tie rebate terms to pricing terms.

tag_set.value: Rebate Contract Division Pbm Contract Id

attributes.name: employer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employer client (plan sponsor) for whom this rebate contract applies within the Company > Division > Client hierarchy.

attributes.name: manufacturer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical manufacturer party that is the counterparty to this rebate contract.

attributes.name: pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM contract under which this manufacturer rebate agreement is negotiated and administered.

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential amendment number for this rebate contract. Zero (0) indicates the original executed contract; positive integers indicate subsequent amendments.

attributes.name: audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rebate contract has been flagged for PBM audit review due to discrepancies between guaranteed rebate terms and actual rebate payments received.

attributes.name: base_rebate_per_unit
attributes.description: Guaranteed flat rebate dollar amount per dispensed unit (e.g., per tablet, per milliliter) under the base rebate tier of this contract. Used in rebate accrual and PBM audit calculations.
attributes.references: PCMA Rebate Transparency Guidelines; CMS DIR Reporting

attributes.name: base_rebate_percent_awp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Base Rebate Percent of Average Wholesale Price (AWP)
attributes.description: Base rebate expressed as a percentage of the drug's Average Wholesale Price (AWP). Common in brand drug rebate contracts. E.g., 15.00 = 15% of AWP.
attributes.references: PCMA Rebate Transparency Guidelines; Medi-Span AWP Standard

tag_set.value: Base Rebate Percent of Average Wholesale Price (AWP)

attributes.name: base_rebate_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Base Rebate Per Member Per Month (PMPM) Amount
attributes.description: Guaranteed flat rebate expressed as a Per Member Per Month (PMPM) dollar amount. Used when the contract is structured on a population basis rather than per-unit dispensing.
attributes.references: PCMA Rebate Transparency Guidelines; CMS DIR Reporting

tag_set.value: Base Rebate Per Member Per Month (PMPM) Amount

attributes.name: contract_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the rebate contract, typically referencing the manufacturer brand or therapeutic class covered (e.g., 'AstraZeneca Oncology Base Rebate 2024').

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned by the PBM or manufacturer to uniquely reference this rebate contract in source systems and correspondence.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rebate contract. Active = in force; Pending = awaiting execution; Expired = past end date; Terminated = cancelled early; Suspended = temporarily paused; Draft = not yet executed.

attributes.name: contract_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this rebate contract record, supporting amendment tracking. Incremented when contract terms are renegotiated or amended (e.g., '1.0', '2.0', 'Amendment 3').

attributes.name: coverage_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rebate applies to a specific brand drug, a generic, a specialty drug, an entire therapeutic class, or a single National Drug Code (NDC).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rebate contract record was first created in the PillarRx data lakehouse. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer record management.
attributes.references: SOC 2; Internal PillarRx Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: dir_applicable_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) Applicable Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether rebates under this contract are subject to CMS Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) reporting requirements, applicable for Medicare Part D plans.
attributes.references: CMS DIR Reporting Guidance; 42 CFR Part 423

tag_set.value: Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) Applicable Indicator

attributes.name: drug_brand_name
attributes.description: Brand name of the drug or drug family covered by this rebate contract (e.g., 'Humira', 'Eliquis'). Null if the contract covers a therapeutic class rather than a specific brand.
attributes.references: FDA Drug Labeling; Medi-Span Drug Reference

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rebate contract becomes legally binding and rebate accruals begin. Aligns with the plan year or negotiated contract start date.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date the rebate contract was formally signed and executed by all parties. May differ from the effective date when contracts are backdated or signed in advance.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rebate contract expires and rebate accruals cease. Null for open-ended contracts. Used in PBM audit and guarantee reconciliation.

attributes.name: formulary_tier
attributes.description: Formulary tier placement required or associated with this rebate contract. Rebate amounts are often contingent on the drug being placed at a specific formulary tier by the plan.

attributes.name: guaranteed_rebate_per_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Effective Rate (GER) Rebate Per Unit
attributes.description: Minimum guaranteed rebate per dispensed unit committed by the PBM under the Guaranteed Effective Rate (GER) provision of the contract, used in PBM audit and guarantee reconciliation.

tag_set.value: Guaranteed Effective Rate (GER) Rebate Per Unit

attributes.name: limited_distribution_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug covered by this rebate contract is a Limited Distribution Drug (LDD), available only through select specialty pharmacies, which may affect rebate eligibility.
attributes.references: FDA Limited Distribution Drug Policy; PCMA

attributes.name: market_share_target_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate Contract Market Share Target Percent
attributes.description: Required market share percentage of the covered drug within its therapeutic class that must be achieved to qualify for market share rebate tiers. E.g., 40.00 = 40% market share.
attributes.references: PCMA Rebate Transparency Guidelines; CMS DIR Reporting

tag_set.value: Rebate Contract Market Share Target Percent

attributes.name: minimum_claim_volume
attributes.description: Minimum number of paid pharmacy claims for the covered drug required within the measurement period before any rebate is earned under this contract.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for consultant or analyst annotations regarding special contract terms, negotiation history, audit findings, or other contextual information not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: pass_through_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rebate contract operates under a pass-through (transparent) PBM pricing model where 100% of manufacturer rebates are passed to the plan sponsor.

attributes.name: pbm_contract_fk
attributes.description: FK to division.pbm_contract.pbm_contract_id — rebate_contract is 'associated with a PBM contract'; required to roll rebate terms up to the governing PBM contract.

attributes.name: pbm_name
attributes.description: Name of the PBM (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts) that administers this rebate contract on behalf of the plan sponsor.

attributes.name: performance_rebate_per_unit
attributes.description: Incremental rebate per dispensed unit earned when performance thresholds (utilization, market share, or quality targets) are achieved under this contract.
attributes.references: PCMA Rebate Transparency Guidelines; CMS DIR Reporting

attributes.name: performance_threshold_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the performance threshold value (e.g., percent for market share targets, claim_count for volume targets, units_dispensed for dispensing volume).

attributes.name: performance_threshold_value
attributes.description: Numeric threshold that must be met to trigger performance rebate payment (e.g., market share percentage, minimum claim volume, Generic Dispensing Rate (GDR) target).

attributes.name: rebate_basis
attributes.description: The basis on which the rebate amount is calculated: per dispensed unit, Per Member Per Month (PMPM), percentage of Average Wholesale Price (AWP), percentage of Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC), or flat fee.
attributes.references: PCMA Rebate Transparency Guidelines; Medi-Span AWP/WAC Standards

attributes.name: rebate_lag_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days after the close of the rebate measurement period before the rebate payment is due from the manufacturer or PBM. Typically 90-180 days for quarterly contracts.

attributes.name: rebate_payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which rebate payments are remitted by the manufacturer or PBM to the plan sponsor (e.g., quarterly is most common in PBM rebate contracts).

attributes.name: rebate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rebate structure. Base = guaranteed flat rebate; Performance = tied to utilization targets; Market Share = tied to drug market share; Formulary Placement = tied to tier position.
attributes.references: PCMA Rebate Transparency Guidelines; CMS DIR Reporting Guidance

attributes.name: specialty_drug_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rebate contract covers a specialty medication (SMN), which typically has higher rebate values and more complex performance tiers than standard brand drugs.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date the rebate contract was early-terminated prior to its scheduled expiration date. Null if the contract ran to its natural expiration.

attributes.name: therapeutic_class_code
attributes.description: Medi-Span or First DataBank (FDB) therapeutic class code identifying the drug class covered by this rebate contract when the contract applies at the class level rather than a single brand.

attributes.name: therapeutic_class_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the therapeutic drug class covered by this rebate contract (e.g., 'TNF Inhibitors', 'SGLT2 Inhibitors'), sourced from Medi-Span or FDB.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rebate contract record was last modified in the PillarRx data lakehouse. Supports change tracking and Silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: SOC 2; Internal PillarRx Data Governance Standard

products.name: rebate_payment
products.description: Transactional record capturing an actual rebate payment received from a PBM or manufacturer on behalf of a Division or Client for a specific rebate period.

attributes.name: rebate_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each rebate payment record in the Pillarrx data lakehouse. Primary key for the rebate_payment entity.

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts) that remitted or reported this rebate payment to the plan.

attributes.name: division_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Division within the Company > Division > Client hierarchy on whose behalf this rebate payment was received and tracked.

attributes.name: employer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employer client (plan sponsor) whose pharmacy benefit generated the rebate. Scopes the payment within the multi-tenant hierarchy.

attributes.name: pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM contract under which this rebate was earned and remitted. Links payment to specific guarantee terms for audit and benchmarking.

attributes.name: primary_rebate_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to division.rebate_contract. Business justification: Links a rebate payment to the specific rebate contract under which it was made. Rebate payments are made according to rebate contracts negotiated with manufacturers.

attributes.name: secondary_rebate_contract_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate Payment Secondary Rebate Contract Id
attributes.description: FK to division.rebate_contract.rebate_contract_id — rebate_payment reconciles 'against the contracted rebate guarantee' in rebate_contract — mandatory transaction->master FK for rebate reconciliation.

tag_set.value: Rebate Payment Secondary Rebate Contract Id

attributes.name: ach_trace_number
attributes.description: ACH transaction trace number assigned by the originating bank when payment_method is ACH. Enables bank statement reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: admin_fee_withheld
attributes.description: Dollar amount withheld by the PBM as an administrative or management fee before remitting the net rebate to the plan. Relevant for pass-through vs. spread pricing audit.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Check number when payment_method is check. Used for bank reconciliation and audit. Null for ACH, wire, or credit memo payments.

attributes.name: claim_count
attributes.description: Number of pharmacy claims included in the rebate calculation for this payment period. Used to compute per-claim rebate rates and validate against PBM reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial cost center code associated with this rebate payment for internal allocation and Brown & Brown parent company financial reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP; SOX; Brown & Brown financial controls

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rebate payment record was first created in the Pillarrx data lakehouse. Audit trail for data governance and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this record. Defaults to USD for domestic PBM rebate payments.

attributes.name: dispute_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount under dispute when payment_status is disputed. Represents the shortfall between guaranteed_amount and payment_amount being formally contested.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for disputing this rebate payment when payment_status is disputed. Documents the basis for the shortfall claim against the PBM.
attributes.references: ERISA; PBM contract dispute resolution terms

attributes.name: expected_payment_date
attributes.description: Contractually expected date by which the PBM or manufacturer was obligated to remit the rebate. Used to identify late payments and trigger dispute workflows.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code in NetSuite / Brown & Brown Finance to which this rebate payment is posted. Supports financial reporting and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: guaranteed_amount
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed rebate amount for the period per the PBM contract (Guaranteed Effective Rate or per-claim guarantee). Baseline for variance and audit analysis.
attributes.references: PBM contract audit standards; ERISA; PCMA

attributes.name: is_pass_through
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PBM contract is pass-through (True) meaning 100% of manufacturer rebates are remitted to the plan, versus spread/retained model (False).

attributes.name: is_reconciled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rebate payment has been fully reconciled against the PBM contract guarantee and claim-level detail. True when reconciliation is complete.
attributes.references: ERISA; SOX financial controls; PBM audit standards

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Net dollar amount received by the plan after deducting admin_fee_withheld from payment_amount. Represents actual plan benefit from the rebate payment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by a Pillarrx analyst regarding this rebate payment. Used to document reconciliation findings, dispute context, or client communication.

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Gross dollar amount of the rebate payment as remitted by the PBM or manufacturer. Denominated in USD. Core financial fact for reconciliation and client reporting.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date the rebate payment was received (cash receipt date) or the date the PBM remitted the payment per the remittance advice.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument or mechanism by which the rebate was remitted: ACH electronic transfer, paper check, wire transfer, credit memo applied against invoices, offset against fees, or other.

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned payment reference number provided by the PBM or manufacturer on the remittance advice. Used for reconciliation and audit tracing.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rebate payment. Drives reconciliation workflow: pending (expected), received (cash in), reconciled (matched to guarantee), disputed, voided, or adjusted.

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the payment: PBM-remitted rebate, direct manufacturer rebate, Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) fee, admin fee, performance bonus, or other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product if values expand]

attributes.name: rebate_as_pct_of_spend
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate as Percentage of Drug Spend
attributes.description: Rebate payment expressed as a percentage of total_drug_spend for the period. Key PBM performance metric used in benchmarking and guarantee audit reporting.
attributes.references: PCMA; ERISA; PBM contract audit standards

tag_set.value: Rebate as Percentage of Drug Spend

attributes.name: rebate_per_claim
attributes.description: Contractual or actual rebate amount per eligible claim for this payment period. Used in PBM guarantee audit to compare against contracted per-claim rebate rates.
attributes.references: PBM contract audit standards; ERISA; PCMA

attributes.name: rebate_period_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate Payment Rebate Period End Date
attributes.description: Last date of the rebate performance or utilization period to which this payment applies. Paired with rebate_period_start_date to define the measurement window.

tag_set.value: Rebate Payment Rebate Period End Date

attributes.name: rebate_period_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate Payment Rebate Period Start Date
attributes.description: First date of the rebate performance or utilization period to which this payment applies. Typically a calendar quarter or contract year start.

tag_set.value: Rebate Payment Rebate Period Start Date

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rebate payment was reconciled against the PBM contract guarantee and claim detail. Populated when is_reconciled is True.

attributes.name: remittance_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier from the PBM or manufacturer remittance advice document accompanying the payment. Supports cash application and audit trail.

attributes.name: source_file_name
attributes.description: Name of the PBM remittance file or data feed from which this rebate payment record was ingested. Supports data lineage and ETL audit tracing.

attributes.name: total_drug_spend
attributes.description: Total plan drug spend (ingredient cost basis) for the rebate period used as the denominator in rebate-as-percent-of-spend calculations and PBM performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this rebate payment record. Tracks reconciliation status changes, dispute updates, and adjustment postings.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between payment_amount and guaranteed_amount (payment_amount minus guaranteed_amount). Positive indicates overpayment; negative indicates shortfall requiring dispute or recovery.

products.name: pbm_feed
products.description: Master record for a data feed/source connection by which PillarRx receives pharmacy (and medical) claim extracts for a specific Division from a specific PBM.

attributes.name: pbm_feed_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Division Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) Feed ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the division-PBM feed configuration record. Primary key for this master agreement entity governing how PillarRx receives claim extracts from a PBM on behalf of a division.

tag_set.value: Division Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) Feed ID

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM entity (CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts, Navitus, EmpiRx Health, BCBS Michigan, Rightway, Prime Therapeutics, ServeYou, Carelon) that is the source of this claims data feed.

attributes.name: division_id
attributes.description: Reference to the division within the Company > Division > Client hierarchy that this PBM feed serves. A division may have multiple PBM feeds across different PBMs.

attributes.name: pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM contract record governing the terms under which this data feed is provided. Links the feed to the broader PBM service agreement for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: baa_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the HIPAA Business Associate Agreement with the PBM became effective for this feed. Used for compliance auditing and to ensure PHI exchange is covered by a valid BAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR §164.504(e)), HITECH Act

attributes.name: baa_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: Business Associate Agreement (BAA) On File Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signed HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA) is on file with this PBM for this feed. A BAA is legally required before PHI can be exchanged. Feeds without a BAA must not be activated.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR §164.504(e)), HITECH Act

tag_set.value: Business Associate Agreement (BAA) On File Indicator

attributes.name: claim_types_included
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of claim transaction types included in this feed (e.g., 'fill|reversal|adjustment'). Defines the scope of claim data expected and drives validation rules in the ingestion pipeline.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PBM feed configuration record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and feed lifecycle tracking per SOC 2 change management controls.

attributes.name: delivery_frequency
attributes.description: How often the PBM delivers claim extract files for this feed. Daily feeds support near-real-time analytics; monthly feeds are common for smaller PBMs or historical loads.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Technical mechanism by which the PBM delivers claim extract files to PillarRx. SFTP is most common; API-based and cloud storage (S3) delivery are increasingly used by modern PBMs.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: dos_end_date
attributes.description: Latest date of service (DOS) for claims expected in this feed. Null for ongoing feeds. Used to validate that the feed does not include claims outside the contracted coverage period.

attributes.name: dos_start_date
attributes.description: Earliest date of service (DOS) for claims expected in this feed. Defines the historical coverage window for the feed and is used to validate that claims are within the contracted data scope.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this PBM feed agreement became or becomes active. Claims with a date of service on or after this date are expected to be included in the feed.

attributes.name: encryption_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether feed files from this PBM must be encrypted (e.g., PGP) in transit. Required for HIPAA-compliant PHI transmission. Drives automated decryption steps in the ingestion pipeline.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR §164.312), NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: expected_member_count
attributes.description: Approximate number of eligible members expected to appear in this feed. Used as a baseline for feed volume validation; significant deviations trigger data quality alerts.

attributes.name: feed_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this feed configuration within the PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform. Used in ETL pipeline routing and file naming conventions.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: feed_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name identifying this PBM feed configuration, typically combining the division name and PBM name (e.g., 'Acme Corp - CVS Caremark Pharmacy Claims'). Used in UI and reporting.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: feed_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of this PBM feed. Active feeds are receiving and processing claim extracts. Suspended feeds are temporarily halted. Terminated feeds are permanently closed.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: feed_type
attributes.description: Classification of the data content delivered by this feed. Pharmacy claim feeds carry NCPDP-standard Rx claim transactions. Medical claim feeds carry HIPAA 837 transactions.

attributes.name: file_delimiter
attributes.description: Character used to separate fields in delimited feed files (e.g., pipe '|', comma ',', tab). Null for non-delimited formats such as fixed-width or XML. Required for ETL parsing configuration.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: file_encoding
attributes.description: Character encoding standard used in the PBM feed files. UTF-8 is the modern default; legacy PBM systems may deliver ISO-8859-1 or ASCII-encoded files requiring transformation.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: Technical file format of the claim extract delivered by the PBM. Fixed-width and delimited (CSV/pipe) are legacy PBM formats; EDI 835/837 are HIPAA-standard transaction formats.
attributes.references: HIPAA Transactions and Code Sets (45 CFR Part 162), NCPDP

attributes.name: file_naming_pattern
attributes.description: Expected filename pattern or regex for incoming feed files from this PBM (e.g., 'ACME_CVS_{YYYYMMDD}.txt'). Used by the ingestion platform to identify, validate, and route incoming files.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: includes_medical_claims
attributes.description: Indicates whether this feed includes medical claims in addition to pharmacy claims. True for integrated PBM/medical feeds used in total cost of care (TCOC) analysis.

attributes.name: includes_rebate_data
attributes.description: Indicates whether this feed includes manufacturer rebate or DIR (Direct and Indirect Remuneration) data alongside claim transactions. Relevant for pass-through PBM contract auditing.

attributes.name: is_pass_through
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PBM contract for this feed operates on a pass-through (transparent) pricing model. Pass-through feeds require additional spread and rebate reconciliation analytics.

attributes.name: last_file_received_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Feed Last File Received Date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent feed file was successfully received from the PBM. Used for feed monitoring, SLA tracking, and alerting when expected files are not delivered on schedule.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

tag_set.value: Pbm Feed Last File Received Date

attributes.name: last_successful_load_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pbm Feed Last Successful Load Date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent feed file was successfully ingested and loaded into the data lakehouse. Distinct from receipt date; a file may be received but fail validation before loading.
attributes.references: PillarRx Enterprise Data Warehouse / Analytics Lakehouse

tag_set.value: Pbm Feed Last Successful Load Date

attributes.name: lookback_days
attributes.description: Number of days of historical claims included in each feed extract. PBMs may include a rolling lookback window to capture late-arriving adjustments and reversals (e.g., 90 days for DIR reconciliation).
attributes.references: CMS DIR Guidance, PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: normalization_profile
attributes.description: Name of the ETL normalization mapping profile applied to this feed during ingestion. Each PBM has a unique field layout; the profile maps source fields to the PillarRx canonical claim schema.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes about this PBM feed configuration, such as known data quirks, PBM-specific field mappings, historical issues, or onboarding context captured during client setup.

attributes.name: pbm_client_code
attributes.description: The client or group identifier assigned by the PBM to identify the division or employer group in the PBM's system. Used for feed routing, file validation, and claim matching.
attributes.references: NCPDP, PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: pbm_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary PBM technical or account contact for this feed. Used for feed delivery notifications, issue resolution, and schema change communications.

attributes.name: pbm_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary PBM account representative or technical contact responsible for this data feed. Used for issue escalation and feed configuration changes.

attributes.name: pbm_group_code
attributes.description: The benefit group identifier used by the PBM to segment members within the employer plan. Corresponds to the RxGroup field in pharmacy claim routing and is used to scope claim extracts.

attributes.name: pgp_key_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the PGP public key used to decrypt incoming feed files from this PBM. The actual key material is stored in the secrets vault; this field holds the key alias or fingerprint.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, SOC 2

attributes.name: rx_bin
attributes.description: Six-digit Bank Identification Number (BIN) used to route pharmacy claims to the correct PBM processor at the point of sale. A key identifier for validating that claims in this feed belong to the correct PBM.

attributes.name: rx_pcn
attributes.description: Processor Control Number (PCN) used in conjunction with RxBIN to route pharmacy claims to the correct PBM sub-processor or plan. Validates claim routing for this feed.

attributes.name: schema_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the PBM feed file layout or API schema in use (e.g., '3.2', '5.0.1'). PBMs periodically update their extract formats; version tracking enables backward-compatible ingestion.
attributes.references: NCPDP, PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: sftp_host
attributes.description: Hostname or IP address of the SFTP server from which PillarRx retrieves feed files for this PBM connection. Confidential infrastructure detail used by the ETL ingestion platform.

attributes.name: sftp_path
attributes.business_glossary_term: Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) Directory Path
attributes.description: Remote directory path on the SFTP server where the PBM deposits claim extract files for this feed. Used by the automated ingestion job to locate and retrieve files.

tag_set.value: Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) Directory Path

attributes.name: sftp_username
attributes.description: Username credential used to authenticate to the PBM SFTP server for this feed. Stored as a reference; actual credentials are managed in a secrets vault per SOC 2 controls.
attributes.references: NIST Cybersecurity Framework, SOC 2, HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this PBM feed agreement ends. Null for open-ended feeds. Claims with a date of service after this date should not be expected from this feed.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PBM feed configuration record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit logging, and detecting configuration drift in the ingestion platform.

products.name: engagement
products.description: Master record for a consulting engagement scoped to a Division (and optionally a specific service line: PBM audit, benchmarking, trend analysis, copay assistance management, rebate reconciliation).

attributes.name: engagement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a consulting engagement scoped to a Division. Primary key for the division_engagement entity.

attributes.name: division_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Division within the Company > Division > Client hierarchy that owns this consulting engagement.

attributes.name: division_pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to division.division_pbm_contract. Business justification: Links an engagement to a specific PBM contract when the engagement is contract-specific (e.g., single-contract audit).

attributes.name: account_manager
attributes.description: Full name of the PillarRx account manager responsible for the client relationship associated with this engagement.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: The date the engagement was actually closed or completed, which may differ from the contractual end_date due to extensions or early termination.

attributes.name: analysis_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the pharmacy claims or data analysis window for this engagement. Defines the claims date-of-service (DOS) range included in deliverables.

attributes.name: analysis_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the pharmacy claims or data analysis window for this engagement. May differ from the engagement start_date (e.g., retrospective audits).

attributes.name: audit_finding_count
attributes.description: Number of audit findings identified during a PBM audit engagement. Populated upon completion of audit work; null for non-audit engagements.

attributes.name: contract_value
attributes.description: Total contracted consulting fee value for this engagement in USD. Used for revenue recognition, billing, and NetSuite/Brown & Brown Finance GL posting.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code in NetSuite to which internal labor and overhead costs for this engagement are allocated. Supports financial reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this division_engagement record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this engagement (e.g., USD). PillarRx operates primarily in USD.

attributes.name: data_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the required PBM claims data or eligibility files were received from the client or PBM, enabling analysis to begin.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: deliverable_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal deliverables (reports, analyses, presentations) committed under this engagement per the SOW. Used for progress tracking.
attributes.references: PillarRx BI and Consulting Reporting Suite

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Contractual or operational end date on which the consulting engagement is scheduled to conclude. Null for open-ended engagements.

attributes.name: engagement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the consulting engagement, used in client communications, SOWs, and invoicing. Sourced from Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: engagement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the consulting engagement. Drives workflow routing, billing eligibility, and reporting inclusion.

attributes.name: engagement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the engagement by delivery model: recurring (ongoing retainer), project (defined scope/timeline), or ad_hoc (one-time request).

attributes.name: estimated_savings
attributes.description: Estimated dollar savings identified for the client through this engagement (e.g., audit recoveries, rebate variances, formulary optimization). Raw estimate, not guaranteed.

attributes.name: fee_structure
attributes.description: Billing model governing how consulting fees are calculated and invoiced for this engagement (e.g., flat fee, PMPM, milestone-based).

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) account code in NetSuite used to post consulting fee revenue for this engagement. Supports Brown & Brown Finance SOX controls.

attributes.name: is_cap_management
attributes.description: Indicates whether this engagement includes Copay Assistance Program (CAP) management via the PAX application. True = CAP management in scope.

attributes.name: is_pbm_audit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this engagement includes a PBM audit service line (contract guarantee reconciliation, discount/rebate/dispensing-fee audit). True = audit in scope.

attributes.name: is_rebate_reconciliation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this engagement includes rebate reconciliation (manufacturer and PBM rebate audit and pass-through verification). True = rebate reconciliation in scope.

attributes.name: is_tcoc_integration
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Cost of Care (TCOC) Integration Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this engagement integrates medical claims data for Total Cost of Care (TCOC) analysis. True = medical claims feed in scope.

tag_set.value: Total Cost of Care (TCOC) Integration Indicator

attributes.name: kickoff_date
attributes.description: Date of the formal kickoff meeting with the client for this engagement. Marks the transition from contracting to active delivery.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent internal or client-facing review or status meeting for this engagement. Used for engagement health monitoring.

attributes.name: lead_consultant
attributes.description: Full name of the PillarRx consultant who is the primary owner and accountable lead for this engagement. Used for workload tracking and client communications.

attributes.name: member_count
attributes.description: Number of covered members in scope for this engagement at the time of initiation. Used for PMPM fee calculation and benchmarking normalization.

attributes.name: engagement_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the consulting engagement (e.g., 'FY2024 PBM Audit – Acme Corp Division'). Used in reporting and client deliverables.

attributes.name: next_milestone_date
attributes.description: Target date for the next scheduled deliverable or milestone in the engagement timeline. Supports proactive project management and client communication.
attributes.references: PillarRx BI and Consulting Reporting Suite

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal notes, special instructions, or context relevant to this engagement. Not shared externally in deliverables.

attributes.name: pbm_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of PBM(s) in scope for this engagement (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts). Drives claims data extraction and audit targeting.
attributes.references: PillarRx PBM Claims Feed Ingestion Platform

attributes.name: pmpm_rate
attributes.description: Consulting fee rate expressed as a Per Member Per Month (PMPM) dollar amount. Applicable only when fee_structure = pmpm. Used for invoice calculation.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this engagement, used for resource allocation and scheduling within the consulting team.

attributes.name: realized_savings
attributes.description: Actual dollar savings confirmed and realized by the client as a result of this engagement. Populated post-implementation; distinct from estimated_savings.

attributes.name: salesforce_opportunity_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the corresponding Opportunity record in Salesforce CRM. Enables cross-system traceability between CRM pipeline and the data warehouse engagement record.

attributes.name: service_line
attributes.description: Primary consulting service line delivered under this engagement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pbm_audit|benchmarking|trend_analysis|cap_management|rebate_reconciliation|prior_auth_analysis|tcoc_integration — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sow_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number or title of the Statement of Work (SOW) governing this engagement. Links the data record to the executed legal/contractual document.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Contractual or operational start date on which the consulting engagement becomes active and work may commence.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this division_engagement record was most recently modified. Used for incremental ETL processing and change detection in the Silver layer.

products.name: reconciliation_deliverable
products.description: Transactional record capturing a client-facing reconciliation/audit deliverable produced under a division_engagement, tying one or more pbm_guarantee_result and/or rebate_payment reconciliation outcomes to an accountable consulting output.

attributes.name: reconciliation_deliverable_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the reconciliation deliverable record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: company_pbm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM (e.g., CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts) whose contract guarantees or rebate payments are subject to this reconciliation.

attributes.name: consulting_fee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consulting fee record associated with this deliverable for NetSuite/Brown & Brown Finance billing and GL reconciliation.

attributes.name: employer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employer client for whom this reconciliation deliverable was produced within the Company > Division > Client hierarchy.

attributes.name: engagement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the division-level consulting engagement under which this reconciliation deliverable was produced.

attributes.name: pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM contract record whose guarantee terms are being audited in this reconciliation deliverable.

attributes.name: pbm_guarantee_result_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reconciliation Deliverable Pbm Guarantee Result Id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary PBM guarantee result record (discount, dispensing fee, or rebate guarantee) tied to this deliverable. Nullable when deliverable covers rebate-only reconciliation.

tag_set.value: Reconciliation Deliverable Pbm Guarantee Result Id

attributes.name: rebate_payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rebate payment record reconciled within this deliverable. Nullable when deliverable covers guarantee-only audit outcomes.

attributes.name: actual_amount
attributes.description: The actual dollar amount delivered by the PBM for the audit period as determined by PillarRx claims analysis. Compared against guaranteed_amount to compute variance.

attributes.name: audit_period_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reconciliation Deliverable Audit Period End Date
attributes.description: End date of the claims or payment period covered by this reconciliation deliverable. Paired with audit_period_start_date to define the full audit window.

tag_set.value: Reconciliation Deliverable Audit Period End Date

attributes.name: audit_period_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reconciliation Deliverable Audit Period Start Date
attributes.description: Start date of the claims or payment period covered by this reconciliation deliverable. Defines the scope of the PBM audit or rebate reconciliation window.

tag_set.value: Reconciliation Deliverable Audit Period Start Date

attributes.name: awp_discount_actual_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Actual Percentage
attributes.description: Actual AWP discount percentage achieved by the PBM for the audit period as computed from normalized claims data. Compared against awp_discount_guaranteed_pct.

tag_set.value: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Actual Percentage

attributes.name: awp_discount_guaranteed_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Guaranteed Percentage
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed AWP discount percentage for the audit period. Compared against awp_discount_actual_pct to identify brand or generic discount shortfalls.

tag_set.value: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Guaranteed Percentage

attributes.name: claim_count_audited
attributes.description: Total number of pharmacy claims included in the audit scope for this reconciliation deliverable. Supports per-claim rate calculations and audit completeness validation.

attributes.name: client_name
attributes.description: Name of the employer client for whom this deliverable was produced. Denormalized for reporting. Confidential as it identifies a specific consulting client relationship.

attributes.name: client_response_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reconciliation Deliverable Client Response Due Date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the client must accept, dispute, or respond to the reconciliation deliverable findings. Drives consulting engagement SLA tracking.

tag_set.value: Reconciliation Deliverable Client Response Due Date

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reconciliation deliverable record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this deliverable. Typically USD for PillarRx employer plan clients.

attributes.name: deliverable_engagement_fk
attributes.description: FK to division.division_engagement.division_engagement_id — Every deliverable is produced under an engagement; required to close the accountability loop and attribute recovery amounts.

attributes.name: deliverable_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this reconciliation deliverable, used in client communications, audit reports, and Salesforce CRM tracking.

attributes.name: deliverable_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the reconciliation deliverable. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_review|pending_client|delivered|accepted|disputed|closed — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: deliverable_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reconciliation deliverable by audit scope. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pbm_audit|rebate_reconciliation|guarantee_audit|spread_analysis|dir_reconciliation|combined — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_actual
attributes.description: Actual average dispensing fee per claim billed by the PBM during the audit period. Compared against dispensing_fee_guaranteed to identify fee overcharges.

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_guaranteed
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed dispensing fee per claim for the audit period. Compared against actual dispensing fees billed by the PBM to identify overcharges.

attributes.name: dispute_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount formally disputed by the PBM or client in response to this reconciliation deliverable findings. Nullable when no dispute has been raised.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation of the basis for the dispute raised against this reconciliation deliverable. Captured for audit trail and resolution tracking.

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current status of any formal dispute raised against the PBM findings in this deliverable. Tracks dispute lifecycle from submission through resolution.

attributes.name: division_engagement_fk
attributes.description: FK to division.division_engagement.division_engagement_id — Each client-facing deliverable is produced under a specific consulting engagement; closes the accountability loop.

attributes.name: engagement_fk
attributes.description: FK to division.division_engagement.division_engagement_id — Each deliverable is produced under a consulting engagement; FK closes the accountability loop.

attributes.name: guarantee_type
attributes.description: Category of PBM contractual guarantee being reconciled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: awp_discount|dispensing_fee|rebate|mac|ger|ber|dir — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: guaranteed_amount
attributes.description: The contractually guaranteed dollar amount the PBM committed to deliver for the audit period (e.g., guaranteed rebate total or guaranteed effective rate savings).

attributes.name: is_pass_through
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PBM contract under audit operates on a pass-through (transparent) pricing model. Affects how spread and rebate reconciliation logic is applied.

attributes.name: issued_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reconciliation deliverable was formally issued and transmitted to the client. Principal business event date for this transaction.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for analyst notes, caveats, or contextual commentary on the reconciliation deliverable findings. Not used for structured data.

attributes.name: rebate_actual_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate Actual Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: Actual rebate amount on a per-member-per-month basis for the audit period as reconciled from PBM remittance data. Compared against rebate_guaranteed_pmpm.

tag_set.value: Rebate Actual Per Member Per Month (PMPM)

attributes.name: rebate_guaranteed_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate Guaranteed Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed rebate amount on a per-member-per-month basis for the audit period. Key PBM performance benchmark metric.

tag_set.value: Rebate Guaranteed Per Member Per Month (PMPM)

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount recovered or credited to the client as a result of this reconciliation deliverable. May be less than variance_amount if partially disputed or settled.

attributes.name: report_file_reference
attributes.description: Path or URI to the reconciliation report document (PDF, Excel) stored in the document management system or data lakehouse. Enables direct access to the client-facing artifact.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reconciliation deliverable dispute or open finding was formally resolved between PillarRx, the client, and the PBM.

attributes.name: salesforce_opportunity_code
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM opportunity or case identifier linked to this reconciliation deliverable for consulting engagement tracking and client relationship management.

attributes.name: total_drug_spend
attributes.description: Aggregate plan drug spend across all claims in the audit scope for this deliverable. Used as the denominator for rebate-as-percent-of-spend and AWP discount calculations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reconciliation deliverable record was last modified. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Dollar difference between guaranteed_amount and actual_amount (guaranteed minus actual). Positive value indicates a shortfall owed to the client by the PBM.

attributes.name: variance_pct
attributes.description: Variance expressed as a percentage of the guaranteed amount. Enables benchmarking of PBM performance shortfalls across clients and audit periods.
