CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`claim_adjustment`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Pharmacy claim adjustment and reversal metrics tracking financial corrections, rebills, and claim lifecycle changes that impact net pharmacy spend."
  source: "`pillarrx`.`claim`.`adjustment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "adjustment_status"
      display_name: "Adjustment Status"
      expr: adjustment_status
      comment: "Status of the adjustment transaction (approved, denied, pending)"
    - name: "adjustment_type"
      display_name: "Adjustment Type"
      expr: adjustment_type
      comment: "Type of adjustment (price correction, quantity correction, reversal, rebill)"
    - name: "is_reversal"
      display_name: "Is Reversal"
      expr: is_reversal
      comment: "Indicates whether the adjustment is a full claim reversal"
    - name: "is_rebill"
      display_name: "Is Rebill"
      expr: is_rebill
      comment: "Indicates whether the adjustment is a rebill of a previously reversed claim"
    - name: "reason_code"
      display_name: "Reason Code"
      expr: reason_code
      comment: "Code indicating the reason for the adjustment"
    - name: "adjustment_date"
      display_name: "Adjustment Date"
      expr: adjustment_date
      comment: "Date the adjustment was processed"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "adjustment_month"
      display_name: "Adjustment Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', adjustment_date)
      comment: "Month bucket for adjustment date"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "original_dos"
      display_name: "Original Date of Service"
      expr: original_dos
      comment: "Original date of service for the adjusted claim"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "total_adjustments"
      display_name: "Total Adjustments"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total count of adjustment transactions"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_reversals"
      display_name: "Total Reversals"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_reversal = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of full claim reversals"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_rebills"
      display_name: "Total Rebills"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_rebill = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of rebilled claims after reversal"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "net_ingredient_cost_adj"
      display_name: "Net Ingredient Cost Adjustment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ingredient_cost_adj AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net adjustment to ingredient cost (positive = increase, negative = decrease)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "net_dispensing_fee_adj"
      display_name: "Net Dispensing Fee Adjustment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(dispensing_fee_adj AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net adjustment to dispensing fees"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "net_total_cost_adj"
      display_name: "Net Total Cost Adjustment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_cost_adj AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net adjustment to total claim cost (critical for true pharmacy spend)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "net_plan_paid_adj"
      display_name: "Net Plan Paid Adjustment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(plan_paid_adj AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net adjustment to plan paid amount"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "net_member_copay_adj"
      display_name: "Net Member Copay Adjustment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(member_copay_adj AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net adjustment to member copay"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "net_member_coinsurance_adj"
      display_name: "Net Member Coinsurance Adjustment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(member_coinsurance_adj AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net adjustment to member coinsurance"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "net_deductible_adj"
      display_name: "Net Deductible Adjustment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(deductible_adj AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net adjustment to deductible applied"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "net_oop_adj"
      display_name: "Net OOP Adjustment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(oop_adj AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net adjustment to out-of-pocket amounts"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "net_dir_fee_adj"
      display_name: "Net DIR Fee Adjustment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(dir_fee_adj AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net adjustment to Direct and Indirect Remuneration fees (Medicare Part D)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "reversal_rate"
      display_name: "Reversal Rate"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_reversal = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of adjustments that are full reversals (quality/audit metric)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_total_cost_adj_per_adjustment"
      display_name: "Avg Total Cost Adjustment"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_cost_adj AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average total cost adjustment per transaction"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Pharmacy claim adjustment and reversal metrics tracking financial corrections, rebills, and claim lifecycle changes that impact net pharmacy spend.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`claim_adjustment_reversal_rate`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Rate of claim adjustments and reversals, a data quality and operational efficiency metric. High rates may indicate billing errors or member eligibility issues."
  source: "`pillarrx`.`claim`.`adjustment`"
  filter: adjustment_status = 'Processed'
  dimensions:
    - name: "Adjustment Date"
      display_name: "Adjustment date"
      expr: adjustment_date
      comment: "Date adjustment was processed"
    - name: "Adjustment Type"
      display_name: "Adjustment type"
      expr: adjustment_type
      comment: "Reversal, price correction, etc."
  measures:
    - name: "Adjustment Count"
      display_name: "Adjustment count"
      expr: COUNT(adjustment_id)
      comment: "Number of adjustments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Adjustment Amount"
      display_name: "Total adjustment amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_cost_adj AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total dollar impact of adjustments"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Adjustment Amount"
      display_name: "Avg adjustment amount"
      expr: ROUND(SUM(CAST(total_cost_adj AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(COUNT(adjustment_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Average adjustment amount"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Rate of claim adjustments and reversals, a data quality and operational efficiency metric. High rates may indicate billing errors or member eligibility issues.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`claim_dur_alert_rate`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

  source: "`pillarrx`.`claim`.`dur_event`"

  measures:

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`claim_member_oop_accumulator`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Member-level deductible and out-of-pocket accumulator metrics tracking benefit utilization, cost-sharing progress, and member financial exposure across benefit years."
  source: "`pillarrx`.`claim`.`member_oop_accumulator`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "accumulator_type"
      display_name: "Accumulator Type"
      expr: accumulator_type
      comment: "Type of accumulator (deductible, OOP max, TROOP for Medicare Part D)"
    - name: "accumulator_status"
      display_name: "Accumulator Status"
      expr: accumulator_status
      comment: "Status of the accumulator (active, met, expired)"
    - name: "coverage_type"
      display_name: "Coverage Type"
      expr: coverage_type
      comment: "Type of coverage (individual, family, employee+spouse, etc.)"
    - name: "deductible_met_flag"
      display_name: "Deductible Met"
      expr: deductible_met_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the member has met their deductible"
    - name: "oop_met_flag"
      display_name: "OOP Max Met"
      expr: oop_met_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the member has met their out-of-pocket maximum"
    - name: "medicare_part_d_flag"
      display_name: "Medicare Part D"
      expr: medicare_part_d_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether this is a Medicare Part D accumulator"
    - name: "benefit_year"
      display_name: "Benefit Year"
      expr: benefit_year
      comment: "Benefit year for the accumulator period"
    - name: "benefit_year_start_date"
      display_name: "Benefit Year Start"
      expr: benefit_year_start_date
      comment: "Start date of the benefit year"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "deductible_met_date"
      display_name: "Deductible Met Date"
      expr: deductible_met_date
      comment: "Date the member met their deductible"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "oop_met_date"
      display_name: "OOP Max Met Date"
      expr: oop_met_date
      comment: "Date the member met their out-of-pocket maximum"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "total_members_with_accumulators"
      display_name: "Total Members with Accumulators"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT member_id)
      comment: "Count of distinct members with accumulator records"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "members_deductible_met"
      display_name: "Members - Deductible Met"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN deductible_met_flag = TRUE THEN member_id END)
      comment: "Count of members who have met their deductible"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "members_oop_max_met"
      display_name: "Members - OOP Max Met"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oop_met_flag = TRUE THEN member_id END)
      comment: "Count of members who have met their out-of-pocket maximum"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_deductible_applied"
      display_name: "Total Deductible Applied"
      expr: SUM(CAST(deductible_applied_amt AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of deductible amounts applied across all members"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_deductible_maximum"
      display_name: "Total Deductible Maximum"
      expr: SUM(CAST(deductible_maximum_amt AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of deductible maximum amounts across all members"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_deductible_remaining"
      display_name: "Total Deductible Remaining"
      expr: SUM(CAST(deductible_remaining_amt AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of remaining deductible amounts across all members"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_oop_applied"
      display_name: "Total OOP Applied"
      expr: SUM(CAST(oop_applied_amt AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of out-of-pocket amounts applied across all members"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_oop_maximum"
      display_name: "Total OOP Maximum"
      expr: SUM(CAST(oop_maximum_amt AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of out-of-pocket maximum amounts across all members"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_oop_remaining"
      display_name: "Total OOP Remaining"
      expr: SUM(CAST(oop_remaining_amt AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of remaining out-of-pocket amounts across all members"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_copay_applied"
      display_name: "Total Copay Applied"
      expr: SUM(CAST(copay_applied_amt AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of copay amounts applied to accumulators"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_coinsurance_applied"
      display_name: "Total Coinsurance Applied"
      expr: SUM(CAST(coinsurance_applied_amt AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of coinsurance amounts applied to accumulators"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_cap_applied"
      display_name: "Total CAP Applied"
      expr: SUM(CAST(cap_applied_amt AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of copay assistance program amounts applied (reduces member OOP)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_troop_applied"
      display_name: "Total TrOOP Applied"
      expr: SUM(CAST(troop_applied_amt AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of True Out-of-Pocket amounts applied (Medicare Part D catastrophic threshold)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_deductible_applied_per_member"
      display_name: "Avg Deductible Applied per Member"
      expr: AVG(CAST(deductible_applied_amt AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average deductible amount applied per member"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_oop_applied_per_member"
      display_name: "Avg OOP Applied per Member"
      expr: AVG(CAST(oop_applied_amt AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average out-of-pocket amount applied per member"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "deductible_attainment_rate"
      display_name: "Deductible Attainment Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(deductible_applied_amt AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(deductible_maximum_amt AS DOUBLE)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of deductible maximum that has been applied (member financial exposure metric)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "oop_attainment_rate"
      display_name: "OOP Attainment Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(oop_applied_amt AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(oop_maximum_amt AS DOUBLE)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of OOP maximum that has been applied (member financial protection metric)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "deductible_met_rate"
      display_name: "Deductible Met Rate"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN deductible_met_flag = TRUE THEN member_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT member_id), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of members who have met their deductible"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "oop_max_met_rate"
      display_name: "OOP Max Met Rate"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oop_met_flag = TRUE THEN member_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT member_id), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of members who have met their out-of-pocket maximum (high-cost member indicator)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Member-level deductible and out-of-pocket accumulator metrics tracking benefit utilization, cost-sharing progress, and member financial exposure across benefit years.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`claim_member_oop_accumulator_status`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Tracks member progress toward deductible and out-of-pocket maximums, critical for benefit design analysis and member affordability assessment."
  source: "`pillarrx`.`claim`.`member_oop_accumulator`"
  filter: accumulator_status = 'Active'
  dimensions:
    - name: "Benefit Year"
      display_name: "Benefit year"
      expr: benefit_year
      comment: "Benefit year"
    - name: "Coverage Type"
      display_name: "Coverage type"
      expr: coverage_type
      comment: "Medical, pharmacy, or integrated"
  measures:
    - name: "Avg Deductible Met %"
      display_name: "Avg deductible met %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * AVG(deductible_applied_amt / NULLIF(deductible_maximum_amt, 0)), 2)
      comment: "Average percentage of deductible met"
    - name: "Avg OOP Met %"
      display_name: "Avg oop met %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * AVG(oop_applied_amt / NULLIF(oop_maximum_amt, 0)), 2)
      comment: "Average percentage of OOP max met"
    - name: "Members with Deductible Met"
      display_name: "Members with deductible met"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN deductible_met_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of members who met deductible"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Members"
      display_name: "Total members"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT member_id)
      comment: "Total unique members"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$
metric_views.description: Tracks member progress toward deductible and out-of-pocket maximums, critical for benefit design analysis and member affordability assessment.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`claim_pbm_feed_batch_quality`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Data quality metrics for PBM feed ingestion batches, tracking record counts, error rates, and processing SLA compliance."
  source: "`pillarrx`.`claim`.`pbm_feed_batch`"
  filter: batch_status IN ('Completed', 'Failed')
  dimensions:
    - name: "Feed Type"
      display_name: "Feed type"
      expr: feed_type
      comment: "Claims, eligibility, or formulary"
    - name: "Batch Status"
      display_name: "Batch status"
      expr: batch_status
      comment: "Completed or failed"
  measures:
    - name: "Batch Success Rate %"
      display_name: "Batch success rate %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN batch_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(pbm_feed_batch_id), 0), 2)

        type: percentage
        decimal_places:

    - name: "decision_date"
      display_name: "Decision Date"

      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "effective_date"
      display_name: "Effective Date"

        type: date

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "total_approved_quantity"

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_approved_days_supply"
      display_name: "Total Approved Days Supply"
      expr: SUM(CAST(approved_days_supply AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of approved days supply"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_approved_days_supply"
      display_name: "Avg Approved Days Supply"
      expr: AVG(CAST(approved_days_supply AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average days supply approved per prior authorization"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "clinical_criteria_met_rate"
      display_name: "Clinical Criteria Met Rate"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN clinical_criteria_met = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of PAs where clinical criteria were met"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "step_therapy_required_rate"
      display_name: "Step Therapy Required Rate"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN step_therapy_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of PAs requiring step therapy (formulary management metric)"

        decimal_places:
          type: exact

    - name: "specialty_drug_pa_rate"

    - name: "unique_members_with_pa"

    - name: "pa_per_member"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`claim_rebate_record`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Pharmacy rebate metrics tracking manufacturer rebate revenue, pass-through arrangements, and net pharmacy cost after rebates — critical for true cost-of-care analysis."
  source: "`pillarrx`.`claim`.`rebate_record`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "rebate_status"
      display_name: "Rebate Status"
      expr: rebate_status
      comment: "Status of the rebate record (estimated, invoiced, received, disputed)"
    - name: "rebate_type"
      display_name: "Rebate Type"
      expr: rebate_type
      comment: "Type of rebate (formulary, market share, performance, specialty)"
    - name: "rebate_basis"
      display_name: "Rebate Basis"
      expr: rebate_basis
      comment: "Basis for rebate calculation (per claim, per unit, percentage of AWP)"
    - name: "is_pass_through"
      display_name: "Is Pass-Through"
      expr: is_pass_through
      comment: "Indicates whether rebate is passed through to the client"
    - name: "is_340b_excluded"
      display_name: "340B Excluded"
      expr: is_340b_excluded
      comment: "Indicates whether 340B claims are excluded from rebate calculation"
    - name: "formulary_tier"
      display_name: "Formulary Tier"
      expr: formulary_tier
      comment: "Formulary tier of the rebated drug"
    - name: "manufacturer_name"
      display_name: "Manufacturer"
      expr: manufacturer_name
      comment: "Name of the drug manufacturer providing the rebate"
    - name: "therapeutic_class_code"
      display_name: "Therapeutic Class"
      expr: therapeutic_class_code
      comment: "Therapeutic class code for the rebated drug"
    - name: "benefit_period_start_date"
      display_name: "Benefit Period Start"
      expr: benefit_period_start_date
      comment: "Start date of the rebate benefit period"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "invoice_date"
      display_name: "Invoice Date"
      expr: invoice_date
      comment: "Date the rebate was invoiced"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "received_date"
      display_name: "Received Date"
      expr: received_date
      comment: "Date the rebate payment was received"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "total_rebate_records"
      display_name: "Total Rebate Records"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total count of rebate records"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_claim_count"
      display_name: "Total Claim Count"
      expr: SUM(CAST(claim_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total count of claims associated with rebate records"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_unit_count"
      display_name: "Total Unit Count"
      expr: SUM(CAST(unit_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total count of drug units associated with rebate records"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_estimated_rebate"
      display_name: "Total Estimated Rebate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_rebate_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of estimated rebate amounts (accrual basis)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_invoiced_rebate"
      display_name: "Total Invoiced Rebate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(invoiced_rebate_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of invoiced rebate amounts"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_received_rebate"
      display_name: "Total Received Rebate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(received_rebate_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of received rebate amounts (cash basis)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_net_rebate"
      display_name: "Total Net Rebate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_rebate_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of net rebate amounts after adjustments and admin fees"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_admin_fee"
      display_name: "Total Admin Fee"
      expr: SUM(CAST(admin_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of PBM administrative fees deducted from rebates"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_adjustment_amount"
      display_name: "Total Adjustment Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(adjustment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of rebate adjustment amounts (positive or negative)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_rebate_per_claim"
      display_name: "Avg Rebate per Claim"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_rebate_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(claim_count AS DOUBLE)), 0)
      comment: "Average net rebate amount per claim"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_rebate_per_unit"
      display_name: "Avg Rebate per Unit"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_rebate_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(unit_count AS DOUBLE)), 0)
      comment: "Average net rebate amount per drug unit"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "rebate_realization_rate"
      display_name: "Rebate Realization Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(received_rebate_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(invoiced_rebate_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of invoiced rebates actually received (cash collection efficiency)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "admin_fee_rate"
      display_name: "Admin Fee Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(admin_fee_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(invoiced_rebate_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0)
      comment: "PBM administrative fee as percentage of invoiced rebates"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "pass_through_rebate_amount"
      display_name: "Pass-Through Rebate Amount"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_pass_through = TRUE THEN CAST(net_rebate_amount AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Sum of rebates passed through to clients (transparent pricing model)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "pass_through_rate"
      display_name: "Pass-Through Rate"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_pass_through = TRUE THEN CAST(net_rebate_amount AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(net_rebate_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of rebates passed through to clients vs retained by PBM"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Pharmacy rebate metrics tracking manufacturer rebate revenue, pass-through arrangements, and net pharmacy cost after rebates — critical for true cost-of-care analysis.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`claim_brand_effective_rate`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Average cost per brand claim as a percentage of AWP, a key PBM pricing guarantee metric. Measures the discount achieved on brand drugs."
  source: "`pillarrx`.`claim`.`rx_claim`"
  filter: claim_status = 'Paid' AND brand_generic_indicator = 'Brand' AND awp_unit_price > 0
  dimensions:
    - name: "Date of Service"
      display_name: "Date of service"
      expr: date_of_service
      comment: "Date the prescription was filled"
    - name: "Specialty Drug"
      display_name: "Specialty drug"
      expr: specialty_drug_flag
      comment: "Specialty vs traditional brand"
  measures:
    - name: "BER %"
      display_name: "Ber %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(ingredient_cost AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(awp_unit_price AS DOUBLE) * CAST(quantity_dispensed AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Brand effective rate as % of AWP"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Brand Cost"
      display_name: "Total brand cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ingredient_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total ingredient cost for brand drugs"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Brand AWP"
      display_name: "Total brand awp"
      expr: SUM(CAST(awp_unit_price AS DOUBLE) * CAST(quantity_dispensed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total AWP for brand drugs"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Brand Claim Count"
      display_name: "Brand claim count"
      expr: COUNT(rx_claim_id)
      comment: "Number of brand claims"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`claim_generic_effective_rate`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Average cost per generic claim as a percentage of AWP, a key PBM pricing guarantee metric. Measures the discount achieved on generic drugs."
  source: "`pillarrx`.`claim`.`rx_claim`"

        decimal_places:

          places: 2
    - name: "Total Generic AWP"

      comment: "Total AWP for generic drugs"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:

          places: 2
    - name: "Generic Claim Count"
      display_name: "Generic claim count"

      format:

        decimal_places:

$$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`claim_rx_claim`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core pharmacy claim transaction metrics at the individual fill grain, covering financial performance, utilization patterns, and member cost-sharing across PBMs and clients."
  source: "`pillarrx`.`claim`.`rx_claim`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "claim_status"
      display_name: "Claim Status"
      expr: claim_status
      comment: "Status of the pharmacy claim (paid, denied, reversed, adjusted)"
    - name: "claim_type"
      display_name: "Claim Type"
      expr: claim_type
      comment: "Type of claim transaction (original fill, refill, reversal, adjustment)"
    - name: "brand_generic_indicator"
      display_name: "Brand/Generic"
      expr: brand_generic_indicator
      comment: "Indicates whether the dispensed drug is brand or generic"
    - name: "formulary_tier"
      display_name: "Formulary Tier"
      expr: formulary_tier
      comment: "Formulary tier of the dispensed drug (Tier 1/2/3/4, Specialty)"
    - name: "daw_code"
      display_name: "DAW Code"
      expr: daw_code
      comment: "Dispense As Written code indicating substitution status"
    - name: "mail_order_flag"
      display_name: "Mail Order"
      expr: mail_order_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the claim was filled via mail order pharmacy"
    - name: "specialty_drug_flag"
      display_name: "Specialty Drug"
      expr: specialty_drug_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the dispensed drug is classified as specialty"
    - name: "network_indicator"
      display_name: "Network Status"
      expr: network_indicator
      comment: "Indicates whether the pharmacy is in-network or out-of-network"
    - name: "compound_flag"
      display_name: "Compound"
      expr: compound_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the prescription is a compound medication"
    - name: "fill_date"
      display_name: "Fill Date"
      expr: fill_date
      comment: "Date the prescription was filled"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "fill_year"
      display_name: "Fill Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', fill_date)
      comment: "Year bucket for fill date, used for year-over-year analysis"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "fill_quarter"
      display_name: "Fill Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', fill_date)
      comment: "Quarter bucket for fill date, used for quarter-over-quarter analysis"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "fill_month"
      display_name: "Fill Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', fill_date)
      comment: "Month bucket for fill date, used for month-over-month analysis"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "date_of_service"
      display_name: "Date of Service"
      expr: date_of_service
      comment: "Date of service for the pharmacy claim"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "paid_date"
      display_name: "Paid Date"
      expr: paid_date
      comment: "Date the claim was paid by the plan"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "total_claims"
      display_name: "Total Claims"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total count of pharmacy claim transactions"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "unique_members"
      display_name: "Unique Members"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT member_id)
      comment: "Count of distinct members with pharmacy claims"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "unique_prescriptions"
      display_name: "Unique Prescriptions"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT rx_number)
      comment: "Count of distinct prescription numbers filled"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_ingredient_cost"
      display_name: "Total Ingredient Cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ingredient_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of ingredient cost paid to pharmacy for dispensed drugs"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_dispensing_fee"
      display_name: "Total Dispensing Fee"
      expr: SUM(CAST(dispensing_fee AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of dispensing fees paid to pharmacies"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_cost"
      display_name: "Total Cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of total pharmacy claim cost (ingredient cost + dispensing fee + other charges)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_plan_paid"
      display_name: "Total Plan Paid"
      expr: SUM(CAST(plan_paid_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of amount paid by the health plan for pharmacy claims"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_member_copay"
      display_name: "Total Member Copay"
      expr: SUM(CAST(member_copay AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of member copayment amounts at point of sale"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_member_coinsurance"
      display_name: "Total Member Coinsurance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(member_coinsurance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of member coinsurance amounts (percentage-based cost sharing)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_member_cost_share"
      display_name: "Total Member Cost Share"
      expr: SUM((CAST(member_copay AS DOUBLE)) + (CAST(member_coinsurance AS DOUBLE)))
      comment: "Sum of total member out-of-pocket cost sharing (copay + coinsurance)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_deductible_applied"
      display_name: "Total Deductible Applied"
      expr: SUM(CAST(deductible_applied AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of deductible amounts applied to pharmacy claims"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_oop_applied"
      display_name: "Total OOP Applied"
      expr: SUM(CAST(oop_applied AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of out-of-pocket amounts applied toward member OOP maximum"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_other_payer_amount"
      display_name: "Total Other Payer Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(other_payer_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of amounts paid by other payers (coordination of benefits, manufacturer copay assistance)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_quantity_dispensed"
      display_name: "Total Quantity Dispensed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quantity_dispensed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of quantity of drug units dispensed across all claims"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_days_supply"
      display_name: "Total Days Supply"
      expr: SUM(CAST(days_supply AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of days supply dispensed across all claims"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_ingredient_cost_per_claim"
      display_name: "Avg Ingredient Cost per Claim"
      expr: AVG(CAST(ingredient_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average ingredient cost per pharmacy claim transaction"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_total_cost_per_claim"
      display_name: "Avg Total Cost per Claim"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average total cost per pharmacy claim transaction"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_plan_paid_per_claim"
      display_name: "Avg Plan Paid per Claim"
      expr: AVG(CAST(plan_paid_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average plan paid amount per pharmacy claim"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_member_cost_share_per_claim"
      display_name: "Avg Member Cost Share per Claim"
      expr: AVG(CAST(member_copay AS DOUBLE) + CAST(member_coinsurance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average member cost sharing (copay + coinsurance) per claim"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_days_supply_per_claim"
      display_name: "Avg Days Supply per Claim"
      expr: AVG(CAST(days_supply AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average days supply per pharmacy claim"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "avg_awp_discount_pct"
      display_name: "Avg AWP Discount %"
      expr: AVG(CAST(awp_discount_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average AWP discount percentage applied to claims"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "generic_fill_rate"
      display_name: "Generic Fill Rate"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN brand_generic_indicator = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of claims filled with generic drugs (key cost efficiency metric)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "specialty_drug_rate"
      display_name: "Specialty Drug Rate"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN specialty_drug_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of claims for specialty drugs (high-cost, high-complexity medications)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "mail_order_utilization_rate"
      display_name: "Mail Order Utilization Rate"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN mail_order_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of claims filled via mail order (typically lower cost channel)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "plan_cost_share_pct"
      display_name: "Plan Cost Share %"
      expr: SUM(CAST(plan_paid_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(total_cost AS DOUBLE)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of total pharmacy cost paid by the health plan"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "member_cost_share_pct"
      display_name: "Member Cost Share %"
      expr: (SUM(CAST(member_copay AS DOUBLE)) + SUM(CAST(member_coinsurance AS DOUBLE))) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(total_cost AS DOUBLE)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of total pharmacy cost paid by members out-of-pocket"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "claims_per_member"
      display_name: "Claims per Member"
      expr: COUNT(1) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT member_id), 0)
      comment: "Average number of pharmacy claims per unique member (utilization intensity)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_cost_current_month"
      display_name: "Total Cost (Current Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total pharmacy cost for the current month period"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: fill_month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "total_cost_prior_month"
      display_name: "Total Cost (Prior Month)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total pharmacy cost for the prior month period"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: fill_month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "total_cost_mom_growth"
      display_name: "Total Cost MoM Growth %"
      expr: (AGG(`total_cost_current_month`) - AGG(`total_cost_prior_month`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`total_cost_prior_month`), 0)
      comment: "Month-over-month growth rate in total pharmacy cost"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_cost_current_year"
      display_name: "Total Cost (Current Year)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total pharmacy cost for the current year period"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: fill_year
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "total_cost_prior_year"
      display_name: "Total Cost (Prior Year)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total pharmacy cost for the prior year period"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: fill_year
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 year
    - name: "total_cost_yoy_growth"
      display_name: "Total Cost YoY Growth %"
      expr: (AGG(`total_cost_current_year`) - AGG(`total_cost_prior_year`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`total_cost_prior_year`), 0)
      comment: "Year-over-year growth rate in total pharmacy cost"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_cost_ytd"
      display_name: "Total Cost (YTD)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Year-to-date cumulative total pharmacy cost"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: fill_date
          range: cumulative
          semiadditive: last
        - order: fill_year
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "total_cost_pytd"
      display_name: "Total Cost (Prior YTD)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Prior year-to-date cumulative total pharmacy cost"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
      window:
        - order: fill_date
          range: cumulative
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 year
        - order: fill_year
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 year
    - name: "total_cost_ytd_growth"
      display_name: "Total Cost YTD Growth %"
      expr: (AGG(`total_cost_ytd`) - AGG(`total_cost_pytd`)) / NULLIF(AGG(`total_cost_pytd`), 0)
      comment: "Year-to-date growth rate in total pharmacy cost vs prior year same period"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Core pharmacy claim transaction metrics at the individual fill grain, covering financial performance, utilization patterns, and member cost-sharing across PBMs and clients.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`claim_total_pharmacy_spend`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Total pharmacy spend across all claims, representing the aggregate cost of prescription drugs dispensed. This is the top-line P&L driver for PBM consulting analysis and client benchmarking."
  source: "`pillarrx`.`claim`.`rx_claim`"
  filter: claim_status = 'Paid'
  dimensions:
    - name: "Date of Service"
      display_name: "Date of service"
      expr: date_of_service
      comment: "Date the prescription was filled"
    - name: "Brand/Generic"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`client_audit_finding`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "PBM audit finding metrics tracking identified contract violations, financial impact, recovery performance, and audit ROI for client value demonstration and PBM accountability."
  source: "`pillarrx`.`client`.`audit_finding`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "audit_finding_id"
      display_name: "Finding ID"
      expr: audit_finding_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the audit finding"
    - name: "finding_status"
      display_name: "Finding Status"
      expr: finding_status
      comment: "Current status of the finding (identified, submitted, acknowledged, resolved, disputed)"
    - name: "finding_type"
      display_name: "Finding Type"
      expr: finding_type
      comment: "Category of audit finding (pricing error, rebate shortfall, contract violation, etc.)"
    - name: "audit_type"
      display_name: "Audit Type"
      expr: audit_type
      comment: "Type of audit that identified the finding"
    - name: "severity"
      display_name: "Severity"
      expr: severity
      comment: "Severity level of the finding (critical, high, medium, low)"
    - name: "pbm_name"
      display_name: "PBM Name"
      expr: pbm_name
      comment: "Name of the PBM where the finding was identified"
    - name: "drug_category"
      display_name: "Drug Category"
      expr: drug_category
      comment: "Drug category associated with the finding"
    - name: "dispensing_channel"
      display_name: "Dispensing Channel"
      expr: dispensing_channel
      comment: "Dispensing channel where the finding occurred (retail, mail, specialty)"
    - name: "is_recoverable_flag"
      display_name: "Is Recoverable"
      expr: is_recoverable
      comment: "Whether the finding amount is financially recoverable from the PBM"
    - name: "is_disputed_flag"
      display_name: "Is Disputed"
      expr: is_disputed
      comment: "Whether the finding is disputed by the PBM"
    - name: "identified_month"
      display_name: "Identified Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', identified_date)
      comment: "Month the finding was identified"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "identified_year"
      display_name: "Identified Year"
      expr: YEAR(identified_date)
      comment: "Year the finding was identified"
    - name: "resolved_month"
      display_name: "Resolved Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', resolved_date)
      comment: "Month the finding was resolved"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "total_findings"
      display_name: "Total Findings"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT audit_finding_id)
      comment: "Total number of audit findings identified"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_claims_audited"
      display_name: "Total Claims Audited"
      expr: SUM(CAST(claim_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of pharmacy claims covered by audit findings"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_members_impacted"
      display_name: "Total Members Impacted"
      expr: SUM(CAST(member_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of members impacted by audit findings"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_estimated_impact"
      display_name: "Total Estimated Impact"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_impact_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated financial impact of all findings (potential savings identified)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_estimated_impact_per_finding"
      display_name: "Avg Impact per Finding"
      expr: AVG(CAST(estimated_impact_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average estimated financial impact per finding"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_disputed_amount"
      display_name: "Total Disputed Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(disputed_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount disputed by PBMs"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_pbm_acknowledged_amount"
      display_name: "Total PBM Acknowledged"
      expr: SUM(CAST(pbm_acknowledged_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount acknowledged by PBMs as valid findings"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_recovered_amount"
      display_name: "Total Recovered Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(recovered_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount actually recovered from PBMs (realized savings)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "recovery_rate"
      display_name: "Recovery Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(recovered_amount AS DOUBLE)) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CAST(estimated_impact_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Percentage of estimated impact that was successfully recovered (audit ROI indicator)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "pbm_acknowledgment_rate"
      display_name: "PBM Acknowledgment Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(pbm_acknowledged_amount AS DOUBLE)) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CAST(estimated_impact_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Percentage of estimated impact acknowledged by PBMs as valid"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "dispute_rate"
      display_name: "Dispute Rate"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_disputed = TRUE THEN audit_finding_id END) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT audit_finding_id), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Percentage of findings disputed by PBMs"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "recoverable_findings_rate"
      display_name: "Recoverable Findings Rate"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_recoverable = TRUE THEN audit_finding_id END) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT audit_finding_id), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Percentage of findings that are financially recoverable"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_impact_per_claim"
      display_name: "Avg Impact per Claim"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_impact_amount AS DOUBLE)) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CAST(claim_count AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Average financial impact per audited claim"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_recovery_per_finding"
      display_name: "Avg Recovery per Finding"
      expr: AVG(CAST(recovered_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average amount recovered per finding"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: PBM audit finding metrics tracking identified contract violations, financial impact, recovery performance, and audit ROI for client value demonstration and PBM accountability.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`client_consulting_fee_invoice`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Consulting revenue and billing metrics tracking invoice performance, payment collection, fee realization, and accounts receivable for financial operations and revenue forecasting."
  source: "`pillarrx`.`client`.`consulting_fee_invoice`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "consulting_fee_invoice_id"
      display_name: "Invoice ID"
      expr: consulting_fee_invoice_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the consulting fee invoice"
    - name: "invoice_status"
      display_name: "Invoice Status"
      expr: invoice_status
      comment: "Current status of the invoice (draft, sent, paid, overdue, voided)"
    - name: "fee_type"
      display_name: "Fee Type"
      expr: fee_type
      comment: "Type of consulting fee (fixed, PMPM, hourly, contingency, milestone)"
    - name: "service_type"
      display_name: "Service Type"
      expr: service_type
      comment: "Type of service being invoiced"
    - name: "billing_frequency"
      display_name: "Billing Frequency"
      expr: billing_frequency
      comment: "Frequency of billing (monthly, quarterly, annual, one-time)"
    - name: "payment_terms"
      display_name: "Payment Terms"
      expr: payment_terms
      comment: "Payment terms for the invoice (Net 30, Net 60, etc.)"
    - name: "payment_method"
      display_name: "Payment Method"
      expr: payment_method
      comment: "Method of payment received"
    - name: "dispute_flag"
      display_name: "Disputed"
      expr: dispute_flag
      comment: "Whether the invoice is disputed by the client"
    - name: "is_renewal_invoice_flag"
      display_name: "Renewal Invoice"
      expr: is_renewal_invoice
      comment: "Whether this invoice is for a renewal engagement"
    - name: "invoice_month"
      display_name: "Invoice Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date)
      comment: "Month the invoice was issued"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "invoice_year"
      display_name: "Invoice Year"
      expr: YEAR(invoice_date)
      comment: "Year the invoice was issued"
    - name: "billing_period_month"
      display_name: "Billing Period Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', billing_period_start_date)
      comment: "Month of the billing period start"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "total_invoices"
      display_name: "Total Invoices"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT consulting_fee_invoice_id)
      comment: "Total number of consulting fee invoices issued"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_invoice_amount"
      display_name: "Total Invoice Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(invoice_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross invoice amount across all invoices"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_net_amount"
      display_name: "Total Net Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net invoice amount after adjustments"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_paid_amount"
      display_name: "Total Paid Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(paid_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount paid by clients (cash collected)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_adjustment_amount"
      display_name: "Total Adjustments"
      expr: SUM(CAST(adjustment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total adjustments applied to invoices"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_tax_amount"
      display_name: "Total Tax Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax amount across all invoices"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_invoice_amount"
      display_name: "Avg Invoice Amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(invoice_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average invoice amount per invoice"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "collection_rate"
      display_name: "Collection Rate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(paid_amount AS DOUBLE)) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Percentage of net invoice amount that has been collected (cash collection efficiency)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "dispute_rate"
      display_name: "Dispute Rate"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dispute_flag = TRUE THEN consulting_fee_invoice_id END) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT consulting_fee_invoice_id), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Percentage of invoices that are disputed by clients"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_pmpm_rate"
      display_name: "Avg PMPM Rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(pmpm_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average per-member-per-month rate across PMPM invoices"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 4
    - name: "total_billed_claims"
      display_name: "Total Billed Claims"
      expr: SUM(CAST(billed_claim_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of claims billed across all invoices"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_billed_members"
      display_name: "Total Billed Members"
      expr: SUM(CAST(billed_member_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of members billed across all invoices"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_per_claim_rate"
      display_name: "Avg Per-Claim Rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(per_claim_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average per-claim billing rate across per-claim invoices"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 4
    - name: "outstanding_ar"
      display_name: "Outstanding AR"
      expr: SUM((CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE)) - (CAST(paid_amount AS DOUBLE)))
      comment: "Total outstanding accounts receivable (net amount not yet collected)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Consulting revenue and billing metrics tracking invoice performance, payment collection, fee realization, and accounts receivable for financial operations and revenue forecasting.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`company_client_pbm_contract`
WITH METRICS

      expr: formulary_type
      comment: "Type of drug formulary (open, closed, tiered, custom)"
    - name: "awp_source"

          places: 2
    - name: "avg_specialty_generic_discount"

        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_specialty_brand_discount"

      expr: AVG(CAST(specialty_brand_awp_discount AS DOUBLE))

      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_retail_dispensing_fee"

      comment: "Average dispensing fee for retail pharmacy (key cost component)"

        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_mail_dispensing_fee"

        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_specialty_dispensing_fee"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`company_client`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core client metrics tracking active employer clients, member populations, and multi-PBM complexity across the PillarRx consulting portfolio"
  source: "`pillarrx`.`company`.`company_client`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "client_status"
      display_name: "Client Status"
      expr: client_status
      comment: "Current status of the employer client relationship (active, inactive, onboarding, terminated)"
    - name: "client_type"
      display_name: "Client Type"
      expr: client_type
      comment: "Classification of client engagement model (fully-insured, self-funded, level-funded, etc.)"
    - name: "industry_segment"
      display_name: "Industry Segment"
      expr: industry_segment
      comment: "Industry vertical of the employer client (manufacturing, healthcare, retail, etc.)"
    - name: "primary_pbm"
      display_name: "Primary PBM"
      expr: primary_pbm
      comment: "Primary pharmacy benefit manager for this client (CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts, etc.)"
    - name: "formulary_type"
      display_name: "Formulary Type"
      expr: formulary_type
      comment: "Type of drug formulary in use (open, closed, tiered, custom)"
    - name: "consulting_fee_model"
      display_name: "Consulting Fee Model"
      expr: consulting_fee_model
      comment: "Revenue model for consulting services (flat fee, PMPM, percentage of savings, hybrid)"
    - name: "multi_pbm_flag"
      display_name: "Multi-PBM Client"
      expr: multi_pbm_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether client uses multiple PBMs requiring cross-PBM normalization and analysis"
    - name: "cap_enrolled_flag"
      display_name: "CAP Enrolled"
      expr: cap_enrolled_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether client is enrolled in PillarRx copay assistance program (PAX application)"
    - name: "specialty_carve_out_flag"
      display_name: "Specialty Carve-Out"
      expr: specialty_carve_out_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether specialty pharmacy is carved out to a separate vendor"
    - name: "three_forty_b_eligible_flag"
      display_name: "340B Eligible"
      expr: three_forty_b_eligible_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether client is eligible for 340B drug pricing program"
    - name: "medical_integration_flag"
      display_name: "Medical Integration"
      expr: medical_integration_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether medical claims are integrated for total cost of care analysis"
    - name: "onboarding_year"
      display_name: "Onboarding Year"
      expr: YEAR(onboarding_date)
      comment: "Year the client was onboarded to PillarRx"
    - name: "onboarding_month"
      display_name: "Onboarding Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', onboarding_date)
      comment: "Month the client was onboarded to PillarRx"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "plan_year_start_month"
      display_name: "Plan Year Start Month"
      expr: plan_year_start_month
      comment: "Month number (1-12) when client plan year begins"
  measures:
    - name: "total_clients"
      display_name: "Total Clients"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT company_client_id)
      comment: "Distinct count of employer clients in the PillarRx portfolio"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "active_clients"
      display_name: "Active Clients"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN client_status = 'active' THEN company_client_id END)
      comment: "Count of clients with active consulting engagements"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_covered_members"
      display_name: "Total Covered Members"
      expr: SUM(CAST(member_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of member populations across all clients (key revenue driver for PMPM models)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_member_count_per_client"
      display_name: "Avg Members per Client"
      expr: AVG(CAST(member_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average member population size per client (client size indicator)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "total_employees"
      display_name: "Total Employees"
      expr: SUM(CAST(employee_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of employee counts across all employer clients"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "multi_pbm_client_count"
      display_name: "Multi-PBM Clients"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN multi_pbm_flag = TRUE THEN company_client_id END)
      comment: "Count of clients using multiple PBMs requiring complex data normalization"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "multi_pbm_penetration_rate"
      display_name: "Multi-PBM Penetration %"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN multi_pbm_flag = TRUE THEN company_client_id END) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT company_client_id), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Percentage of clients using multiple PBMs (complexity indicator)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "cap_enrolled_client_count"
      display_name: "CAP Enrolled Clients"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cap_enrolled_flag = TRUE THEN company_client_id END)
      comment: "Count of clients enrolled in copay assistance program (PAX revenue stream)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "cap_enrollment_rate"
      display_name: "CAP Enrollment Rate %"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cap_enrolled_flag = TRUE THEN company_client_id END) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT company_client_id), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Percentage of clients enrolled in copay assistance program (product penetration KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "specialty_carve_out_client_count"
      display_name: "Specialty Carve-Out Clients"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN specialty_carve_out_flag = TRUE THEN company_client_id END)
      comment: "Count of clients with specialty pharmacy carved out (impacts data integration complexity)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "three_forty_b_eligible_client_count"
      display_name: "340B Eligible Clients"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN three_forty_b_eligible_flag = TRUE THEN company_client_id END)

      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "medical_integration_client_count"
      display_name: "Medical Integration Clients"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN medical_integration_flag = TRUE THEN company_client_id END)
      comment: "Count of clients with medical claims integrated for total cost of care analysis"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "medical_integration_rate"
      display_name: "Medical Integration Rate %"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN medical_integration_flag = TRUE THEN company_client_id END) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT company_client_id), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Percentage of clients with medical claims integrated (product sophistication indicator)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "rebate_sharing_avg_pct"
      display_name: "Avg Rebate Sharing %"
      expr: AVG(CAST(rebate_sharing_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average percentage of manufacturer rebates shared with clients (pricing model indicator)"
      format:

        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_invoiced_amount"
      display_name: "Total Invoiced Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(invoiced_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of invoiced amounts (revenue recognized)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_collected_amount"
      display_name: "Total Collected Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(collected_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of cash collected from clients (actual revenue realization)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "collection_rate"
      display_name: "Collection Rate %"
      expr: SUM(CAST(collected_amount AS DOUBLE)) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CAST(invoiced_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Percentage of invoiced fees successfully collected (cash realization efficiency)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_estimated_savings"
      display_name: "Total Estimated Savings"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_savings_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of estimated client savings identified through consulting engagements (value proposition)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_realized_savings"
      display_name: "Total Realized Savings"
      expr: SUM(CAST(realized_savings_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of actual client savings realized (validated value delivery)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "savings_realization_rate"
      display_name: "Savings Realization Rate %"
      expr: SUM(CAST(realized_savings_amount AS DOUBLE)) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CAST(estimated_savings_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Percentage of estimated savings actually realized by clients (delivery quality indicator)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "roi_multiple"
      display_name: "ROI Multiple"
      expr: SUM(CAST(realized_savings_amount AS DOUBLE)) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CAST(contracted_fee_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Ratio of realized client savings to consulting fees (client value multiple)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_client_satisfaction_score"
      display_name: "Avg Client Satisfaction"
      expr: AVG(CAST(client_satisfaction_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average client satisfaction score across engagements (service quality indicator)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "total_audit_findings"
      display_name: "Total Audit Findings"
      expr: SUM(CAST(audit_finding_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of PBM audit findings identified (compliance and pricing issues)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_audit_findings_per_engagement"
      display_name: "Avg Audit Findings per Engagement"
      expr: AVG(CAST(audit_finding_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of audit findings per engagement (issue density indicator)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "total_plan_spend_reviewed"
      display_name: "Total Plan Spend Reviewed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_plan_spend_reviewed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of total pharmacy plan spend analyzed across engagements (audit coverage)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_claims_reviewed"
      display_name: "Total Claims Reviewed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_rx_claims_reviewed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of pharmacy claims analyzed across engagements (audit volume)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_contracted_fee"
      display_name: "Avg Contracted Fee"
      expr: AVG(CAST(contracted_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average consulting fee per engagement (pricing indicator)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "recurring_engagement_count"
      display_name: "Recurring Engagements"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_recurring = TRUE THEN company_consulting_engagement_id END)
      comment: "Count of recurring consulting engagements (revenue stability indicator)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "recurring_engagement_rate"
      display_name: "Recurring Engagement Rate %"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_recurring = TRUE THEN company_consulting_engagement_id END) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT company_consulting_engagement_id), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Percentage of engagements that are recurring (business model stability)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Consulting engagement performance metrics tracking project delivery, client satisfaction, savings identification, and revenue realization for PillarRx audit and advisory services
