CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`company_consulting_fee`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Consulting fee and revenue metrics tracking billing, collections, payment terms, and accounts receivable performance for PillarRx consulting services"
  source: "`pillarrx`.`company`.`consulting_fee`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "fee_status"
      display_name: "Fee Status"
      expr: fee_status
      comment: "Current status of consulting fee (draft, invoiced, paid, overdue, disputed, void)"
    - name: "fee_type"
      display_name: "Fee Type"
      expr: fee_type
      comment: "Type of consulting fee (audit, advisory, CAP management, retainer, success fee)"
    - name: "service_category"
      display_name: "Service Category"
      expr: service_category
      comment: "Category of service delivered (PBM audit, benchmarking, formulary review, etc.)"
    - name: "payment_method"
      display_name: "Payment Method"
      expr: payment_method
      comment: "Method of payment received (ACH, wire, check, credit card)"
    - name: "payment_terms"
      display_name: "Payment Terms"
      expr: payment_terms
      comment: "Payment terms agreed with client (Net 30, Net 60, due on receipt, etc.)"
    - name: "is_disputed"
      display_name: "Disputed"
      expr: is_disputed
      comment: "Indicates whether fee is under dispute by client"
    - name: "is_recurring"
      display_name: "Recurring Fee"
      expr: is_recurring
      comment: "Indicates whether fee is recurring (monthly retainer, quarterly review, etc.)"
    - name: "invoice_year"
      display_name: "Invoice Year"
      expr: YEAR(invoice_date)
      comment: "Year the fee was invoiced"
    - name: "invoice_month"
      display_name: "Invoice Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date)
      comment: "Month the fee was invoiced"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "payment_year"
      display_name: "Payment Year"
      expr: YEAR(payment_received_date)
      comment: "Year payment was received"
    - name: "payment_month"
      display_name: "Payment Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_received_date)
      comment: "Month payment was received"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "billing_period_year"
      display_name: "Billing Period Year"
      expr: YEAR(billing_period_start_date)
      comment: "Year of billing period start"
    - name: "billing_period_month"
      display_name: "Billing Period Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', billing_period_start_date)
      comment: "Month of billing period start"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "total_fees"
      display_name: "Total Fees"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT consulting_fee_id)
      comment: "Distinct count of consulting fee line items"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_billed_amount"
      display_name: "Total Billed Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(billed_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of billed consulting fees (gross revenue)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_adjustment_amount"
      display_name: "Total Adjustments"
      expr: SUM(CAST(adjustment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of billing adjustments (credits, discounts, write-offs)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_net_fee_amount"
      display_name: "Total Net Fees"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of net consulting fees after adjustments (net revenue)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_paid_amount"
      display_name: "Total Paid Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(paid_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of payments received from clients (cash collected)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "total_outstanding_balance"
      display_name: "Total Outstanding Balance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(outstanding_balance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of unpaid consulting fees (accounts receivable)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "collection_rate"
      display_name: "Collection Rate %"
      expr: SUM(CAST(paid_amount AS DOUBLE)) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CAST(net_fee_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Percentage of net fees successfully collected (cash realization efficiency)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_fee_amount"
      display_name: "Avg Fee Amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(net_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average net consulting fee per line item"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "disputed_fee_count"
      display_name: "Disputed Fees"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_disputed = TRUE THEN consulting_fee_id END)
      comment: "Count of fees under client dispute"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "disputed_fee_amount"
      display_name: "Disputed Fee Amount"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_disputed = TRUE THEN CAST(net_fee_amount AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Sum of fees under client dispute (revenue at risk)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "dispute_rate"
      display_name: "Dispute Rate %"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_disputed = TRUE THEN consulting_fee_id END) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT consulting_fee_id), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Percentage of fees disputed by clients (billing quality indicator)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "recurring_fee_count"
      display_name: "Recurring Fees"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_recurring = TRUE THEN consulting_fee_id END)
      comment: "Count of recurring consulting fees (predictable revenue stream)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "recurring_fee_amount"
      display_name: "Recurring Fee Amount"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_recurring = TRUE THEN CAST(net_fee_amount AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Sum of recurring consulting fees (stable revenue base)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "recurring_revenue_rate"
      display_name: "Recurring Revenue Rate %"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_recurring = TRUE THEN CAST(net_fee_amount AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CAST(net_fee_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Percentage of revenue from recurring fees (business model stability)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_pmpm_rate"
      display_name: "Avg PMPM Rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(pmpm_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average per-member-per-month consulting fee rate (pricing indicator)"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 4
    - name: "total_member_months"
      display_name: "Total Member Months"
      expr: SUM(CAST(member_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of member-months billed (volume indicator for PMPM model)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$
metric_views.description: Consulting fee and revenue metrics tracking billing, collections, payment terms, and accounts receivable performance for PillarRx consulting services

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`company_member`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Member population and enrollment metrics tracking covered lives, demographics, eligibility status, and copay assistance program enrollment across PillarRx client base"
  source: "`pillarrx`.`company`.`member`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "enrollment_status"
      display_name: "Enrollment Status"
      expr: enrollment_status
      comment: "Current enrollment status of member (active, terminated, pending, suspended)"
    - name: "relationship_to_subscriber"
      display_name: "Relationship to Subscriber"
      expr: relationship_to_subscriber
      comment: "Member relationship to primary policyholder (subscriber, spouse, child, other dependent)"
    - name: "gender"
      display_name: "Gender"
      expr: gender
      comment: "Member gender (male, female, other, unknown)"
    - name: "language_preference"
      display_name: "Language Preference"
      expr: language_preference
      comment: "Member preferred language for communications"
    - name: "copay_assistance_eligible"
      display_name: "CAP Eligible"
      expr: copay_assistance_eligible
      comment: "Indicates whether member is eligible for copay assistance program"
    - name: "source_system"
      display_name: "Source System"
      expr: source_system
      comment: "Source PBM or eligibility system (CVS Caremark, Optum Rx, Express Scripts, etc.)"
    - name: "state"
      display_name: "State"
      expr: state
      comment: "Member state of residence"
    - name: "plan_name"
      display_name: "Plan Name"
      expr: plan_name
      comment: "Pharmacy benefit plan name"
    - name: "plan_year"
      display_name: "Plan Year"
      expr: plan_year
      comment: "Plan year for member enrollment"
    - name: "enrollment_year"
      display_name: "Enrollment Year"
      expr: YEAR(enrollment_effective_date)
      comment: "Year member enrollment became effective"
    - name: "enrollment_month"
      display_name: "Enrollment Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', enrollment_effective_date)
      comment: "Month member enrollment became effective"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "termination_year"
      display_name: "Termination Year"
      expr: YEAR(enrollment_termination_date)
      comment: "Year member enrollment was terminated"
    - name: "termination_month"
      display_name: "Termination Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', enrollment_termination_date)
      comment: "Month member enrollment was terminated"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "age_band"
      display_name: "Age Band"
      expr: CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, CURRENT_DATE()) < 18 THEN 'Under 18' WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, CURRENT_DATE()) BETWEEN 18 AND 34 THEN '18-34' WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, CURRENT_DATE()) BETWEEN 35 AND 49 THEN '35-49' WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, CURRENT_DATE()) BETWEEN 50 AND 64 THEN '50-64' WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, CURRENT_DATE()) >= 65 THEN '65+' ELSE 'Unknown' END
      comment: "Member age band for demographic analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_members"
      display_name: "Total Members"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT member_id)
      comment: "Distinct count of members (covered lives)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "active_members"
      display_name: "Active Members"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN enrollment_status = 'active' THEN member_id END)
      comment: "Count of members with active enrollment (current covered lives)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "terminated_members"
      display_name: "Terminated Members"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN enrollment_status = 'terminated' THEN member_id END)
      comment: "Count of members with terminated enrollment"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "cap_eligible_members"
      display_name: "CAP Eligible Members"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN copay_assistance_eligible = TRUE THEN member_id END)
      comment: "Count of members eligible for copay assistance program"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "cap_eligibility_rate"
      display_name: "CAP Eligibility Rate %"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN copay_assistance_eligible = TRUE THEN member_id END) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT member_id), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Percentage of members eligible for copay assistance program"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "subscriber_count"
      display_name: "Subscribers"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN relationship_to_subscriber = 'subscriber' THEN member_id END)
      comment: "Count of primary policyholders (subscribers)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "dependent_count"
      display_name: "Dependents"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN relationship_to_subscriber != 'subscriber' THEN member_id END)
      comment: "Count of dependents (non-subscribers)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "dependent_ratio"
      display_name: "Dependent Ratio"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN relationship_to_subscriber != 'subscriber' THEN member_id END) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN relationship_to_subscriber = 'subscriber' THEN member_id END), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Ratio of dependents to subscribers (family coverage indicator)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "medicare_member_count"
      display_name: "Medicare Members"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN medicare_beneficiary_identifier IS NOT NULL THEN member_id END)
      comment: "Count of members with Medicare Beneficiary Identifier (Medicare-eligible population)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "medicare_penetration_rate"
      display_name: "Medicare Penetration %"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN medicare_beneficiary_identifier IS NOT NULL THEN member_id END) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT member_id), 0) AS DOUBLE)
      comment: "Percentage of members who are Medicare-eligible"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "unique_member_360_keys"
      display_name: "Unique Member 360 Keys"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT member_360_key)
      comment: "Count of unique member 360 identifiers (deduplicated members across PBMs)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
$$
metric_views.description: Member population and enrollment metrics tracking covered lives, demographics, eligibility status, and copay assistance program enrollment across PillarRx client base

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`company_member_count_by_client`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML

          type: all

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`company_org_division`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Organizational division metrics tracking division-level client portfolios, member populations, benefit configurations, and PBM relationships within the Company > Division > Client hierarchy"
  source: "`pillarrx`.`company`.`org_division`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "division_status"
      display_name: "Division Status"
      expr: division_status
      comment: "Current status of organizational division (active, inactive, pending)"
    - name: "division_type"
      display_name: "Division Type"
      expr: division_type
      comment: "Type of organizational division (geographic, product line, business unit)"
    - name: "funding_type"
      display_name: "Funding Type"
      expr: funding_type
      comment: "Benefit funding model (fully-insured, self-funded, level-funded)"
    - name: "primary_pbm"
      display_name: "Primary PBM"
      expr: primary_pbm
      comment: "Primary pharmacy benefit manager for division"
    - name: "reporting_region"
      display_name: "Reporting Region"
      expr: reporting_region
      comment: "Geographic or business reporting region"
    - name: "cap_enabled"
      display_name: "CAP Enabled"
      expr: cap_enabled
      comment: "Indicates whether copay assistance program is enabled for division"
    - name: "specialty_carve_out"
      display_name: "Specialty Carve-Out"
      expr: specialty_carve_out
      comment: "Indicates whether specialty pharmacy is carved out"
    - name: "medical_claims_integrated"
      display_name: "Medical Claims Integrated"
      expr: medical_claims_integrated
      comment: "Indicates whether medical claims are integrated for total cost of care"
    - name: "pass_through_pricing"
      display_name: "Pass-Through Pricing"
      expr: pass_through_pricing
      comment: "Indicates whether division uses pass-through pricing model"
    - name: "rebate_pass_through"
      display_name: "Rebate Pass-Through"
      expr: rebate_pass_through
      comment: "Indicates whether manufacturer rebates are passed through to clients"
    - name: "n340b_eligible"
      display_name: "340B Eligible"
      expr: n340b_eligible
      comment: "Indicates whether division is eligible for 340B drug pricing program"
    - name: "rds_eligible"
      display_name: "RDS Eligible"
      expr: rds_eligible
      comment: "Indicates whether division is eligible for Retiree Drug Subsidy"
    - name: "hipaa_baa_executed"
      display_name: "HIPAA BAA Executed"
      expr: hipaa_baa_executed
      comment: "Indicates whether HIPAA Business Associate Agreement is executed"
    - name: "data_sharing_consent"
      display_name: "Data Sharing Consent"
      expr: data_sharing_consent
      comment: "Indicates whether data sharing consent is on file"
    - name: "dir_applicable"
      display_name: "DIR Applicable"
      expr: dir_applicable
      comment: "Indicates whether Direct and Indirect Remuneration fees are applicable"
  measures:
    - name: "total_divisions"
      display_name: "Total Divisions"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT org_division_id)
      comment: "Distinct count of organizational divisions"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "active_divisions"
      display_name: "Active Divisions"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN division_status = 'active' THEN org_division_id END)
      comment: "Count of divisions with active status"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_clients_in_divisions"
      display_name: "Total Clients"
      expr: SUM(CAST(client_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of client counts across all divisions"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_clients_per_division"
      display_name: "Avg Clients per Division"
      expr: AVG(CAST(client_count AS DOUBLE))

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `pillarrx`.`_metrics`.`drug_mac_pricing`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Maximum Allowable Cost pricing metrics for PBM audit, spread analysis, and generic reimbursement benchmarking"
  source: "`pillarrx`.`drug`.`mac_pricing`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "pricing_basis"
      display_name: "Pricing Basis"
      expr: pricing_basis
      comment: "Pricing basis methodology (AWP, WAC, MAC, etc.)"
    - name: "price_source"
      display_name: "Price Source"
      expr: price_source
      comment: "Source of MAC pricing data"
    - name: "appeal_status"
      display_name: "Appeal Status"
      expr: appeal_status
      comment: "MAC pricing appeal status"
    - name: "effective_month"
      display_name: "Effective Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', effective_date)
      comment: "MAC effective date bucketed to month for pricing trend analysis"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "effective_quarter"
      display_name: "Effective Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', effective_date)
      comment: "MAC effective date bucketed to quarter"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "avg_mac_price"
      display_name: "Avg MAC Price"
      expr: AVG(CAST(mac_price AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average MAC price per unit — generic reimbursement benchmark"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_pharmacy_acquisition_cost"
      display_name: "Avg Pharmacy Acq Cost"
      expr: AVG(CAST(pharmacy_acquisition_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average pharmacy acquisition cost per unit — pharmacy cost baseline"
      format:
        type: currency
        currency_code: USD
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "mac_to_pac_spread_pct"
      display_name: "MAC-PAC Spread %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * (AVG(CAST(mac_price AS DOUBLE)) - AVG(CAST(pharmacy_acquisition_cost AS DOUBLE))) / NULLIF(AVG(CAST(pharmacy_acquisition_cost AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Average MAC-to-PAC spread percentage — measures PBM margin opportunity on generic reimbursement"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_awp_discount_pct"
      display_name: "Avg AWP Discount %"
      expr: AVG(CAST(awp_discount_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average AWP discount percentage applied to MAC pricing — generic pricing concession"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Maximum Allowable Cost pricing metrics for PBM audit, spread analysis, and generic reimbursement benchmarking
